| History                 = In this timeline, [[Orchis (Moira-IV.8)|Orchis]] was successful in its mission to destroy [[Mutants (Homo superior)|mutantkind]], leaving only a few scattered survivors. In time, Orchis was wholly usurped by the [[Sentinels|machines]], who continued to wage war against the X-Men while using their advanced technology to summon a [[Dominions|dominion]] that could absorb them into its nigh omnipotent machine intellect.{{r|Rise of the Powers of X Vol 1 1}}  

After ten years, Orchis was on the cusp of victory. By this time, [[Anthony Stark (Moira-IV.8)|Tony Stark]] was long dead, but an A.I. imprint of him remained, inhabiting his final suit and fighting alongside the X-Men.{{r|Rise of the Powers of X Vol 1 1}}  

Knowing that the only hope of averting the machines' plans lay in reseting their own timeline, the X-Men sought to find [[Nathaniel Essex (Mister Sinister) (Moira-IV.8)|Mr. Sinister]], since his [[Moira Engine]] would allow them to reset their timeline. The X-Men managed to trace Sinister to a prison on [[Phobos (Moon)|Phobos]]. However, when they arrived the [[Sentinels|Sentinel]] surveillance began to increase. The amount of computer power required to keep the X-Men hidden overwhelmed Tony, causing him to explode.{{r|Rise of the Powers of X Vol 1 1}}

| QuoteSource             = I Am Iron Man Vol 1 5

| History                 = As one of Earth's premier super heroes and due to his constant exposure to danger, [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] has devised a consciousness-backup system which uploads his consciousness and memories into a clone in the event of a lethal injury. If he survives an otherwise-fatal hazard or the system glitches out, a surplus clone or clones might surface. Since that represents a liability on its own, whenever a Tony Stark discovers an anomaly, he is to hunt down and terminate all other Tony Starks.

One such backup clone, believing himself to be the real Tony Stark, once visited the [[Cube]] to recruit and help reform the technopath criminal [[Deola (Earth-616)|Deola]]. He became aware of the anomaly when the Cube's warden [[George (Cube Warden) (Earth-616)|George]] mentioned his lobbying to reform the prison into a more humane environment, which he hadn't personally done. When leaving the prison with Deola, Iron Man was attacked by a [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-616)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] strike team led by yet another surplus Iron Man clone. Tony broadcast data packets around himself which were downloaded into the other Iron Man's armor, assembling in its systems as a virus which hijacked his suit's life support and killed him. Afterward, Tony synchronized his memories with those of his dead opponent.

Three months later, Iron Man and Deola were refueling a S.H.I.E.L.D. satellite in orbit when Stark was attacked by a new [[Gargantus II (Alien Robot) (Earth-616)|Gargantus]] deployed to take him down, who knocked Tony down back to Earth. Tony's consciousness-backup system was damaged in the process, and Gargantus overpowered him. Deola came to Tony's aid, augmenting his armor with her own, which gave him the edge against Gargantus. The robot detonated afterward, and Tony shoved Deola out of harm's way. Before being caught in the blast and dying, Iron Man admitted to Deola that he still didn't recall reforming the Cube, meant as a reassurance that there was still another Tony Stark out there.{{r|I Am Iron Man Vol 1 5}}

| History                 = On [[Earth-802]], a universe ruled by [[Jennix (Earth-001)|Jennix]] of the [[Inheritors (Earth-001)|Inheritors]], Tony Stark was the architect of three of its biggest cities.

When [[Benjamin Reilly (Earth-94)|Spider-Man]], [[Kaine Parker (Earth-616)|Scarlet Spider]], and [[Jessica Drew (Spider-Clone) (Earth-1610)|Black Widow]] travelled to this reality, and encountered a factory of clones, Iron Man was attracted by the disturbances created by the arachnid heroes. Iron Man attempted to apprehend them, aware that bringing three spider-heroes would guarantee him a high reward from Jennix, but he was taken by surprise by the Scarlet Spider, and knocked out when the face-plate of his [[Iron Man Armor|armor]] was up.

Black Widow dismantled the armor and interrogated Stark for the location of Jennix, which was revealed to be the [[Baxter Building]]. Spider-Man would later wear Stark's Iron Man armor to impersonate him and gain easy access to the Baxter Building.{{r|Scarlet Spiders Vol 1 1}}

===Early years===
After the [[Earth-10011|Cancerverse]] was corrupted by the [[Great Old Ones|Many-Angled Ones]] and [[Death (Earth-10011)|Death]] was vanquished by [[Mar-Vell (Earth-10011)|Lord Marvel]],{{r|Thanos Imperative Vol 1 3}} Iron Man and his fellow [[Revengers (Earth-10011)|Avengers]] were corrupted and placed under Mar-Vell's service, now calling themselves the Revengers,{{r|Thanos Imperative Vol 1 1|6}} headquartered at the [[Trapezohedron]].{{r|Realm of Kings Vol 1 1}}

===The Fault and Thanos===
Along with [[Thor Odinson (Earth-10011)|Thor]], [[Carol Danvers (Earth-10011)|Ms. Marvel]], [[Henry Pym (Earth-10011)|Giant-Man]], the [[Wanda Maximoff (Earth-10011)|Scarlet Witch]] and [[Steven Rogers (Earth-10011)|Captain America]], Iron Man tracked down the [[Bruce Banner (Earth-10011)|Hulk]], who ended up attacking [[Wendell Vaughn (Earth-616)|Quasar (Wendell Vaughn)]] from [[Earth-616]] (having arrived there after going through the space/time fissure known as the [[Fault]]). Hulk was quickly subdued (Iron Man pulling Banner's heart out to neutralize him), and Quasar captured and brought to the Trapezohedron for questioning.{{r|Realm of Kings Vol 1 1}}

Based on his very presence, the Revengers deduced the existence of a world available for conquest and the Scarlet Witch (terrified of Stark and Pym), using the [[Leng Lens]], was able to follow his trail of energy to Earth-616. The first steps of the march on Earth-616 were set, but Quasar managed to escape thanks to the intervention of [[Vision (Earth-10011)|Vision]] (who had hidden himself in his wife's body). Iron Man pursued him.{{r|Realm of Kings Vol 1 1}}

They fought against the forces of [[Earth-616]] in an attempt to corrupt that reality as well.{{r|Thanos Imperative Vol 1 1|6}}<!-- divide ref -->

Iron Man, along with everyone else in the Cancerverse died when [[Thanos (Earth-616)|Thanos]] brought [[Death (Earth-616)|Death]] to the Cancerverse.{{r|Realm of Kings Vol 1 1}}{{r|Thanos Imperative Vol 1 1|6}}<!-- divide ref -->

===Worldmind===
Iron Man and some of his fellow Revengers were later resurrected and possessed by the Many-Angled Ones and the [[Xandarian Worldmind (Earth-616)|Xandarian Worldmind]] to secure [[Richard Rider (Earth-616)|Nova]] who had become a portal between the Cancerverse and Earth-616. With help from [[Samuel Alexander (Earth-616)|Sam Alexander]], Nova fought off the Revengers and both he and Sam escaped to Earth-616 using a [[Cosmic Cube]].{{r|Nova Vol 7 6|7}}<!-- 

===The Scourge of the Negative Zone===
... -->

==Religion==
Iron Man was seemingly a fervent worshiper of the [[Great Old Ones|Many-Angled Ones]], stating he would "employ any and every method [he could] to find new territories for [his] gods to walk upon", mentioning it as a "restoration of the angles of etheric harmony", and was described as being able of terrific things to those who would oppose their plans<!-- Scarlet Witch was afraid -->.{{r|Realm of Kings Vol 1 1}}

| History                 = Iron Man was a supporter of the Superhero Registration Act and after several skirmishes with the Anti-Superhero Registration forces he agreed to meet with [[Steven Rogers (Earth-10208)|Captain America]]. During this meeting he thanked Steve for coming and asked for his help, this made Steve change his mind about using the weapon he had concealed in his hand. However, his team accidentally released the [[Codename Lightning (Earth-10208)|Thor Clone]] and [[Reed Richards (Earth-10208)|Mister Fantastic]] was unable to shut it down. Both Pro and Anti- registration joined forces to put him down. The clone turned to attack [[William Foster (Earth-10208)|Bill Foster]] but Iron Man took the force of the attack and was about to be finished by it when Captain America stepped in to protect his friend. Eventually the group managed to take the clone down and the two leaders met to talk in Avengers Tower. Here Iron Man made a new proposition, Captain America should be the man who everyone registers with, not the government, since only he would be the man everybody would trust. Steve initially disagreed but eventually came round to the idea and after revealling to world, they formed a new [[Avengers (Earth-10208)|Avengers]] team and the world was led into a new golden age of heroes. {{r|What If? Stark and Richards agreed to work together in dealing with these recent developments. Stark's attitude toward Thor irked the thunder god by Reed Richards managed to keep the peace.{{r|Thor: First Thunder Vol 1 3}} Stark and Mr. Fantastic were able to call a meeting with Thor at the Fantastic Four's [[Baxter Building]] headquarters to advise him that his activities might cause tensions across the world stage with other countries trying to develop super-humans of their own as part of a growing super-human arms race. Not long thereafter, Stark met with Thor again following his battle with the Chinese super-human known as the [[Chen Lu (Earth-11035)|Radioactive Man]]. Stark later met with Thor again, representing the American government, thanking him for dealing with the Radioactive Man. Stark also earned Thor's ire again when he deduced there was some connection between Thor and [[Donald Blake (Earth-11035)|Dr. Donald Blake]], secretly Thor's mortal alter-ego. The meeting was brief, as Stark had to leave to the other side of the world for a weapons inspection.{{r|Thor: First Thunder Vol 1 4}}

| Quotation               = God, I could use a drink.
| Speaker                 = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-11080)|Iron Man]]
| QuoteSource             = Marvel Universe Vs. The Avengers Vol 1 3

| History                 = When a plague turned the world's population into cannibals, Iron Man helped his fellow [[Avengers (Earth-11080)|Avengers]] hold back the infected.{{r|Marvel Universe Vs. The Avengers Vol 1 1}}

The scientists working on a cure were attacked in the [[Baxter Building]] so they decided to move operations to Elizabeth, [[New Jersey (State)|New Jersey]], where [[Reed Richards (Earth-11080)|Reed Richards]] had stored old equipment and where [[T'Challa (Earth-11080)|T'Challa]] believed [[Shuri (Earth-11080)|his sister]] was hiding. Iron Man was among the heroes that led the convoy out of [[New York City|New York]] when they were confronted by the [[Bruce Banner (Earth-11080)|Hulk]] and his army on the Goethals Bridge. The heroes held them back while the scientists escaped, though not without much loss of life.{{r|Marvel Universe Vs. Wolverine Vol 1 3}}

As their losses started to pile up, [[Victor von Doom (Earth-11080)|Doctor Doom]] came to them and offered to give them a cure in exchange for being named Emperor of Earth. Though initially hesitant, they agreed to his demands.{{r|Marvel Universe Vs. The Avengers Vol 1 2}}

The cure in question were his Doomstones, made from a combination of science and alchemy, which were designed to keep the cannibalism dormant inside the wearer. However, when one is put on an infected person, their mind is completely wiped clean, effectively turning them into vegetables. Due to the scientific and mystical nature of the Doomstones, Tony was incapable of unlocking its secrets, and running tests on them were made even harder with his lab in shambles. Tony sent [[Pietro Maximoff (Earth-11080)|Quicksilver]] to deliver a Doomstone to Reed and T'Challa, currently based in [[Alaska (State)|Alaska]], for them to study it themselves.

To make matters worse, [[Jeanne Foucault (Earth-11080)|Finesse]] alerted him and [[Clinton Barton (Earth-11080)|Hawkeye]] of an attack at one of their safety camps housing twenty thousand uninfected civilians and a third of the medical team. Though they were able to stop the infected with the [[Francis Castle (Earth-11080)|Punisher]]'s help, many died in the process.{{r|Marvel Universe Vs. The Avengers Vol 1 3}}

Later on, Hawkeye discovered that Doom was infected and that his Doomstones were actually a means for him to turn everyone into cannibals. After activating them, everyone wearing a Doomstone immediately succumbed to the plague. At that moment, Iron Man, [[Thaddeus Ross (Earth-11080)|Red Hulk]] and the [[Avengers Academy (Earth-11080)|Avengers Academy]] kids were putting up an electrified barrier to keep cannibals out of New York City. Thanks to his suit, Iron Man was safe from the effects of the Doomstones, but after a brutal battle against the infected Red Hulk, his systems went critical, exposing him long enough to succumb to the plague. However, his suit shut down entirely, locking him inside.{{r|Marvel Universe Vs. The Avengers Vol 1 4}} He screamed for five days before eventually dying.{{r|Marvel Universe Vs. The Punisher Vol 1 3}}

===Origin and early years===
At some point, '''Anthony Stark''' worked with [[Reed Richards (Earth-11326)|Reed Richards]] to prevent [[Max Eisenhardt (Earth-11326)|Magneto]]'s efforts to reverse the magnetic poles. Their solution, field valence manipulators, run "full-time" to prevent a repeat of that crisis.{{r|Age of X Communiqués Vol 1 1}}

During a confrontation with the Jeffries brothers, [[Madison Jeffries (Earth-11326)|Madison]] and [[Lionel Jeffries (Earth-11326)|Lionel]], he was infected with a virus which fused him permanently with his suit. Slowly being digested by the suit, he was essentially a corpse animated by machinery and jokingly called himself the "'''Steel Corpse'''".{{r|Age of X: Universe Vol 1 1}}

===Avengers===
At some point, he joined the [[Avengers (Earth-11326)|Avengers]], and intervened at the [[Grand Canyon]] [[Grand Canyon Genetic Exclusion Zone|Genetic Exclusion Zone]] riot, demonstrating enjoyment in the repression and murder of mutants.{{r|Age of X: Universe Vol 1 1}}

When the team called off the mission against the [[Fortress X]], an emergency override took over his armor and attempted to kill mutant children. When [[Steven Rogers (Earth-11326)|Captain America]] asked Stark how he could save him, Stark heroically responded to Rogers not to save him but save the children. At his request, Captain America killed him with a shot to the back of the head. His right glove was then used by [[Jessica Drew (Earth-11326)|Redback]] to kill the [[Bruce Banner (Earth-11326)|Hulk]].{{r|Age of X: Universe Vol 1 2}}

| History                 = 
===Origin===
Anthony "Tony" Stark was the son of Howard and Maria Stark before their deaths, he grew taking after his fathers intellect but was always displeased how his father hardly spent any time with him, even so Tony respected him as great scientist rather than a great dad. Howard would always tell Tony stories of his old friend and war hero Captain America.

Tony Stark grew up to be a brilliant inventor and CEO of [[Stark Industries (Earth-12041)|Stark Industries]] but was also arrogant and egotistical. One day he was taken into captivity by the [[Ten Rings (Earth-12041)|Ten Rings]] in [[Afghanistan]] when they attacked him with his own weapons, one of the bombs shrapnel resulted being stuck to his chest. He built an Arc Reactor in his chest to keep him alive as well as his first armor while held hostage by [[Ten Rings (Earth-12041)|terrorists]], using his brilliant technical know how to escape. Once back in the [[United States of America|United States]] he uses his new invention to become the hero Iron Man and later on was one of the founding members and the leader of the [[Avengers (Earth-12041)|Avengers]] before it disbanded.

===Great Power===
Iron Man is considered by both [[Nicholas Fury (Earth-12041)|Nick Fury]] and [[Peter Parker (Earth-12041)|Spider-Man]] as one of the greatest superheroes ever.{{r|Ultimate Spider-Man (animated series) Season 1 1}}

===Flight of the Iron Spider===
Spider-Man and the team fight the [[Arthur Parks (Earth-12041)|Living Laser]] but are saved by Iron Man, the armored Avenger, flying down. Spider-Man is totally stunned as he watches his hero talking with Nick Fury, who recently arrived, and wants him to stay away from [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-12041)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] business. After Peter intervenes in the conversation, suggesting a way to contain Living Laser for his obvious return, he's invited by Stark to come to the Stark Industries Main Plant. Fury reminds him to stay away from S.H.I.E.L.D. business and Spider-Man. The following day, Spider-Man is walking though Stark Industries: as he shows Spider-Man some inventions, such as robots and a machine capable of teleporting matter to different universes, Spider-Man imagines himself in different realities.{{r|Ultimate Spider-Man (animated series) Season 1 5}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-12041) from Ultimate Spider-Man (animated series) Season 1 5 0002.jpg|thumb|left]]
The tour ends with Tony Stark giving Spider-Man a new costume, at which Spidey is amazed. The next day, the S.H.I.E.L.D. trainees are at the [[Helicarrier]] waiting for Spider-Man, who isn't coming. When they finish training, he appears in the [[Iron Spider Armor]], which he can't really control. The next week the trainees are annoyed by Spidey's new costume, which he thinks is totally value for the group and can't admit he cannot control it. The Living Laser returns and takes over the Spider Armor, and Iron Man is forced to sacrifice himself to save Spider-Man. The Living Laser now is unstoppable in the Iron Man armor.

Meanwhile, Spider-Man uses the data in his armor to search about Iron Man's. When he finds a security fail-safe, a electric discharge which could be discharged in Stark's brain, but [[Just A Really Very Intelligent System (Earth-12041)|J.A.R.V.I.S.]] (an AI equipped in the armor) suggests not to do it. With Tony awake he blast the Laser out the Armor and send him to a particle accelerator that sends him into another dimension.

===The Iron Octopus===
Spider-Man and [[Norman Osborn (Earth-12041)|Norman Osborn]] are attacked by one of Iron Man's armors, so he travels to Stark Industries to find out what happened. When he arrives he finds Iron Man battling his own armors, working with Spider-Man he takes them all out. They discover an [[Octobots|Octobot]] hacking his system, which they try to follow but escapes through a vent. The Ocotobot returns to [[Otto Octavius (Earth-12041)|Doc Ock]] who uses the [[Arc Reactor]] technology to build his own armor. The Osborns are taken to the Helicarrier for protection, Norman threatens to sue Stark for everything he owns, despite Stark's denial of involvement. The Osborns, Iron Man, and Spider-Man were then called into [[Curtis Connors (Earth-12041)|Doc Connors]]' lab to view his regarding a piece of the tentacle. Doc Connors explained that it was created by Dr. Otto Octavius. Osborn reveals that Octavius was a former employee that died in an accident. Doc Ock reactivates the tentacle and attacks Osborn, but it is destroyed by Iron Man. Doc Ock, in his Iron Octopus armor, arrives and kidnaps both the Osborns. He takes them both to his secret lab and threatens Osborn. Spider-Man arrives in his Iron Spider armor and rescues his friends. He then battled the Iron Octopus, but before Doc Ock could defeat Spider-Man, Iron Man arrives and blasts Doc Ock and is defeated due to his faulty Arc Reactor. Norman recovers Doc Ock's body and provides him the medical treatment he needs with plans to use him again in the future. Iron Man thanks Spider-Man and agrees to another possible team up in the future.{{r|Ultimate Spider-Man (animated series) Season 1 22}}

===Not a Toy===
Iron Man is briefly seen flying through the sky when [[Captain America's Shield]] falls out of the Helicarrier and hits him on the head.{{r|Ultimate Spider-Man (animated series) Season 1 23}}

===Swarm===
In a fight between Spider-Man and [[Cain Marko (Earth-12041)|Juggernaut]], Iron Man appears and blasts him, but he just keeps running straight into a building, as it collapses, the two try to stop the fall. Spider-Man attempts to use his tracer to track Juggernaut, but being a prototype it does not work. Spider-Man goes to Stark Industries, but the employees were being attacked by robotic arms and other machines. It is revealed they being controlled by [[Michael Tan (Earth-12041)|Michael Tan]] who was a disgruntled employee at Stark Industries who was fired after Tony Stark rejected his technopathic devices. Michael swears he will get his revenge on Stark, and activates his latest creation, which seemingly vaporizes him. Unknown to Stark and Spider-Man Michael's molecules had been dispersed, and his consciousness found a new host in one of Spider-Man's [[Spider-Tracer|Spider-Tracers]]. During a second battle with the Juggernaut, the Spider-Tracers begin to rapidly multiply, and Michael makes this fluid-like collection of Spider-Tracers his new body. Michael, now calling himself "Swarm" attacks Spider-Man and Iron Man, destroying the [[Hall of Armor]] in the process. Swarm is only defeated after the two heroes fly through the villain's "mouth" and Spider-Man neutralizes the Spider-Tracers.{{r|Ultimate Spider-Man (animated series) Season 2 11}}

===The Avengers Protocol===
After [[Steven Rogers (Earth-12041)|Captain America]] is vaporized by the [[Johann Schmidt (Earth-12041)|Red Skull]], Iron Man activates "The Avengers Protocol" calling the team through a hologram device to a meeting. The heroes selected by Stark are [[Thor Odinson (Earth-12041)|Thor]], [[Clinton Barton (Earth-12041)|Hawkeye]], [[Bruce Banner (Earth-12041)|Hulk]], [[Natalia Romanova (Earth-12041)|Black Widow]], and a S.H.I.E.L.D. trainee named [[Samuel Wilson (Earth-12041)|Sam Wilson]]. As the Avengers fly to the [[Hydra (Earth-12041)|Hydra]] Base, in [[Antarctica]] and learn that Captain America is still alive and was only unreported by [[George Tarleton (Earth-12041)|M.O.D.O.K.]] to undergo a body change with his mortal nemesis the Skull. What ensues is a massive battle that ends up rescuing Captain America. After his defeat the Skull realizes where the true power resides in the Avengers team and orders M.O.D.O.K. attack and strips Tony of his Arc Reactor and Armor. Now clad in his armor he calls himself the "Iron-Skull". As Tony lies their dying Tony asks Captain America for help.{{r|Marvel's Avengers Assemble Season 1 1}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-12041) from Marvel's Avengers Assemble Season 2 1 002.jpg|thumb|left|Tony Stark]]
The team find the [[Quinjet]] blown to pieces. The only option is for them to all squeeze into the S.H.I.E.L.D. flying car. They rush him back to the [[Avengers Mansion]] where Falcon hooks Tony up to machinery to restart his heart. M.O.D.O.K. use special nanobot with the ability to manipulate the Avengers to turn on each other. During the sparring session the nanobots attack and infect them. They all battle each other with only Tony left uninfected. He cures his allies using a concentrated EMP. They find the Skull who was trying to steal Tony's tech, but he is stopped, but still has time to teleport away. It is then that Tony discovers the Mansion's reactor was about to blow. The team must work together to stop the explosion. They create a vortex shooting the explosive energy into the sky. The team now move to [[Stark Tower]] where they set up home as now a official team.{{r|Marvel's Avengers Assemble Season 1 2}}

===Ghost of a Chance===
The Avengers battle [[Space Phantoms]], extra-dimensional beings who can replicate them right down to cellular level. The creatures replace them one by trapping them in [[Limbo (Temporal)|Limbo]]. But thanks to Falcon he is able to save the team and working together the take down the alien invaders.{{r|Marvel's Avengers Assemble Season 1 3}}

===The Serpent of Doom===
The Avengers battle [[Victor von Doom (Earth-12041)|Doctor Doom]] as he uses the [[Asgardians|Asgardian]] weapon [[Codgel]] to release the [[Jormungand (Earth-12041)|Midgard Serpent]] with hopes of using it to conquer the globe. The creature is too powerful and would continue to grow until it consumes the Earth. After a battle with the Avengers he and the creature are banished to the [[Realm Below]] using the extra-dimensional portal used by [[Ulik (Earth-12041)|Ulik]].{{r|Marvel's Avengers Assemble Season 1 4}}

===Blood Feud===
The Avengers battle [[Vlad Dracula (Earth-12041)|Dracula]] who had kidnapped the Black Widow and turned her into a [[Vampire]]. They travel to [[Transylvania]] and confront him at [[Castle Dracula]]. He reveals that he was an ally of Captain America during [[World War II]], working together to defeat the invading Hydra forces. He wants the [[Super-Soldier Serum]] in Cap's blood which will allow him and his subject the ability to go out in the sunlight. During the fight he drinks the Hulk's blood absorbing his powers and turning the Hulk into a Vampire. However the Hulk gamma cells act like tiny suns and he burns away the infection, which also weakens Dracula. In his defeat his minion drag him underground to safety.{{r|Marvel's Avengers Assemble Season 1 5}}

He was captured along the other heroes by the [[Taneleer Tivan (Earth-12041)|Collector]], and rescued by She-Hulk and Skaar.{{r|Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. Season 1 4}} 

===Super-Adaptoid===
After showing Captain America a brief virtual simulation about battle tactics, Tony offers to give Steve an armor to enhance his abilities. Steve declines just as Justin Hammer sends a video message to them, inviting him to his company to show off his new invention: The Super-Adaptoid. The Avengers make quick work of the Adaptoid, prompting Hammer to rebuild the robot and send it to Avengers Tower to attack the team. After a lengthy battle, Tony and the Avengers manage to destroy the Super-Adaptoid again.{{r|Marvel's Avengers Assemble Season 1 6}}

| History                 = Tony Stark was the hero known as Iron Man, a visionary playboy and billionaire inventor who created one of the most [[Iron Man Armor|advanced pieces of technology on Earth]]. He was both a founder member of the [[Avengers (Earth-12131)|Avengers]] and the secret group known as the [[Illuminati (Earth-12131)|Illuminati]], apart from being one of the few heroes who help [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-12131)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] both in field and planning.{{r|Marvel: Avengers Alliance}}

===The Pulse===
One day, a mysterious Pulse hit Earth, a phenomenon which affected technology worldwide, left strange energy signatures, and traces of an unknown material. Tony was the first superhero to become part of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s newest [[Commander (Earth-12131)|Agent]]'s team to rescue [[Natalia Romanova (Earth-12131)|Black Widow]] from [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-12131)|A.I.M.]], and later helped to re-establish the connections of the [[S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier|Helicarrier]] and its flight deck after the Pulse.

After facing [[Hydra (Earth-12131)|Hydra]] forces, led by [[Ophelia Sarkissian (Earth-12131)|Viper]] and [[Helmut Zemo (Earth-12131)|Baron Zemo]], [[Steven Rogers (Earth-12131)|Captain America]] along with Tony, [[Nicholas Fury (Earth-12131)|Nick Fury]], [[Maria Hill (Earth-12131)|Maria Hill]], [[Thor Odinson (Earth-12131)|Thor]], and [[Reed Richards (Earth-12131)|Mr. Fantastic]] collect all the things they know about the Pulse and the enemies they faced in battle.

After the reunion they arrived to the conclusion that the Pulse was a charged cloud of an "[[Neutronium|Isotope-8]]", a kind of compound capable of multiply people's powers, that crashed the Earth, leaving all this energy lost in the planet and that was what their enemies were looking for. The heroes realized they could use this Iso-8 for good, boosting agents' and heroes' abilities against the new enhanced villains.{{r|Marvel: Avengers Alliance}}

===Ulterior Motive===
Later, Tony alerted S.H.I.E.L.D. from [[Servo-Guards]] attacking the [[Avengers Mansion]], after discovering they where actually hacked Servo-Guards, he and S.H.I.E.L.D. decided to investigate who was controlling them instead of their creator, [[Victor von Doom (Earth-12131)|Doctor Doom]]. After the [[Sentinels/Alternate Realities#Earth-12131 (Avengers Alliance)|Sentinels]] also attacked the Avengers Mansion, Stark discovered who was controlling them was apparently [[Boris Turgenov (Earth-12131)|Crimson Dynamo]]. But after defeating him, the heroes realized Crimson Dynamo's armor was also being controlled, by an unknown party.{{r|Marvel: Avengers Alliance}}
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-12131) from Marvel Avengers Alliance 0004.png|thumb|left]]
===Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.===
After Nick Fury and Maria Hill were kidnapped while attending to a diplomatic engagement in the [[Latverian Embassy]], Tony Stark became the acting director of S.H.I.E.L.D.. Congressional voices started trying to run S.H.I.E.L.D. their own way, increasing the pursuit to find them. After finding a coded message from Fury, Tony and Reed Richards managed to find their location, [[Ryker's Island]], where a jailbreak was being used as a cover. After defeating the leader of the breakout, [[Paul Norbert Ebersol (Earth-12131)|Fixer]], peace was restored and Nick and Maria retrieved from the island by pilot [[Benjamin Grimm (Earth-12131)|Ben Grimm]], also known as the superhero the Thing. After their return, Nick Fury revealed a new alliance of supervillains was born: the [[Syndicate (Earth-12131)|Syndicate]].{{r|Marvel: Avengers Alliance}}

===Avengers vs. X-Men===
When the [[Phoenix Force (Earth-12131)|Phoenix Force]] returned Earth, it manifested within [[Phoenix Five (Earth-12131)|five X-Men]], who retreated to their base on [[Utopia (X-Men Base)|Utopia]], and created a new type of Iso-8. Iron Man was among the [[Avengers (Earth-12131)|Avengers]] who believed the Phoenix Force was way too powerful for the [[X-Men (Earth-12131)|X-Men]] to leave them control it to their cravings, and that it would ultimately corrupt them and destroy the world. After facing [[Emma Frost (Earth-12131)|Emma Frost]], the Avengers concluded the Phoenix Force was indeed corrupting those five X-Men.

The Avengers continued to face the X-Men and other enemies trying to get their hands on the Phoenix Force's powers, and ultimately, the Phoenix Force left the mutants, and Earth. With their differences settled, both the Avengers and the X-Men continued to fight in the same side.{{r|Marvel: Avengers Alliance}}

===The Syndicate===
An alliance sealed by Doctor Doom resulted in the creation of a mega-group composed of different criminal organizations with the aim to control the Iso-8. Tony helped to discover that the villains used magic from the [[Hand (Earth-12131)|Hand]] in order to bring back to life one of Captain America's old enemies from the [[World War II]], the [[Johann Schmidt (Earth-12131)|Red Skull]].

After they were defeated by the [[Alliance (Earth-12131)|Alliance]] and [[Max Eisenhardt (Earth-12131)|Magneto]], Doom finally revealed the Syndicate to be just a distraction to prevent S.H.I.E.L.D. from noticing about his real plans with Iso-8.{{r|Marvel: Avengers Alliance}}

===Extremis===
Stark had created a new armor by the time A.I.M.'s newest terrorist attack was executed. [[Boris Bullski (Earth-12131)|Titanium Man]], [[Anton Vanko (Whiplash) (Earth-12131)|Whiplash]] and Crimson Dynamo were hired by the terrorist organization in order to protect their project Extremis, a nano-technologic initiative whose existence was revealed by S.H.I.E.L.D.'s intel.

After Titanium Man was defeated, Stark searched through A.I.M.'s data on Extremis and found out they were replicating the job of [[Maya Hansen (Earth-12131)|Maya Hansen]], an old colleague of Stark, who was researching a new kind of super-soldier solution, based on direct nanotech interfaces with human nerves.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-12131) from Marvel Avengers Alliance 0010.png|thumb|250px|right]]
Stark discovered a mercenary [[Eric Savin (Earth-12131)|Eric Savin]] was used by A.I.M. as the first test subject of the Extremis technology, suggesting the involvement of a third party. Meanwhile, the Stark Tower was attacked by A.I.M., the task to protect it was left to S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Alliance, as Nick Fury ordered Tony to make the reveal of Savin's location his priority.

After having a solid lead on Savin's location, Iron Man departed along [[James Rhodes (Earth-12131)|War Machine]] to find him. A.I.M. goon [[Donald Gill (Earth-12131)|Blizzard]] directly attacked the Stark Tower, and Iron Man monitored how [[Virginia Potts (Earth-12131)|Pepper Potts]], who was debuting in her superheroic career as Rescue, handled him.

A.I.M. managed to crack [[Stark Tower]]'s security and let Savin remotely control Rhodes' [[War Machine Armor MK II (Earth-199999)|Iron Patriot Armor]], with which he fought Rescue once more until the armor's command codes were re-keyed by Iron Man.

During his search-and-destroy mission along War Machine, Iron Man recovered material for Mr. Fantastic, [[Henry McCoy (Earth-12131)|Beast]] and [[Henry Pym (Earth-12131)|Giant-Man]] to investigate. After S.H.I.E.L.D. figured out a way to identify the electronic signature of the [[Extremis]] nanos remotely, Savin was located nearby the [[Empire State University]].

Iron Man's armor was still not combat ready as it was still recovering from A.I.M.'s cyber attack to Stark Tower, and Blizzard, Crimson Dynamo, Titanium Man and Whiplash were sent to distract the Alliance and protect Savin, but after they were all defeated with the help of Rescue, Savin revealed himself, just in time for Stark's armor to be fully operational. Savin was defeated and taken to S.H.I.E.L.D. custody in order to investigate the Extremis technology.

Right after Savin was captured, the [[Mandarin (Earth-12131)|Mandarin]] revealed himself in a video transmission to be the mysterious ally of A.I.M., and that his true plan was about to start.{{r|Marvel: Avengers Alliance}}

| History                 = When Tony Stark was a young child, his father [[Howard Stark (Earth-12311)|Howard Stark]] encouraged a friendly rivalry between him and his brother [[Arno Stark (Earth-12311)|Arno]] to promote affection, but ended up creating a bitter never-ending competition between the two brothers.{{r|Armor Wars Vol 1 1}}

Like the rest of the inhabitants of [[Technopolis]], Tony was forced to live his life encased in a high-tech suit of armor to protect his body after Howard secretly released an airborne disease as part of a secret marketing ploy to make people buy his life-support armors, and the pathogen proved to be more virulent than expected, affecting every citizen instead of a small portion as originally planned.

Following Howard's death, Tony became the new Baron of Technopolis, and continued to do anything to keep the nature of the disease a secret from the populace and maintain the name of his family clean. The main technique for keeping people away from the truth were the secret neural inhibitors placed in the populace's suits of armor, which could steer people's minds from wanting to uncover the truth. However, in some occasions, people could accidentally override their inhibitors and try to learn the truth, which was the reason why Tony killed the parents his protégée [[Kiri Oshiro (Earth-12311)|Kiri Oshiro]], [[Rumiko Fujikawa (Earth-12311)|Rumiko Fujikawa]] and her husband, and reporter [[Benjamin Urich (Earth-12311)|Ben Urich]].{{r|Armor Wars Vol 1 5}}

In the business of providing Technopolis with life and mobility, Baron Stark's direct rival was his brother Arno. Tony promised Howard to allow Arno free market in the city as long as he didn't break any laws. Even though Arno constantly opposed Tony, and even provided technology for criminals, Tony had not been able to prove his brother's illicit activities, and opposed the idea to use his power as Baron to get rid of Arno.{{r|Armor Wars Vol 1 1}} Additionally, Tony allowed Arno to commit his acts of industrial espionage so the sub-coding for the neural inhibitors permeated his tech as well. Tony had also tried to acquire Mobairu Yōsai Mechaniks to prevent the internal work of Kiri's armors, and the powerful mainframe that Stark couldn't get into, from getting to Technopolis' inhabitants.{{r|Armor Wars Vol 1 5}} He covered his true intentions by claiming he wanted to protect Kiri from Arno.{{r|Armor Wars Vol 1 1}}

The latest victim of Baron Stark's measures to keep the truth hidden was [[Peter Urich (Earth-12311)|Peter Urich]], the vigilante known as [[Spider-Man|Spyder-Man]]. A special "spyder virus" that had infected his armor and granted him extraordinary abilities was able to withstand and override the neural inhibitors, so when he started investigating the death of his father Ben, he ultimately stumbled across the truth.{{r|Armor Wars Vol 1 5}}

After discovering Arno was involved in industrial espionage against Kiri, Tony confronted him in his headquarters. While Tony blasted Arno out of his building, the two brothers engaged in a civil and friendly conversation.{{r|Armor Wars Vol 1 3}} Tony reassured that it was important for Kiri to stay alive, as her technology could be relevant to keeping Howard's secret.{{r|Armor Wars Vol 1 5}}

Tony an Arno made a temporary alliance after the [[Thor]] of [[Technopolis]] and Grand Marshal [[James Rhodes (Earth-12311)|Jim Rhodes]] started investigating Spyder-Man's murder and discovered the truth. While Arno kept the [[War Machine Deputies (Earth-12311)|War Machine Deputies]] neutralized, Tony killed Rhodes. However, the truth still got out because Rhodes had been transmitting his confrontation with Tony to his niece [[Lila Rhodes (Earth-12311)|Lila]], who was friends with Kiri. Kiri and Lila decided to stop the Stark brothers once and for all, and deployed two giant mechas to confront them.{{r|Armor Wars Vol 1 4}}

A battle of gigantic proportions took place in the streets of Technopolis between the Stark brothers and Kiri and Lila. While Stark revealed the truth to Kiri, she had been using the fight as a misdirection to distract the Starks from a virus she had entered into their suits, and ultimately shut them down. Some time later, the [[Thors (Earth-15513)|Thors]] arrived to the scene to take care of the Stark brothers, and dispatched them in the name of [[Victor von Doom (Earth-616)|Doom]].{{r|Armor Wars Vol 1 5}}

===Origin===
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-13122) from LEGO Marvel's Avengers 002.png|thumb|left|10x|Mark I]]
Tony was an irresponsible arms dealer until he was kidnapped by terrorists who used his weapons. Tony managed to create his [[Iron Man Armor MK I (Earth-199999)|first armor]] and successfully escape from captivity. The armor became Tony's life support, as its [[Arc Reactor|energy source]] also serves to prevent shrapnel in his body from reaching his heart, causing Tony and the armor to be linked. Returning home, he realized the cost of his weapons [[Stark Industries (Earth-13122)|company]]'s success in the world and decided to use the armor for good as [[Iron Man]].{{r|LEGO Marvel Super Heroes 2}}

Tony faced [[Obadiah Stane (Earth-13122)|Iron Monger]], meeting [[Natalia Romanova (Earth-13122)|Natalia Romanova]], [[Nicholas Fury Jr. (Earth-13122)|Nick Fury]], and [[Phillip Coulson (Earth-13122)|Phil Coulson]] in that clash.{{r|LEGO Marvel's Avengers}}{{r|LEGO Marvel Avengers: Time Twisted}} Tony was also considered for the Avengers Initiative, but was withdrawn due to his unpredictable nature.{{r|LEGO Marvel's Avengers}}

=== Chitauri Invasion ===
==== Revisiting the initiative ====
After finishing a project with [[Just A Rather Very Intelligent System (Earth-13122)|J.A.R.V.I.S.]] to install clean energy in [[Stark Tower]], Tony was informed by J.A.R.V.I.S. that he was being contacted by Agent Phil Coulson of [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-13122)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]]. Coulson eventually made his way in despite Stark's attempts to lock him out of the system, informing Stark of a revival of the Avengers Initiative, presenting Stark with footage of [[Bruce Banner (Earth-13122)|Hulk]], [[Steven Rogers (Earth-13122)|Captain America]], and [[Thor Odinson (Earth-13122)|Thor]]. Pepper took a flight out to [[Washington, D.C.|Washington D.C.]], while Tony  set out to review the footage Coulson had presented him.

==== Ambush in Germany ====
Later, when Struttgard, Germany was attacked by [[Loki Laufeyson (Earth-13122)|Loki]], Iron Man made a theatrical surprise entrance, teaming up with [[Steven Rogers (Earth-13122)|Captain America]] to take Loki down. Steve and Iron Man sparred with Loki, Loki able to gain backup through mind controlled agents and his powers of illusion, until the heroes were able to capture him.However, while escorting him to the Quinjet, [[Thor Odinson (Earth-13122)|Thor]] arrived, stealing Loki from them to discuss personal matters, Iron Man and Cap pursued the God of Thunder, eventually resulting in Iron Man antagonizing Thor and him fighting the two. The skirmish escalated throughout the Forest, the duo assembling gadgets to stop Thor as he reigned thunder from the skies. This continued until Thor attacked [[Captain America's Shield]] with his [[Mjolnir]], the three realising they were at an impasse and resolved to bring Loki into the [[S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier|Helicarrier]].

==== Attack on the Helicarrier ====
On the Helicarrier, Tony began tracking the Tesseract with [[Bruce Banner (Earth-13122)|Bruce Banner]] while running an encryption programme on S.H.I.E.L.D.'s files, being interrupted by Steve, informing the group of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s plans to make weapons of mass destruction with the Tesseract, leading to an argument between them, Thor, Black Widow and Nick Fury. The group were then interrupted by the Hellicarrier being by a group of brainwashed S.H.I.E.L.D. agents led by [[Clinton Barton (Earth-13122)|Hawkeye]], separating the group. Due to the damage sustained to the propellers, Tony donned the [[Iron Man Armor MK VI (Earth-199999)|MK VI Armor]] and rendezvoused with Captain America to fix engine 3; making their way there whilst fighting their way through brainwashed S.H.I.E.L.D. agents. While Captain America inspected the relay, Iron Man decided to push the propeller blades manually using his Iron Man suit's flight capabilities, successfully restarting the propeller. Upon regrouping on the Helicarrier bridge, they learned of [[Phillip Coulson (Earth-13122)|Phil Coulson]]'s incipacitation and [[Loki Laufeyson (Earth-13122)|Loki]]'s escape. Deceived by Fury into thinking Coulson dead, Tony left the briefing and had a heart to heart with Captain America. This conversation led to Tony figuring out that Loki must be in [[Stark Tower]] due to his sense of ego and theatrics. Tony, along with the other scattered heroes, began to prepare for the upcoming battle, with Tony repairing his Iron Man armor.

==== Avengers Assembled ====
After finding equipment for Hawkeye, who had recently been freed from Loki's mind control, Tony made his way to New York City. Going to Stark Tower, Tony found J.A.R.V.I.S. unable to disable the portal device, Tony made his way inside and begun threatening Loki while the [[Iron Man Armor MK VII (Earth-199999)|MK VII]] readied for deployment. This exchange concluded when Loki tried to corrupt Tony with his scepter, only for him to throw Tony out of the Stark Tower window when this didn't work. The MK VII saved Tony, deploying and wrapping around him as he fell and readying him for battle, leading Iron Man to begin fighting the [[Chitauri]] fleet that begun appearing in New York. As Captain America, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Thor acted on the ground to keep the army's attention on them, Iron Man provided air support and examined the [[Leviathans (Chitauri)|Leviathans]], only able to destroy one upon the arrival of Bruce Banner, who used his Hulk form to incapacitate the beast, allowing Tony to target its weak points. 

==== Triumph in New York ====
With the [[Avengers (Earth-13122)|Avengers]] now assmbled, Loki sent the rest of the Chitauri army through the portal. Captain America took charge, instructing Tony Stark to enforce a perimeter around the city. In the ensuing battle, Nick warned Tony that a missile was headed for New York, Tony grabbing the Nuke and redirecting it to the portal from which the Chitauris came and blew up their mothership, causing most of the Chitauri to die. Managing to fall just as Natasha closed the portal with Loki's scepter, Hulk caught Tony as he landed, giving him the kiss of life and reviving him. With the world largely heralding them as heroes, the Tesseract and Loki were returned to Asgard, while the Avengers went to get food at Shawarma palace. {{r|LEGO Marvel's Avengers}}

=== Cosmic Brick Crisis ===
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-13122) from LEGO Marvel Super Heroes 0001.png|thumb|left|10x|Mark VI]]
Pursuing the [[Norrin Radd (Earth-13122)|Silver Surfer]] who had recently landed on Earth, Silver Surfer's board was shattered by a [[Doomjet|ship]] hired by [[Victor von Doom (Earth-13122)|Doctor Doom]], injuring Silver Surfer in the process and causing many "Cosmic Bricks" to splinter from the board.

==== Grand Central Station Assault ====
Iron Man and [[Bruce Banner (Earth-13122)|Hulk]] were sent to deal with [[William Baker (Earth-13122)|Sandman]] and [[Emil Blonsky (Earth-13122)|Abomination]] who had taken it hostage. The two worked their way through the nearby roads, leading to a fistfight with Hulk and Abomination which resulted in Abomination being incapacitated. Entering the bank, Iron Man and Hulk made their way past Sandman's defences, eventually causing Sandman to retaliate and take the form of a sandstorm, attacking [[Stark Tower|Avengers Tower]]. Running into [[Peter Parker (Earth-13122)|Spider-Man]], the trio were able to incapacitate Sandman by solidifying his form with a combination of water and cement. As the two supervillains were taken into custody, [[Nicholas Fury Jr. (Earth-13122)|Nick Fury]] told Iron Man to go back to [[Stark Tower]] and do more research on the mysterious "cosmic bricks". 

==== Emergency at The Raft ====
Having researched Silver Surfer with Hulk, Tony found him to be heavily connected to the Power Cosmic energy and tracked his power signature to [[Latveria]]. Suddenly, a break-in at the raft occurred, with Fury sending Tony and Hulk to take care of it. The two took a ferry to the [[Raft]] after helping said Ferry's captain and entered the Raft. There they met [[James Howlett (Earth-13122)|Wolverine]], who had tracked [[Victor Creed (Earth-13122)|Sabretooth]] to this location. The prisoners were subsequently freed by Sabretooth and [[Raven Darkhölme (Earth-13122)|Mystique]], leading the three to investigate the Raft further. Entering the Raft's inner area, the trio encountered the newly freed [[Ivan Vanko (Whiplash) (Earth-13122)|Whiplash]] and [[Samuel Sterns (Earth-13122)|Leader]]. The trio made quick work of the Leader, destroying his forcefield and using teamwork to bypass his mind control powers. Finding Sabretooth at a Chamber room, Sabretooth was able to free various high threat inmates, including [[Cletus Kasady (Earth-13122)|Carnage]], [[Johann Shmidt (Earth-13122)|Red Skull]], [[Aleksei Sytsevich (Earth-13122)|Rhino]], [[Stan Lee (Earth-13122)|Stan Lee]], and [[Eric Lensherr (Earth-13122)|Magneto]]. Magneto used his powers to pull Iron Man's MK 6 suit apart, putting him out of the proceedings. After Hulk and Wolverine defeated Abomination and Sabretooth, the three split up, with Tony joining [[Steven Rogers (Earth-13122)|Captain America]] to put him in a new Iron Suit.

==== Break-In at Stark Tower ====
After entering Stark Tower through unconventional means the two found that J.A.R.V.I.S. had been reprogrammed against them, with the entire building going into security lockdown. Due to this setback Tony planned to use the MK 1 suit, the only one not connected to the mainframe. Upon entering the MK 1 armor the two encountered [[Aldrich Killian (Earth-13122)|Aldrich Killian]] flanked by a group of [[Extremis]] soldiers. The two worked their way up to J.A.R.V.I.S.' mainframe where they were able to restore his programming, allowing Tony to use his latest invention: the MK 42. Confronting Killian, the two found him working with [[Mandarin (Earth-13122)|Mandarin]] and [[Loki Laufeyson (Earth-13122)|Loki]], with the three working together to steal Tony's Arc Reactors. As Loki teleported away, Tony and Cap confronted the villains on Stark Tower rooftops. Eventually, they were able to incapacitate Killian, forcing Mandarin into the Hulkbuster armor. With the use of the House Party Protocol and an EMP, Iron Man & Captain America were able to disable the Hulkbuster suit and bring The Mandarin into capture. Afterwards, Tony reported back to Nick Fury, making sure to demagnetize any suits should he encounter Magneto again.

==== A Trip to the Ocean ====
Tracking Loki and Doom to the Ocean, Tony and [[Thor Odinson (Earth-13122)|Thor]] were assigned to a S.H.I.E.L.D. research sub to help track them. There they found the research sub had been taken hostage by an [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-13122)|A.I.M.]] sub. After Iron Man took out the external weapons, the two were met by Spider-Man and made their way broke into the A.I.M. sub. Fighting their way through various A.I.M. Agents, the thee were faced with Doctor Doom. Following him, they were ambushed by [[George Tarleton (Earth-13122)|M.O.D.O.K.]] who they defeated M.O.D.O.K. as a result of him overloading his power. After M.O.D.O.K. was defeated, Doom fled in the stolen S.H.I.E.L.D. research sub. The A.I.M. ship then began to break down and sink. The three were rescued, however, when [[Jean Grey (Earth-13122)|Jean Grey]] arrived, immersing them in a protective forcefield. The four made their way to the stolen research sub, which was lodged on an ocean cliff due to falling debris, as Iron Man, Thor and Spider-Man protecting Jean from oncoming [[Doombot]]s. Reaching the sub and making their way inside, they confronted Doctor Doom, Thor knocking him unconscious with Mjolnir and dislodging the ship in the process. Doom was not brought into S.H.I.E.L.D. custody, however, as Magneto then rescued him by controlling the [[Statue of Liberty]].

==== Battle with Magneto ====
Breaking out of the submarine, Jean left the three to report back to Xavier. Meanwhile Tony was briefed by Fury about Magneto's new ship, Asteroid M, with the three resolving to stop it. After Tony and Peter uncovered the Stark Jet, the three arrived at Asteroid M's hangar, where they were greeted by Magneto who locked them in the room with a group of Acolytes. Utilizing the airlock to blow the door open, the three pursued Magneto. Chasing Magneto throughout the Asteroid, they eventually confronted him. Magneto proved a worthy opponent, fashioning a metal Avatar for himself and throwing all manner of objects at them. Despite this, however, the heroes were able to defeat Magneto by fashioning large objects out of debris and destroying his avatar, then defeating him in regular combat, launching Magneto back to Earth afterwards. 

==== Battle on Asteroid M ====
The three then confronted Doom and Loki. Being supercharged by Loki's scepter, Doom blasted the three, knocking Iron Man and Thor back into the lower areas. Eventually, Iron Man and Thor were able to reach Loki and the other heroes after Doom had been defeated. From here, Loki revealed his master plan, use the Doom Ray to take control of Galactus and have it devour Earth and Asgard. Loki demonstrated this, having Galactus destroy Asteroid M, causing the 6 heroes to crash-land on the Helicarrier.

==== Last Stand on the Helicarrier ====
Faced with the threat of global annihilation, Tony and [[Reed Richards (Earth-13122)|Reed Richards]] came up with a new plan, team up with the various villains Loki had hired due to their shared interest in protecting the earth. Fury followed this plan, having Iron Man and Thor meet up with Magneto and Abomination and brief them on the mission. Upon assembling the group, Iron Man was assigned on 'Team Two' with Abomination, [[Jonathan Storm (Earth-13122)|Human Torch]] and [[Edward Brock (Earth-13122)|Venom]]. Through the use of Venom's webbing and Iron Man's Thrusters, Team Two were able to redirect the Helicarrier's rotor blasts towards Galactus. Eventually, the earth was saved, with Team Three summoning a Black Hole and Team Four knocking Galactus and Loki into it. As per Fury and Doom's earlier agreement, the villains were given a thirty second head-start to escape, an idea that was unintentionally sabotaged by Hulk's inability to count to three, allowing the villains to escape.{{r|LEGO Marvel Super Heroes}}

=== Afterparty at Stark Tower ===
Celebrating their victory over Galactus, Tony held a party which the guests found lifeless and boring. With the help of [[James Rhodes (Earth-13122)|Rhodey]], Tony was able to bring life to the party by creating a DJ table for Fury to operate, activating a disco ball and fixing a speaker that Hulk broke. Eventually, they made the finishing touches through a remote controlled Iron Patriot suit, able to begin a three-way dance routine which proved a crowd-pleaser.{{r|LEGO Marvel Super Heroes}}

=== Face-Off at the Bank ===
Upon a Bank in the Downtown Financial District being attacked by [[Maxwell Dillon (Earth-13122)|Electro]] and [[Herman Schultz (Earth-13122)|Shocker]], Iron Man went to the scene in a repaired MK VI suit with Captain America and Spider-Man. After Spider-Man knocked Shocker into a bank vault Electro was able to protect himself by electrifying the water in the bank. After the heroes rescued nearby civilians, Electro engaged them directly, the team quickly defeating him. They then opened the Bank vault, where they were able to defeat Shocker. Both villains were then taken into custody.{{r|LEGO Marvel Super Heroes}}

===Maximum Overload===
While Tony was at his [[Retreat (Tony Stark's Malibu Mansion)|mansion in Malibu]], the [[Trevor Slattery (Earth-13122)|Mandarin]] challenged him with his helicopter, Loki sees this and overloads the Mandarin with Nornfrost. The villain's supercharged abilities spread to his helicopter and he destroys Stark's mansion. Iron Man and Pepper Potts managed to escape the explosion, but Loki throws even more Nornfrost at the Mandarin. He fires rockets at the mansion again, burying Tony Stark in the rubble. Tony sends his armor's left hand after the Mandarin, knocking him out of the plane. After that, he and Pepper go out for lunch.{{r|LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Maximum Overload Season 1 3}}

Tony and [[Daniel Rand (Earth-13122)|Iron Fist]] go looking for Abomination on a speedboat, and when they see the Hulk and Abomination fighting on top of a plane and destroying it, they fly in and pick up the passengers. Hulk and Abomination crash land on a nearby oil drilling rig and continue their fight, Iron Man knocks Iron Fist onto the rig. After Abomination was defeated, Tony placed the passengers on the platform.{{r|LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Maximum Overload Season 1 4}} Tony returns to his mansion which had been repaired, but it was soon crushed by the Helicarrier which was shot down by the villains under Loki's control. Thor soon discovered that Loki was behind everything, so he, Tony and Spider-Man go to Loki's hideout and defeat the villain by making him free the villains from his control. After all, Tony reconstructed the mansion with the help of S.H.I.E.L.D.{{r|LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Maximum Overload Season 1 5}}

=== Killian Attacks ===
When the Mandarin started launching multiple terrorist attacks on [[United States of America|America]], one of these attacks resulted in Tony's friend [[Harold Hogan (Earth-13122)|Happy Hogan]] being injured. Afterwards, Tony publicly challenged the Mandarin. In response, helicopters were sent to Tony Stark's Malibu mansion, destroying it and stranding Tony in [[Tennessee (State)|Tennessee]]. There, he teamed up with [[Harley Keener (Earth-13122)|Harley Keener]], who helped him fix his damaged armor. Together, they took down [[Ellen Brandt (Earth-13122)|Ellen Brandt]]. Then, Tony travelled to [[Miami]], where he and Rhodey found out that the Mandarin was really [[Trevor Slattery (Earth-13122)|Trevor Slattery]], an actor hired by [[Aldrich Killian (Earth-13122)|Aldrich Killian]] as a public figure, taking the blame for explosions caused by [[Extremis (Virus)|Extremis]]-enhanced individuals. They also found out Killian had kidnapped [[Virginia Potts (Earth-13122)|Pepper Potts]] and injected her with Extremis, as well as the [[Matthew Ellis (Earth-13122)|president]]. The two then travelled to a [[Roxxon Corporation (Earth-13122)|Roxxon]] shipping yard, where they fought against Killian, with the help of Tony's House Party Protocol. In the end, Tony trapped Killian in his Mark 42 armor before commanding it to self-destruct, and Pepper finished him off. Afterward, Tony destroyed all of his armor.{{r|LEGO Marvel's Avengers}}

=== Age of Ultron ===
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-13122) from LEGO Marvel's Avengers 003.jpg|thumb|left|10x|MK XLIII]]
==== Sokovian Raid ====
After the fall of [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-13122)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]], Tony, along with the [[Avengers (Earth-13122)|Avengers]], started tracking down [[Hydra (Earth-13122)|Hydra]] bases across the world, trying to find [[Wolfgang von Strucker (Earth-13122)|Baron Wolfgang von Strucker]] and [[Loki's Scepter]]. Finally, they tracked him down to [[Sokovia]]. Iron Man worked with Hulk to work through Hydra's defenses, taking out one of their laser-shields. Afterwards, Tony begun probing the forcefield of Strucker's Castle whilst sending the Iron Legion to prevent civilian causalities. Tony was eventually able to disable the forcefield, allowing him and Captain America to assault it while the others tended to Hawkeye who had been injured by [[Pietro Maximoff (Earth-13122)|Quicksilver]], Tony taking out the airborne threats while Cap took out Hydra's cannons. After they worked their way through these forces, Tony entered the castle where he found Loki's scepter, only for [[Wanda Maximoff (Earth-13122)|Scarlet Witch]] to sneak behind him and create a nightmare in Tony's mind, where he saw the Avengers defeated during the Chitauri invasion. Once he woke up, Tony retrieved the scepter. 

==== Creation of Ultron ====
Heading back to Avengers Tower, Tony and Banner begun analyzing the scepter in an attempt to find what Strucker had used it for before Thor would send it back to Asgard. The scientists quickly considered the possibility that they could use the scepter to power and create [[Ultron (Earth-13122)|Ultron]], a peacekeeping program. With the help of [[Bruce Banner (Earth-13122)|Bruce Banner]], the two successfully powered Ultron up, though they were unaware of their success at the time. During the party at Avengers Tower, Tony Stark and [[Maria Hill (Earth-13122)|Maria Hill]] helped keep the guests entertained before each of the male Avengers tested their worthiness with [[Mjolnir]]. They were interrupted when a damaged [[Iron Legion (Earth-13122)|Iron Legion]] drone attacked the Avengers, [[Helen Cho (Earth-13122)|Helen Cho]] and Hill. Tony's efforts against the Legion initially seemed fruitless, but he was able to gain an upper hand after Hill, Hawkeye and Cap helped him retrieve his [[Iron Man Armor MK XLIII (Earth-199999)|MK 43 armor]]. Upon Ultron declaring his intentions, the extinction of the Avengers, Thor destroyed his makeshift body with [[Mjolnir]], though Ultron's consciousness managed to escape and his forces had successfully taken the sceptre.{{r|LEGO Marvel's Avengers}}

==== Hulk's Rampage in Johannesburg ====
The Avengers then tracked Ultron to [[Africa]], where he and the Maximoff twins retrieved [[Vibranium]] from [[Ulysses Klaue (Earth-13122)|Ulysses Klaue]]. The trio got into a fight with the Avengers, where Wanda used her powers to incapacitate [[Steven Rogers (Earth-13122)|Captain America]], [[Natalia Romanova (Earth-13122)|Black Widow]], and [[Thor Odinson (Earth-13122)|Thor]], as well as sending Hulk on a rampage. After chasing down Ultron and destroying his current body, Tony, in order to stop the Hulk, sent in the Hulkbuster armor to take him down. Afterwards, Tony and the Avengers travelled to [[Clinton Barton (Earth-13122)|Hawkeye]]'s family home to hide out. Nick Fury then appeared and offered his help to the Avengers, and together, they figured out Ultron's plan to force Helen Cho to build him a new body with the Cradle. As the other Avengers went to stop Ultron in [[South Korea]], Tony tried to find someone who had been trying to stop Ultron. In Korea, while Ultron was able to escape with Black Widow, the Avengers were able to retrieve the Cradle containing Ultron's body, along with the Maximoff twins, who betrayed Ultron. Tony and Banner then transferred J.A.R.V.I.S.'s mind, who he discovered was the one fighting Ultron, into the empty body. With Thor's help, the two powered the body up and J.A.R.V.I.S. was reborn as [[Vision (Earth-13122)|Vision]], powered by the [[Mind Stone]].{{r|LEGO Marvel's Avengers}}

==== Battle of Sokovia ====
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-13122) from LEGO Marvel's Avengers 001.png|thumb|right|5x|Mark XLV]]
Thanks to a message by the captured Black Widow, the Avengers found Ultron in Sokovia. Tony and Vision then encountered Ultron in the church, where Vision cuts Ultron out of the internet. In response, Ultron launched Sokovia into the sky, threatening to plummet it towards Earth and cause the extinction of humanity. The Avengers, with the help of S.H.I.E.L.D. and War Machine, evacuated the civilians. Tony and the Avengers then mounted their last stand at the church, preventing Ultron from dropping Sokovia, where Tony, Thor and Vision severely damaged Ultron. As the last of the civilians were evacuated, and Hulk destroying Ultron's prime body, Ultron, at the last minute, activated the device which plummeted Sokovia. Tony and Thor then destroyed Sokovia.{{r|LEGO Marvel's Avengers}}

===Masters of Evil===
Trying to stop the [[Masters of Evil (Earth-13122)|Masters of Evil]]'s plans, Tony faced the four villains together, but they soon destroyed his armor, leaving him incapacitated. Soon after, Tony recovered the armor, and together with the rest of the Avengers, managed to put an end to the Masters of Evil's plans.{{r|LEGO Marvel's Avengers}}

=== Kang's Invasion ===
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-13122) from LEGO Marvel Super Heroes 2 001.jpg|thumb|left|10x|Model Prime]]
==== Battle With Attuma ====
During a party at Avengers Mansion, Nick Fury called the Avengers to help out with criminal activity across the world. Tony and [[Carol Danvers (Earth-13122)|Captain Marvel]] headed into the [[Pacific Ocean]], where they found Roxxon funding an invasion attempt by [[Attuma (Earth-13122)|Attuma]]. Together, the two destroyed turbines powering the underwater base. However, while fighting Attuma, Tony's armor was severely damaged. As Tony and Carol returned to New York to rendezvous with the other Avengers, [[Nathaniel Richards (Kang) (Earth-13122)|Kang]] took [[Manhattan]] into [[Chronopolis]].

==== Knowhere ====
In Chronopolis, after the Avengers accidentally defeat [[Theodore Sallis (Earth-13122)|Man-Thing]], allowing Kang to bring Chronopolis into a single time zone, the Avengers received a message originating from [[Cosmo (Earth-13122)|Cosmo]] from [[Knowhere]]. After boosting the signal, Cosmo offered his help to the gathered heroes. With [[Henry Pym (Earth-13122)|Goliath]]'s help, Tony came up with the idea to bring Knowhere into Chronopolis. After gaining [[Heimdall (Earth-13122)|Heimdall]]'s help, Tony took Heimdall to Broadway as thanks. As the Avengers and [[Guardians of the Galaxy (Earth-13122)|Guardians of the Galaxy]] tried regather the scattered Nexus Fragments, Tony and Hank figured out a plan to use Knowhere's EMP to disable Kang's shield around his citadel. Finally, after the heroes had gathered the Nexus Fragments, Tony and Hank used the built machine to open a portal to bring in Knowhere. However, Kang, aware of their plans, sent [[Ego (Earth-13122)|Ego the Living Planet]] through instead. Working with Hank and [[Stephen Strange (Earth-13122)|Doctor Strange]], Ego was sent away and Knowhere brought into Chronopolis.

==== Bringing Down Damocles Base ====
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-13122) from LEGO Marvel Super Heroes 2 002.jpg|thumb|right|Mark XLVII]]
Travelling to Knowhere with [[Peter Quill (Earth-13122)|Star-Lord]] and Spider-Man, they used Knowhere's EMP to disable Kang's shield. However, before the [[Nova Corps (Earth-13122)|Nova Corps]] could destroy Kang's citadel, [[Damocles Base]] destroyed all their starfighters. In response, Tony, Star-Lord and Spider-Man snuck into Damocles Base in order to destroy it. Once inside, the three faced a hologram of Kang, who told them he had ordered Damocles Base to plummet to the ground, before sending [[Michael Korvac (Earth-13122)|Korvac]] to delay their escape. The trio defeated Korvac and escaped just before Damocles Base crashed into the ground.

==== Final Battle ====
As a group of heroes infiltrated Kang's citadel, Tony fought with the others outside against Kang's forces, before meeting with the other heroes inside. There, he witnessed [[Ravonna Renslayer (Earth-13122)|Ravonna]] betray Kang, using the [[Forever Crystal]] to turn him into a baby.{{r|LEGO Marvel Super Heroes 2}}

==== Terminatrix ====
After everything was restored, Tony, Steve and Carol were approached by Ravonna, now called Terminatrix, along with Cosmo, Man-Thing, an elderly Kang and the [[Supreme Intelligence (Earth-13122)|Supreme Intelligence]], warning them of an incoming threat.{{r|LEGO Marvel Super Heroes 2}}

=== Climate Conundrum === 
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-13122) from LEGO Marvel Avengers Time Twisted 001.jpg|thumb|left|10x|Iconic Armor]]
Stark showed off a [[Stark Weather Machine|weather machine]] which can control the weather at the first annual "Environmental Atmosphere Awareness and Global Pollution Clean-up Coalition Conference". Some [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-13122)|A.I.M.]] Agents working for [[Johann Shmidt (Earth-13122)|Red Skull]]{{r|LEGO Marvel Avengers: Climate Conundrum Season 1 2}} steal the machine.{{r|LEGO Marvel Avengers: Climate Conundrum Season 1 1}} They make [[Justin Hammer (Earth-13122)|Justin Hammer]]'s machine he was showing off go haywire as a distraction so they can steal Stark's machine. Hammer blames Stark for hijacking his machine as a result of their disagreements in the past, but Tony says it wasn't him. A.I.M. makes a deal with Hammer that if he helps their cause, they'll improve his inventions in return so he can get revenge on Stark. Hammer accepts the deal, but soon realizes he's working for Red Skull who wants to destroy the world, so he helps Tony and other Avengers defeat A.I.M instead.{{r|LEGO Marvel Avengers: Climate Conundrum Season 1 2}} They all go to destroy the weather machine before Red Skull can use it to cause chaos.{{r|LEGO Marvel Avengers: Climate Conundrum Season 1 3}}{{r|LEGO Marvel Avengers: Climate Conundrum Season 1 4}} 

===Time Twisted===
After the Avengers discover that the Ant-Van was stolen by [[Thanos (Earth-13122)|Thanos]], Tony (using the [[Iron Man Armor MK VIII (Earth-TRN908)|Sakaraan Hulkbuster]]) and the rest of the group go to the island where the villain and his allies (Hydra, [[Obadiah Stane (Earth-91334)|Iron Monger]], and [[Ultron (Earth-78362)|Ultron]]) were and fight them to win the fight.{{r|LEGO Marvel Avengers: Time Twisted}}

Tony reminded them that they were the Avengers and they did not take days off. Later that evening, Tony was drinking eggnog in his armor and was visited by the ghost version of his friend [[Simon Williams (Earth-13155)|Wonder Man]]. He informed Tony that he would be visited by three spirits and then as soon as he left, [[Wade Wilson (Earth-13155)|Deadpool]] arrived in ghost form to take Tony on a ''{{WP|A Christmas Carol}}''-like journey to his past, present, and potential futures. Tony witnessed a moment between him and his [[Howard Stark (Earth-13155)|father]] at Christmas time where his dad stated that he would never give Tony his love or approval. Deadpool then took him to the present to see how the Avengers had been struggling since Tony forced them all to work. Tony didn't believe this to be his fault so Wade tried to take him to his future but ended up [[Earth-811|visiting]] [[Earth-TRN1281|multiple]] [[Earth-71912|alternate]] [[Earth-TRN1282|universes]] [[Earth-1218|instead]]. After getting tired of it all, Tony agreed to change his ways and was sent back to the present. After being filled with a sense of holiday cheer, he payed [[Henry Pym (Earth-13155)|Ant-Man]] to go and fetch him the largest goose he could find. Hank agreed and the Avengers celebrated the holidays together. Their celebration was cut short when one hour later the Skrulls had succeeded in their mission and blew up the Earth.{{r|Marvel Super Heroes: What The--?! Season 1 29}}

With the [[Avengers (Earth-13178)|Avengers]] fractured in two, Iron Man leads a team of heroes who believe in accountability and the greater good to track down and stop rogue led by his former friend, [[Steven Rogers (Earth-13178)|Captain America]].
