| History                 = 
'''Tony Stark''' grew up in the apocalyptic wasteland of an Earth conquered by the [[Johann Shmidt (Earth-21798)|Black Skull]] of the [[Masters of Evil (Multiverse)|Multiversal Masters of Evil]]. Disgusted with his father's coping mechanism of keeping his head down in an alcohol-fueled haze and his mother's distant "fairy tale" futurism, Stark took to obsessing over stories of the past, dedicating himself to studying ancient forgotten sciences and becoming the world's first archeologist. In his youth, Stark sought to relieve his loneliness by constructing his own friend, creating a robotic lifeform, [[Vision (Earth-21170)|Vision]], to accompany him. During his many adventures, Stark would uncover the remains of a [[Progenitor (Celestial) (Multiverse)|Celestial Head]] that he converted into a firearm attachment, and a miraculous size-changing particle which he dubbed [[Pym Particles|Stark Particles]], allowing him to explore greater depths and to fend off the Skull's forces as the resistance fighter dubbed '''Ant-Man'''.

At one point, Ant-Man was captured by the Wastelord's forces while looting the Temple of the Fist of [[Khonshu]]. Stark was tortured extensively until he broke and promised to build the Skull anything he wanted to make the suffering end- resulting in the creation of the [[War Machines (Earth-21170)|War Machines]], an elite force of mass produced, armored police force that extended the Skull's grip on the wasteland to a near inescapable degree. After some time working for the War Machines, Stark was eventually able to escape thanks to the intervention of Shellhead, the Iron Ant, a mechanical drone and protector Stark had built. Becoming the most wanted man on the planet in the escape, Stark teamed up with Vision, [[Benjamin Grimm (Earth-21170)|Infinity Thing]], [[Mariama Spector (Earth-21170)|Moon Knight]], and [[Simon Williams (Earth-21170)|Wonder Man]] to form a disparate resistance group to battle the Skull's control of the Wasteland.{{r|Avengers Forever Vol 2 1}}

===Becoming an Avenger===
Following up on another archeological lead, Ant-Man and Shellhead, uncovered the final resting place of [[Mjolnir]], the mythical war hammer of the All-Father, [[Odin Borson (Earth-21170)|Odin]]. While able to briefly lift the Hammer, Stark was quickly overwhelmed by its power and vowed not to try a second time, before shrinking it, and the piece of earth beneath it, down with his Stark Particles to safeguard. While his dig was quickly surrounded by War Machines, the armored units were called off when [[Roberto Reyes (Earth-616)|a Ghost Rider]], Robbie Reyes, arrived from across time and space- drawing them into a larger fight and providing Stark the cover he needed to return to his team with the hammer.{{r|Avengers Forever Vol 2 1}}

Agreeing that they needed to rescue the captured Ghost Rider and his [[Deathlok]] companion, Stark and his team devised a plan to break into the prison and make contact with the heroes. Ant-Man shrank down and was able to enter through the walls of the Ghost Rider's cell; only to be informed the Reyes and his Deathlok weren't interested in a rescue. Quickly changing gears, Stark shifted the rescue mission to instead support Reyes' plan to overthrow the Wastelord- while Wonder Man assaulted the War Machine garrison and Ghost Rider engaged the Black Skull one-on-one, Stark went sub-atomic, smaller than he had ever accomplished before, providing the wind-up running start to the "biggest punch in the history of the planet"- sprinting from sub-atomic to gigantic size and throwing all his momentum into a strike that left the Black Skull stunned long enough for Reyes to make his own move- using his newfound powers to pilot the Symbiote, stripping it from the Skull and finally defeating him.{{r|Avengers Forever Vol 2 3}}

Any celebration of victory was short-lived, as the defeat of the Black Skull caused a coalition of the Masters of Evil's [[Red Skull]] variants to pour through the dimensional portal, having declared that whoever killed the Avengers and remained last Skull standing would take the original's place as the new Wastelord. Before the Skulls could overwhelm Ant-Man and his allies, the battle was joined by another third party, the [[Goddesses of Thunder (Earth-14412)|Goddesses of Thunder]], descendants of Odin whose own Mjolnir was called forth by the Mjolnir Stark had previously released. The Goddesses quickly tipped the scales in the resistance's favor, and Stark and his allies were able to repel the Skulls back into their portals and return them to their home dimensions. After supervising the complete destruction of the War Machines, Stark found that learned that the Masters of Evil were still out there planning to do to countless more worlds what they had done to his own. No longer feeling satisfied with saving only his own world, Stark chose to get into Reyes' [[Hell Charger]] and join the Ghost Rider and Deathlok on their odyssey across the multiverse, planning to stop the Masters of Evil one Earth at a time.{{r|Avengers Forever Vol 2 4}}

Stark would later help recruit various Avengers throughout the Multiverse. He fought with the other Avengers to fight against the [[Council of Red (Multiverse)|Council of Red]] when the attacked [[Avengers Tower (God Quarry)|Avengers Tower]].{{r|Avengers Forever Vol 2 12}}

| Powers                  = '''[[Pym Particles|Stark Particles]]:''' Ant-Man carried a supply of Stark Particles throughout his suit, allowing him to reduce himself to sizes even smaller than an atom, or grow to gargantuan sizes. His control over the Stark Particles also allows him to disperse this effect on other targets, including his allies or enemies, as well as objects from his archeological digs, as well as allowing him to carry an arsenal of gadgets and tools at incredibly small sizes. 
| Abilities               = '''Marksmanship:''' Stark fights primarily with pistols, with which he shows an affinity. 
| Weaknesses              = 

| Equipment               = 
* '''[[Ant-Man's Suit]]:''' Ant-Man goes into battle wearing a high-tech suit of armor that includes a [[Ant-Man's Helmet|retractable helmet]] with numerous built-in HUD features, jet boots capable of flight and storage for his arsenal of shrunk down weaponry and gadgets. 
| Transportation          = 
* '''Shellhead:''' Serving as both transportation and bodyguard, Shellhead the Iron Ant is a mechanical drone constructed by Stark and operated separately by an artificial intelligence, allowing Ant-Man and Shellhead to operate independently in combat. The mechanical ant is capable of flight, relic storage and contains a number of excavation tools, making it a vital part of Ant-Man's archeological work as well as a combat tool or form of transportation. 
| Weapons                 = 
* '''[[Progenitor (Celestial) (Multiverse)|Knowhere Gun]]:''' The severed head of a Celestial discovered by Stark on one of his digs, the Knowhere Gun has decayed and lost nearly all of its sentience and power; but still releases an incredibly damaging barrage of energy when the skull begins to scream. Weaponizing this, Stark carries the shrank down head in his arsenal, and has tinkered with it to form an attachment to his pistol, allowing him to fire the Celestial's waves with the pull of a trigger.

| History                 = Little was detailed about Iron Man's life before the zombie plague arrived on [[Earth-2149]], however it can be presumed that it followed much the same path as his [[Earth-616]] [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|counterpart]].

Iron Man was at [[Avengers Mansion]] when [[Ashley J. Williams (Earth-818793)|Ash]] tried to blast his way into the Mansion. He and the other [[Avengers (Earth-2149)|Avengers]] greeted Ash and demanded he explain himself. The man began ranting about an Army of the Dead and began to get a little hot under the collar.[[Wanda Maximoff (Earth-2149)|Scarlet Witch]] spirited him away.{{r|Marvel Zombies/Army of Darkness Vol 1 1}}

Presumably, those remaining at the Avengers Mansion after [[Steven Rogers (Earth-2149)|Col. America]] and the others left to investigate reports of purple lightning and something fallen from the sky received a call from [[Nicholas Fury (Earth-2149)|Nick Fury]] to join the resistance aboard the [[Strategic Hazard Intervention Espionage Logistics Directorate (Earth-2149)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] [[S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier|Helicarrier]], and left to join them.

While a team was dispatched back to the surface, Iron Man and a few of the others stayed behind to try and work out how exactly to stop this thing. Tony showed Nick Fury a teleportation device he had been working on. Unfortunately, he explained, it could only work with a similar device in the destination dimension, and so it would need coordination with the reality in order to escape. Just then, the zombified [[Fantastic Four (Earth-2149)|Fantastic Four]] burst into the lab and attacked the un-armored Stark. Before he could put on his Iron Man armour he was bitten. Reed then told the others to collect the pieces of the transporter and started moving it to the [[Baxter Building]].{{r|Marvel Zombies: Dead Days Vol 1 1}}

When [[Henry McCoy (Earth-2149)|Beast]] and [[Reed Richards (Earth-2149)|Reed Richards]] found a sizeable stash of meat in [[Latveria]] and the surrounding area, Iron Man and a huge horde of zombies headed off to lay siege to [[Castle Doom (Doomstadt)|Castle Doomstadt]]. Unable to gain access to the fortress, presumably, Luke got held up by the risen Deadite Legion, and at some point, he returned to [[New York City|New York]].

In New York, the [[Norrin Radd (Earth-2149)|Silver Surfer]] appeared in the sky above them, and Stark led the charge against him, managing to score some effective blows despite the Surfer blasting his legs off. With the Herald of Galactus down, [[Bruce Banner (Earth-2149)|Hulk]] managed to bite his head off, and Rogers, Stark, [[Peter Parker (Earth-2149)|Parker]], Pym, Cage, and [[James Howlett (Earth-2149)|Wolverine]] managed to get a piece in them at the expense of the rest of the zombies. Realizing they had somehow been imbued with the [[Power Cosmic]], the seven newly [[Power Cosmic Zombies (Earth-2149)|Power Cosmic Zombies]] fried the masses of zombies gathered around them in a fruitless attempt to improve their flavor.

Suddenly, looming over them appeared [[Galan (Earth-2149)|Galactus]], who had come to devour their world. They attacked him with the Power Cosmic, but he repelled them with his much greater power. They retreated to Pym's lab and formulated a plan for bringing down the giant being. With the last sheets of [[Vibranium]] from [[Wakanda]], the Power Cosmic Zombies built a gun-like contraption which combined all of their individual beams of Power Cosmic into one super strong beam. While moving the weapon into position, they noticed that a group of zombified super-villains were attacking Galactus but having little effect. The Power Cosmic Zombies took their first shot, but it took another to put him down.

At this point, the heroes and the villains faced off for who would devour him. Stark and his group were victorious and were tucking into the World Devourer's body quickly before he could get up. Suddenly, the bodies of the zombie Fantastic Four dropped into the street closely followed by a miraculously uninfected [[Victor van Damme (Earth-1610)|Dr. Doom]]. After they tried to attack the ultimate Dr. Doom, they used the power cosmic granted by Galactus to travel through the cosmos and eat other life forms.{{r|Marvel Zombies Vol 1 3|5}}{{r|Ultimate Fantastic Four Vol 1 32}}

===Skrull World===
After travelling through the cosmos devouring planets as they went, the [[Zombie Galacti (Earth-2149)|Zombie Galacti]] arrived at the [[Tarnax IV|Skrull home planet]]. Wolverine ripped through the defensive field with his claws, and the Galacti squeezed through. Like many civilizations before them, the [[Deviant Skrulls|Skrulls]] tried to defend themselves by firing missiles at them, but the zombified heroes destroyed them easily with the Power Cosmic.

On reaching the planet surface, Tony and Luke first came across some kind of bug, and they attacked that, then turned to gorge on the Skrull populace. With most of the Skrulls on the ground devoured, the Zombie Galacti concentrated on the Skrull Warships circling them. Iron Man and the other Zombie Galacti penetrated the hulls of the warships and feasted on the delights within.

The Zombie Galacti traveled in search for and to devour Skrulls in the city itself. Iron Man consumed a Skrull General and Sergeant, who were running from Wolverine. They seemed unstoppable, but chasing after a group of Skrulls they ran into the bug they met when they first arrived. This time, however, it had been zombified and ate some of the Skrulls. The zombified heroes attacked but the bug punched them into the side of a building far away. They decided to eat some more, before they attacked again.

Cage finally rejoined the rest of the Zombie Galacti, where they quickly returned to bickering and arguing. Stark lost his temper and tried to blast Cage with a bolt of Power Cosmic, but it had no effect on a similarly powered being. Luke simply walked up to Stark and punched him high through the air.

Iron Man rejoined his compatriots, and they confronted the New [[Fantastic Four (Earth-616)|Fantastic Four]] in a crashed Skrull ship, and demanded that they hand over the Transdimensional device that they had been using. Wolverine decided instead to search the Skrull ship for any injured Skrulls to snack on, but only came across [[Thanos (Earth-2149)|Thanos]], and his mistress [[Death (Cosmic Entity)|Death]]. They offered the Zombies a reward for their destruction; an end to their undeadness. Though Spider-Man discovered that they were far from what they seemed. As the projections of Thanos and Death disappeared, the two Skrulls beneath begged for their lives.

With the last of the Skrulls eaten, the Zombie Galacti decided to explore the Galactus element to their powers, and began to consume the planet, eventually leaving themselves floating in space.{{r|Black Panther Vol 4 27|30}}

===40 Years Later===
At the edge of the known universe, Tony and the other Zombie Galacti were joined by Thanos, [[Pyraeus Kril (Earth-2149)|Firelord]], [[Kallark (Earth-2149)|Gladiator]], and [[Phoenix Force (Earth-2149)|Dark Phoenix]]. At some point in the previous forty years, Iron Man had reverted to his original costume and obtained a cybernetic lower body. Thanos also joined, but he was killed by an angered Hulk.

It seemed that they had consumed most of the universe and decided to make their way back to Earth in order to rebuild the teleportation device originally built by Stark. Along the way back to Earth, Tony and the other zombies stopped and devoured a living planet and continued their trek back to Earth.

Upon returning to Earth, Tony and the other zombies discovered a colony of human survivors in New York, now known as [[New York City|New Wakanda]]. After Giant Man declared a plan to create a breeding program to have food for eternity, Spider-Man and Luke Cage rebelled and fought Tony and the others. A force field was activated, protecting [[T'Challa (Earth-2149)|Black Panther]]'s stronghold and the survivors, but sealed Gladiator and an unconscious Bruce Banner inside and cut Cage in half. Gladiator got in a fight with Spider-Man and Cage, and was also attacked by someone in Tony's Mark I suit. After Gladiator was killed, Tony asked who was in the Mark I suit, and it was [[Forge (Earth-2149)|Forge]], who said that Stark International's doors were no longer closed and that he updated everything Tony ever did.

The zombies departed for the Baxter Building, where they discovered that Reed Richards' security devices were still activated, and they were attacked. After realizing Forge must have taken the teleporter, they returned to the force field, where they found [[Janet Van Dyne (Earth-2149)|Wasp]], Black Panther, Spider-Man, and Luke Cage (with a cybernetic lower half as well). Giant Man agreed to take the device only and not eat the survivors, but once the field was deactivated, the "good" zombies attacked the others. The force field was reactivated, but Tony found his way in. He promised that he wouldn't eat too much before getting the device and entered the stronghold.

While looking around, searching for survivors, he was intercepted by the [[T'Channa (Earth-2149)|new Colonel America]], Forge (in the Mark I suit), [[Malcolm Cortez (Earth-2149)|Malcolm Cortez]], and the [[Acolytes (Earth-2149)|Acolytes]]. After the force field was deactivated and the zombies got through, all of the other zombies realized that their hunger was gone. However, their moment of shock was cut short, as Bruce Banner awoke earlier (and inadvertently deactivated the force field) and became the Hulk. He broke through the wall and demanded to eat everything he could. Tony was one of the zombies that tried to stop the Hulk but was killed by the Hulk when he broke through Tony's armor.{{r|Marvel Zombies 2 Vol 1 1|5}}

They can {{Power|Energy Projection|channel}} beams of energy through their hands with great destructive force and {{Power|Teleportation|teleport}} through hyperspace; The distances which they can teleport is almost limitless.

| History                 = 
===Origins===
Possessing bottomless cash reserves and a brilliant intellect, Tony Stark knows all about privilege. He has the resources to turn any challenge into a success, thanks to his own mind and the wealth from his father's corporation. After a deadly bomb blast, he even transformed the shrapnel lodged in his chest and threatening his heart into a net-benefit; it pushed him to perfect not only his innovative Arc Reactor, but also a hi-tech suit of armor.

===The World of Spooky===
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-22145) from Marvel's Midnight Suns 004.jpg|thumb|left]]
After the return of [[Lilith (Earth-22145)|Lilith]], [[Stephen Strange (Earth-22145)|Doctor Strange]] and Iron Man went to see [[Johnathon Blaze (Earth-22145)|Johnny Blaze]] for the page of the [[Darkhold]] in his possession, but he refused to provide help. Tony received an urgent message from [[Bruce Banner (Earth-22145)|Bruce Banner]] warning of an imminent danger to the [[Sanctum Sanctorum]], prompting Strange to conjure a portal that transported them there. The Sanctum was attacked by [[Hydra (Earth-22145)|Hydra]] forces who got inside through a portal. Joined by [[Carol Danvers (Earth-22145)|Captain Marvel]], the heroes dealt with the minions, but when Lilith herself showed up, they could do nothing against her. Iron Man was placed by Lilith into a time stasis but the magic users just barely managed to push her back through the portal.{{r|Marvel's Midnight Suns}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-22145) from Marvel's Midnight Suns 006.jpg|thumb|right]]
Doctor Strange took Tony and Carol to the [[Abbey]], hidden inside a [[Pocket Dimension]] in [[Salem (Massachusetts)]]. The [[Avengers (Earth-22145)|Avengers]] were introduced to the [[Midnight Suns (Earth-22145)|Midnight Suns]] and the Caretaker, and watched as Sarah and Strange resurrected [[Hunter (Earth-22145)|Hunter]], Lilith's child and the only one to have ever defeated her. The Sanctum Sanctorum had been taken over by Lilith's Hydra forces, and Tony and the other Avengers joined the Midnight Suns in their fight against Lilith, while also making themselves a new home in the Abbey. Tony provided all others with access to the superhero-only "Superlink" social network of his own design and got to work at the Abbey's mystical Forge powered by an ancient Babylonian demon. He had to share his workspace with Stephen Strange whom Tony annoyed by calling him "Doctor Spooky". Being unfamiliar with magic, Tony was incredibly uncomfortable living and working in the place that was so rich with it, being afraid that life-threatening dangers were lurking and waiting for him at every turn. Nevertheless, he participated in the Shop Class organized by [[Roberto Reyes (Earth-22145)|Robbie Reyes]] and [[Peter Parker (Earth-22145)|Peter Parker]] and developed a friendship with the Hunter.{{r|Marvel's Midnight Suns}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-22145) from Marvel's Midnight Suns 008.jpg|thumb|left]]
When [[Bruce Banner (Earth-22145)|Bruce Banner]] alerted them that the [[Stark Tower|Avengers Tower]] was under the assault of [[Hydra (Earth-22145)|Hydra]], Iron Man responded personally, taking the Hunter with him. They observed [[Steven Rogers (Earth-22145)|Captain America]] engaged in combat with Hydra forces on the rooftop. A squadron of Hydra helicopters launched missiles at the Tower, and though Iron Man intercepted most of them, one missile got through, damaging the top floors. [[Brock Rumlow (Earth-22145)|Crossbones]] then descended to the rooftop and engaged the heroes in battle. After being defeated, Crossbones leapt from the Tower's edge onto a helicopter. Banner was hanging on the ladder, taunting the heroes and expressing gratitude for the [[Gamma Accelerator]] he took from the Tower, having fallen under Lilith's corrupting influence. Banner then triggered a series of explosions throughout Avengers Tower as the team narrowly escaped back to the Abbey. Tony was profoundly affected by Bruce's loss and troubled by his decision to prioritize a friend's life over potentially saving the world.{{r|Marvel's Midnight Suns}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-22145) from Marvel's Midnight Suns 007.jpg|thumb|right]]
To get back inside the Sanctum, Tony and Strange required a sample from the [[Venom (Symbiote) (Earth-22145)|Venom Symbiote]] to analyze how to protect Hunter from the reaction that had occurred during their last encounter. The sample analysis had succeeded, and Tony began working on an "anti-Venom" suit using the Symbiote sample. Carol was operating C.E.N.T.R.A.L. when peculiar errors featuring Latin text appeared, translated as "do not trust the horse, Trojans," which Tony recognized as an alert from one of his father [[Howard Stark (Earth-22145)|Howard]]'s security protocols indicating unauthorized access to a sensitive project. {{r|Marvel's Midnight Suns}}

===Destroying the Parchment===
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-22145) from Marvel's Midnight Suns 005.png|thumb|left]]
Iron Man and Hunter immediately departed for the location but quickly realizing that Banner had deliberately triggered the security protocol to lure them there. Banner attempted to persuade Tony to join him in completing Howard's work, but Tony declined. Banner fled, summoning a Dread Maiden. Iron Man apologized for his impulsiveness and proceeded to destroy his father's equipment to erasing the information within. Back at the Abbey, Iron Man explained that his father developed numerous powerful weapons but harbored a particular interest in [[Gamma Radiation]], dreaming of creating a [[Gamma Accelerator]], a device that would pose extreme danger if Banner succeeded in utilizing Howard's original plans to construct one. Tony revealed his belief that the Gamma Accelerator could potentially destroy the [[Parchment of Power]], prompting Doctor Strange to highlight the significant implication: destruction of the Parchment would render the Prophecy's fulfillment impossible. Tony was enthusiastic about the Gamma Accelerator's eventual recovery, while Doctor Strange expressed doubt regarding Tony's apocalypse-prevention plan, believing that only [[Chthon (Earth-22145)|Chthon]] could stop Chthon.{{r|Marvel's Midnight Suns}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-22145) from Marvel's Midnight Suns 010.jpg|thumb|right]]
Tony showcased the completed Gamma Accelerator and briefed the team on his strategy destroy the supposedly indestructible Parchment of Power with an enormous ray gun, despite Doctor Strange's continued objections that this was impossible. Tony explained that the [[Los Diablos Missile Base]] remained saturated with gamma radiation; he intended to utilize the Gamma Accelerator to absorb this radiation and supercharge it to power his Gamma Cannon, asking everyone present to assist in this undertaking. Though Johnny Blaze sacrificed himself to place the Parchment into the Cannon's blast, Banner leapt from the helicopter into the blast zone. A tremendous explosion cleared to reveal Fallen Hulk standing triumphantly with the Parchment clutched in his hand. Back at the Abbey, Steve and Tony engaged in a heated argument, with Steve attempting to convince Tony that after this catastrophic failure, he might need to consider others' perspectives and solutions, while Tony remained obstinate and insisted he alone could rectify the situation.{{r|Marvel's Midnight Suns}}

Iron man joined the others in the final confrontation with Lilith at the Temple of Chthon, which ended with the threat being dealt with, at the cost of losing Hunter to the [[Darkhold]].{{r|Marvel's Midnight Suns}}

The tragedy was witnessed through the [[Bridge|Bridge]] by the [[Illuminati (Earth-616)|Illuminati]] of [[Earth-616]], who were shocked to see what was headed towards them.{{r|New Avengers Vol 3 14}}

| History                 = [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-24223) from Aliens vs. Avengers Vol 1 2 001.jpg|thumb|left]]
Twenty years ago, an aging '''Tony Stark''' who was already using a wheelchair signed his company to be absorbed by [[w:c:AVP:Weyland Corp|Weyland Corp]]. He put up no resistance to this hostile takeover because he was playing possum, having deduced that the representatives of Weyland were not even from his universe. While signing the deal, Tony let them know that he was aware of their true nature and of the [[w:c:AVP:Xenomorph XX121 (Alien)|Xenomorphs]] that they were about to unleash on [[Earth-24223|his universe]]. Confident in their superiority and inevitable victory, [[w:c:AVP:Synthetic|Synthetic]] revealed that the seed of the [[Earth]]'s extinction would land in three years and nine months. Having learned his deadline, Tony revealed that he was not defenseless after all. He revealed that his wheelchair transformed into an [[Iron Man Armor]] and dispatched his attackers. He would go on to spend his remaining time constructing what would be the last fortress to hold against the Xenomorphs: an evacuation ship with an entire city built around it.{{r|Aliens vs. Avengers Vol 1 2}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-24223) from Aliens vs. Avengers Vol 1 2 002.jpg|thumb|right]]
The Xenomorphs landed on schedule and decimated all of the Earth's defenders. Twenty years after Tony learned of the planet's fate, only about 1,400 humans remained in the last human city on the planet. After losing [[Valeria Richards (Earth-24223)|Valeria Richards]] and having no contact from [[Clinton Barton (Earth-24223)|Barton]], [[Natalia Romanova (Earth-24223)|Romanoff]] or [[Steven Rogers (Earth-24223)|Rogers]], Tony declared them to be the last survivors of the human race and prepared to launch. [[Bruce Banner (Earth-24223)|Bruce Banner]] noted that there was not enough people left to avoid both extinction and genetic diseases, but Tony insisted that with the science at their disposal they would make it work. After the launch sequence was already initiated, they unexpectedly saw Captain America running towards the ship, with hundreds of survivors behind him. They were being chased by Xenomorphs and Stark could not risk saving those who could be saved. He proceeded with the launch, but at the last moment Banner leapt off the vessel to stay with the Captain.{{r|Aliens vs. Avengers Vol 1 2}}

The ship was damaged during the launch and had to stop at [[Mars (Planet)|Arakko]] for repairs. Tony, [[Carol Danvers (Earth-24223)|Carol Danvers]], and [[Miles Morales (Earth-24223)|Miles Morales]] went out and found the planet empty of [[Mutants (Homo superior)|Mutants]], with only [[Nathaniel Essex (Earth-24223)|Mr. Sinister]] to greet them. He revealed that he saw Xenomorphs as the ultimate pinnacle of evolution, at which point his other clones have attacked the evacuation ship which exploded minutes later.{{r|Aliens vs. Avengers Vol 1 3}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-24223) from Aliens vs. Avengers Vol 1 3 001.jpg|thumb|left]]
Tony and Miles got separated from Carol, and Tony prepared to unleash a blast when he was stabbed through his armor by a Xenomorph. With his last words, Tony asked to do what needed to be done. Miles was confused, but Tony wasn't talking to him but to his [[Venom (Symbiote) (Earth-24223)|symbiote]], who went inside Tony's mouth and bonded with the Xenomorph growing inside of him, emerging from his chest as a bigger and stronger Symbiote-Xenomorph hybrid.{{r|Aliens vs. Avengers Vol 1 4}}

A month later, the last surviving humans and mutants listened to the final message left by Tony, which urged them to avenge him and the other fallen.{{r|Aliens vs. Avengers Vol 1 4}}

| History                 = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-24331)|Tony Stark]] married [[Janet Van Dyne (Earth-24331)|Janet Van Dyne]], and together they had a son [[James Stark (Earth-24331)|James]].{{r|Avengers: Twilight Vol 1 1}} They were both among the hero responders on the "H-Day" when [[Ultron (Earth-24331)|Ultron]] seized control of [[Bruce Banner (Earth-24331)|the Hulk]] and unleashed him on the heroes. After both Hulk and Ultron were defeated, Tony realized that something bigger was coming, as the government cleanup crews were targeting both villains and heroes alike. Tony and Jan escaped the scene at [[Boston]], but had to get James out before they could leave further.{{r|Avengers: Twilight Vol 1 4}} Tony had a plan to get James and donned his [[Iron Man Armor]], but in case the planet did not work, Janet asked to be miniaturized and placed in stasis inside his ring. Knowing that the ring would be given to James as their personal possessions, she wanted to be close to him until the day he would find a way to free his mother.{{r|Avengers: Twilight Vol 1 6}}

Tony's plan was discovered and his armor was sabotaged to explode,{{r|Avengers: Twilight Vol 1 4}} he survived only as a disembodied head. Both Tony and Janet were pronounced dead, and James was being looked after by [[Edwin Jarvis (Earth-24331)|Jarvis]]' brother [[Johann Shmidt (Earth-24331)|Kyle]].{{r|Avengers: Twilight Vol 1 2}} Kyle was in fact none other than [[Johann Shmidt (Earth-24331)|Red Skull]] himself, a fact he revealed to Tony's head knowing that he could not do anything about it. Tony's head was taken to the [[Raft]] and occasionally probed for new new weapon designs by his son, Tony remained conscious but was unable to communicate anything. Over the next decades, "Jarvis" would gain more and more power through media control, transforming America into a surveillance police state.{{r|Avengers: Twilight Vol 1 2}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-24331) from Avengers Twilight Vol 1 4 001.jpg|thumb|left|Tony's head is reawakened]]
[[Steven Rogers (Earth-24331)|Captain America]] was convinced by [[Lucas Cage (Earth-24331)|Luke Cage]] to come out of retirement and reassemble the Avengers.{{r|Avengers: Twilight Vol 1 1}} Steve rescued Tony's head from the Raft and was joined by [[Thor Odinson (Earth-24331)|Thor]] and [[Kamala Khan (Earth-24331)|Ms. Marvel]]. Regrouping at the [[Defenders (Earth-24331)|Defenders]]' base, the heroes reactivated Tony's head, who revealed to them that the country has been run by the Red Skull. Tony's head was fitted onto a new robotic torso which them put on the [[Iron Man Armor]] once more. The Avengers officially assembled again for the raid on the [[Avengers Mansion]]. Their targets were the new generation of government-sponsored Avengers, but those were revealed to be digital fakeries created by the Red Skull. Tony managed to extract Red Skull's plans, learning that he already controlled the U.S. military and was executing a coup in Washington.{{r|Avengers: Twilight Vol 1 4}}

The Avengers rushed to stop the Red Skull. Tony burst into the Oval Office, but found the President already dead. Red Skull himself was enhanced with [[Ultron (Earth-24331)|Ultron]]-designed armor, proving a match for Tony. James had taken Red Skull's side in the coup, having been indoctrinated into his ideology over decades of building resentment towards his father. As Tony was engaged with Skull, the villain ordered a massive missile strike on [[Washington, D.C.]], causing Tony to break away and rush to intercept them. He was met by James in his own [[Iron Man Armor]] with a fleet of drones behind him. James tried to kill his father while Tony tried to get through to him, but also using that time to take over the remote control over the drone armors and send them to intercept the missiles. Furious, James threw Tony through the [[Washington Monument]], yelling that Red Skull would now resort to a nuclear option and blaming Tony for it.{{r|Avengers: Twilight Vol 1 5}} 

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-24331) from Avengers Twilight Vol 1 6 001.jpg|thumb|Tony in Valhalla]]
Tony's armor was down on the ground, and James removed parts of his armor to berate and cursing his father. At this point his ring reacted with Tony's armor, and Janet was released from her stasis, just in time to be alerted by Tony about the falling nuclear bomb which she managed to catch by growing to enormous in size. Red Skull fired a blast at Janet, which finally broke through to James. Tony and Janet embraced as James rushed to her side, but the reunion was cut short as their help was needed by Captain America in his fight with Skull. The three of them and [[Ramona Jones (Earth-24331)|Hawkeye]] combined their fire and were able to make an opening in Skull's armor which Rogers used to deliver a decisive blow. Even defeated, the Skull attempted to blow himself up along with the rest of the Avengers to take them to the grave with him. James grabbed him and shot upwards, seeking to make things right, but Tony easily caught up with his son and sent him back towards the ground. He managed to reach the upper atmosphere where Skull's bomb detonated with Tony as the only casualty.{{r|Avengers: Twilight Vol 1 6}}

After the victory over the Red Skull, Thor returned home to [[Asgard]]. He sent a raven to his father [[Odin Borson (Earth-24331)|Odin]], now residing in [[Valhalla]], asking him to bend the rules and accept Tony into Valhalla despite him being non-Asgardians. There, Tony was reunited with [[Bruce Banner (Earth-24331)|Bruce Banner]].{{r|Avengers: Twilight Vol 1 6}}

| History                 = ===Age of Revelation===
Following the outbreak of the [[X-Virus]], '''Iron Man''' and [[James Rhodes (Earth-25221)|War Machine]] continued operating out of the old [[Avengers Mansion]] in [[New York City]], using their sealed armors to keep themselves from being infected. Four years into the [[Age of Revelation]], they came into conflict with [[Douglas Ramsey (Earth-25221)|Revelation]]'s [[Seraphim (Earth-25221)|Seraphim]]: [[Marrow (Sarah) (Earth-25221)|Marrow]], [[Christian Cord (Earth-25221)|Phaser]], and [[Carmella Unuscione (Earth-25221)|Carmella Unuscione]], who sought to take a newly-revealed mutant [[Eris Vale (Earth-25221)|Eris]]. Aided by [[Emma Frost (Earth-25221)|Emma Frost]] and [[Angelica Jones (Earth-25221)|Firestar]], Iron Man and War Machine fought to stop the Seraphim from taking Eris and her mother. During the fight, Carmella Unuscione killed Eris's mother by destroying her respiratory mask. This triggered Eris' seismic powers, which killed Unuscione opened a massive sinkhole that swallowed the mansion. Firestar's powers exploded out of control, forcing Rhodes to extinguish her with suppression foam. Emma leapt between Marrow and Eris to shield the girl and took a bone dagger through the chest; she shifted into her diamond form to survive the wound and fell into the collapsing sinkhole, where she was crushed by falling rock. With no heartbeat to detect in her diamond form, Stark and Rhodes believed Emma dead and evacuated with Eris and Firestar.{{r|Iron & Frost Vol 1 1}}

===The Iron King===
[[Iron Man Armor Model 74]] had a filtration failure, which exposed Tony to X-Virus, fusing him with the armor into a being of living iron.{{r|Iron & Frost Vol 1 1}} Tony created a [[Anthony Stark (Augmented Reality Avatar) (Earth-25221)|backup copy of his personality]] before his own mind was pushed out by the new '''Iron King''' persona that operated on pure logic.{{r|Iron & Frost Vol 1 2}} Aided by Rhodes, who had adopted Eris, he reformed the [[Hellfire Club (Earth-25221)|Hellfire Club]] at the sunken [[Avengers Mansion]] and established a workshop laboratory to search for a cure to the X-Virus, sending War Machine out to gather the necessary supplies.{{r|Iron & Frost Vol 1 2}} Firestar, who never stopped going critical, was shrunken down with [[Pym Particles]] and used to power the Iron King's designs.{{r|Iron & Frost Vol 1 3}} 

Unbeknownst to them, Emma had clawed her way back to the surface, but with a hole in her chest was unable to return to her mortal form and thus use her telepathy. After six years, she returned to the sinkhole to ask Tony for help, only to find the Iron King.{{r|Iron & Frost Vol 1 1}} Rhodes returned from another mission but was pursued by Phaser. The Iron King killed him, but not before Phaser damaged [[War Machine Armor]], triggering Rhodes' own transformation. He was uncontrollably projecting energy, and Iron King prepared to euthanize him but was stopped by Eris, who injected her adopted father with Iron King's experimental [[Extremis]]-based formula that briefly stabilized Rhodes. He lasted long enough to bring Emma up to speed before his mutation began spreading again, and Iron King had him executed.{{r|Iron & Frost Vol 1 2}}

The power discharged by Rhodes disabled to containment system, released other mutants inside Iron King's laboratory. It moved to neutralize them, while his [[Anthony Stark (Augmented Reality Avatar) (Earth-25221)|Augmented Reality Avatar]] wrapped Emma in the [[War Machine Armor]] to speak to her directly. His operation falling apart, Iron King prepared to neutralize everything, his systems building toward a catastrophic detonation. Eris and the Virtual Tony activated their last Hail Mary by sending a signal into the past to try and prevent their future. But it required longer time that was allowed by Iron King's countdown, so Emma used the [[War Machine Armor]] to grab the Iron King and fly him upwards into the sky. Shifting out of her diamond state to use her telepathy one last time, she reached out to Ton underneath the Iron King persona before dying of her chest wound. Tony briefly re-emerged, but Iron King quickly reasserted control. Firestar then finally detonated within him, ending them both.{{r|Iron & Frost Vol 1 3}}

| First                   = X-Universe Vol 1 1

| History                 = As a saboteur against the forces of [[En Sabah Nur (Earth-295)|Apocalypse]], Tony Stark fell victim to one of his own weapons and suffered a serious wound to his heart. With his mechanical expertise he managed to construct a mechanical heart to replace his injured biological one.{{r|X-Universe Vol 1 2}} Following Apocalypse's takeover of North America, Stark fled to Europe and became associated with the [[Human High Council (Earth-295)|Human High Council]], the government body that ruled over the remaining human population in Europe and Asia, likely providing his technological expertise to their cause. 

The human population grew into a frenzy due to the manipulations of [[Mikhail Rasputin (Earth-295)|Mikhail Rasputin]], one of Apocalypse's [[Horsemen of Apocalypse (Earth-295)|Four Horsemen]], who relocated to Europe to try and sow the seeds of dissent among the human population in order to overthrow the government and make them his willing guinea pigs for cybernetic augmentation.{{r|X-Universe Vol 1 2}}

Stark was dispatched to the nation of [[Wakanda]] to collect [[Donald Blake (Earth-295)|Donald Blake]], who was in the region providing relief for the people in the famine-ravaged region. When Blake and his assistant [[Gwendolyne Stacy (Earth-295)|Gwen Stacey]] were attacked by the [[Marauders (Earth-295)|Marauders]], a group of wealthy cyborgs, Stark arrived in a ship and he and his pilot [[Clinton Barton (Earth-295)|Clint Barton]] killed them. Despite Stacy's lack of trust in Stark, he convinced both her and Blake to accompany him back to [[London]].{{r|X-Universe Vol 1 1}}

Stark took them to join Eurasian security chief [[Victor von Doom (Earth-295)|Victor von Doom]], scientist [[Bruce Banner (Earth-295)|Bruce Banner]] and soldiers [[Susan Storm (Earth-295)|Sue Storm]] and [[Benjamin Grimm (Earth-295)|Ben Grimm]] aboard Mikhail's ship, where the "Lost Horseman" addressed the public with a speech about unity. Taking the group into a private location, he informed them that this was all a ploy to exterminate the human race and showed them [[Manuel de la Rocha (Earth-295)|Empath]], his slave that he was using to manipulate the people's emotions below before taking them all prisoner.{{r|X-Universe Vol 1 1}}

Tony was selected as Mikhail's next subject for cybernetic augmentation. The Horseman thought of Stark as an ideal candidate because of his mechanical heart. However, he did not account for the fact that Stark had rigged a needle device that was programmed to pierce into his mechanical heart, causing an electrical surge to blow the power aboard Mikhail's ship. This would have come at the expense of Stark's life as he would have gone into cardiac arrest, however he was rescued by the now-free Donald Blake who injected his heart with adrenaline, reactivating it and saving his life.{{r|X-Universe Vol 1 2}}

After arming themselves from Mikhail's ammo dump, Tony and Gwen traveled to the control room of his ship and took command of it. They were attacked by Banner, who had reverted to his Thing form — a hulking monster loyal to Mikhail — but Gwen kept the monster busy while Stark hacked into the computer databases to learn a horrifying truth: that Apocalypse had activated his sea-wall defense grid and it was sending nuclear weapons across the ocean that would decimate the Eurasian continent. Stark managed to convince the Thing to revert back into Banner and help them stop the advancing sea wall but to no avail. They all attempted to escape in a ships headed for space.{{r|X-Universe Vol 1 2}}

Detecting that humans were escaping the sea-wall attack, nuclear weapons were launched at the shuttles escaping the holocaust. Tony, piloting the main ship, ordered Sue to send the other ships to destroy the fleet of missiles aimed at them. They succeeded with no serious damage, however one last missile was launched against them: A gamma bomb made out of [[Adamantium]]. This missile was ultimately destroyed by Banner, who turned into his Thing form and destroy it in an act of atonement for betraying humanity to Apocalypse.{{r|Hulk: Broken Worlds Vol 1 2}}

The fate of Stark and the others following this sacrifice, the death of Apocalypse, and the [[X-Men (Earth-295)|X-Men]]'s rebuilding of civilization remain unrevealed.

===''(Ultimate) Marvel vs. Capcom 3''===
Iron Man's first appearance was battling {{Wc|darkstalkers|Morrigan Aensland|Morrigan}} while both were airborne. Later, with the appearance of [[Galan (Earth-30847)|Galactus]] and dangerous villains determined to conquer both the Marvel and Capcom worlds, Iron Man ceased battling Morrigan and turned his attention to stopping the villains. He is later seen saving {{Wc|viewtifuljoe|Viewtiful_Joe|Viewtiful Joe}} from plummeting to his death after Joe and {{Wc|okami|Amaterasu|Amaterasu}} unsuccessfully attacked the [[Kl'rt (Earth-30847)|Super Skrull]], flying alongside Morrigan (who saved Amaterasu) towards the [[New York City|New York]] mainland. Iron Man then helps to rally together more Marvel and Capcom heroes, who take the fight to the enemy.

Iron Man's ending involves him noting in his journal that uploaded battle data, gathered from his climactic battle with [[Galan (Earth-30847)|Galactus]], shows that he was barely able to defeat him. To better prepare himself for any future threats, Iron Man uses the analyzed data to build the new [[Galactus-Buster Armor]].{{r|Marvel vs. Capcom 3: Fate of Two Worlds}}

===''Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite''===

After [[Ultron (Earth-30847)|Ultron]] and {{Wc|megaman|Sigma|Sigma}} merge their worlds with the [[Reality Stone]] and [[Space Stone]], Iron Man and other heroes work together to stop their fused form, {{Wc|marvelvscapcom|Ultron Sigma|Ultron Sigma}}. To do so, the team rescues Thanos from Ultron Sigma in order to learn where the other four [[Infinity Stones]] are.

After collecting three of the stones, {{Wc|megaman|Mega Man X (character)|X}}, {{Wc|megaman|Zero|Zero}}, and Iron Man use the stones to stop a giant [[Symbiotes|symbiote]] and the {{Wc|strider|Gravitron|Gravitron}} before they can cause severe harm, but the latter spreads the {{Wc|megaman|Sigma Virus|Sigma Virus}} around the [[Stark Tower|Avengers Tower]] when destroyed, infecting Tony and the other heroes. When he used the [[Time Stone]], Iron Man saw how the worlds were merged.

Running out of time, Tony and Thanos starts working on the [[Infinity Buster]] in what is left of the original {{Wc|megaman|Abel City|Abel City}}. During their work, Tony reveals to Thanos what he saw with the Time Stone. Not believing that [[Death (Earth-30847)|Death]] would trick him, Thanos angrily fights with Iron Man and takes the Time Stone to see it with his own eyes, and angrily beating all the heroes present. While they are down, Thanos finishes the Infinity Buster and another device, leaving Ultron Sigma to the heroes, with Iron Man telling the others to keep what happened with them between themselves. When Iron Man arrives to Xgard, he gives the Infinity Buster to X, which uses it to destroy Ultron Omega.{{r|Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite}}

| History                 = Taken captive in the Holy Land during the English/Spanish war, Anthony Stark was forced to make weapons for the English by way of weeks of torture by [[David Banner (Earth-311)|David Banner]].{{r|Marvel 1602: New World Vol 1 4}} He needs his massive armor to survive. The armor is powered by "lightning bottles" and provides him with super strength and invulnerability as well as several electricity-powered weapons.{{r|Marvel 1602: New World Vol 1 3}}

Anthony was called by [[James Charles Stuart (Earth-311)|James I]] of [[England]] into finding David Banner in the New World, after he was not heard from since his transformation to the Hulk. Anthony agreed, but swore that if Banner had betrayed the king, he would kill Banner personally.{{r|Marvel 1602: New World Vol 1 2}} Accompanied by [[Thaddeus Ross (Earth-311)|Captain Ross]] and his assistant [[Rupert Rhodes (Earth-311)|Rhodes]], Lord Iron crossed the [[Atlantic Ocean]] and arrived at [[Roanoke Island|Roanoke]] where Iron attacked. Iron then flung himself from his ship and captured [[Peter Parquagh (Earth-311)|Peter Parquagh]], demanding to know Banner's whereabouts.{{r|Marvel 1602: New World Vol 1 3}} Iron defeated the colony's soldiers with his built-in technology forcing the colony under control by the English.{{r|Marvel 1602: New World Vol 1 4}} 

Eventually both Lord Iron and Rhodes were led by [[Virginia Dare (Earth-311)|Virginia Dare]] who promised them she would find Banner, but they were then led to the ruins of a destroyed native village and were threatened by her into swearing their loyalty to the English, which they did (Iron had no actual allegiance to James I and cared more about swearing his vengeance upon Banner).{{r|Marvel 1602: New World Vol 1 4}}

When the natives, alongside with the Hulk, battled against the English, Iron attacked the Hulk in a glider. Despite the Hulk's plea to Iron into relenting his vendetta, Iron continued attacking him until Virginia Dare transformed into a monstrous sphinx who then convinced everyone fighting to stop or she would "start eating". After the battle, Lord Iron made amends with Banner and abandoned his quest for vengeance. Lord Iron and Rhodes then decided to stay in the Roanoke colony and start their lives over, in which the two rebuilt [[John Jonah Jameson (Earth-311)|Jonah Jameson]]'s printing press (which was previously inadvertently destroyed in a conflict between Virginia Dare and the Hulk) as an automated, electricity-driven machine much to Jonah's enjoyment.{{r|Marvel 1602: New World Vol 1 5}}

Each side blamed the other and the two split into two separate nations: Iron Man founded the [[Iron (Warzone)|Iron]] where powers strictly monitored and controlled. After years of fighting, [[Miriam Sharpe (Earth-32323)|Miriam Sharpe]] attempted to negotiate a peace talk, but was assassinated during the talk. Steve figured out the killed was from the Blue side but was aiming at him and so left assuming Stark had called the hit.{{r|Civil War Vol 2 1}} Returning to the Iron, Stark sent a drone into the [[Blue (Warzone)|Blue]] to track the assassin but the drone was destroyed by [[Ororo Munroe (Earth-32323)|Storm]]. Tracking the killer to [[Steeltown]], Iron Man began to suspect that someone had been manipulated the war. [[Jennifer Walters (Earth-32323)|She-Hulk]] went to infiltrate the Blue but was captured and ended up in the [[Divide]]. Iron Man went to rescue her and found the entire conflict had been manipulated by [[Deviant Skrulls|Skrulls]]. He managed to escape, and found Captain America had led his troops into the Iron and began the Battle of the Divide‏‎. This conflict continued for hours with Captain America attempting to draw in all the big hitters to activate the bomb, when Iron Man appeared over the battlefield and had [[James Howlett (Earth-32323)|Logan]] launch him and Iron Man. Here Iron Man revealed the truth about the Skrull infiltration. In order to deal with it they decided to throw Bellcurve into the Divide and set it off to remove the Skrulls abilities. However the detonator failed to go off, so both men went down into the Divide. They died in the ensuing explosion.{{r|Civil War Vol 2 4|5}}

| History                 = Tony Stark's history was similar to his [[Earth-199999]] [[Anthony Stark (Earth-199999)|counterpart]] until after his weapons demonstrate in 2008. When Tony was attacked by the [[Ten Rings (Earth-32938)|Ten Rings]], he was saved by an American soldier named [[N'Jadaka (Earth-32938)|Erik Stevens]]. Tony held a press conference at Stark Industries to commemorate Erik Stevens for his rescue, during the conference Stevens' outed [[Obadiah Stane (Earth-32938)|Obadiah Stane]] as the one behind the Ten Rings attack and Tony had Stane arrested.

After Tony and Erik had formed a friendship they started work on the first [[Stark Liberator Drones|Stark Liberator Drone]] but they realised they needed something to stop the drone from overheating, Stark suggested a miniaturised [[Arc Reactor]] but Erik brought up the idea of using [[Vibranium]]. Tony set up a meeting between [[James Rhodes (Earth-32938)|James Rhodes]] and [[Ulysses Klaue (Earth-32938)|Ulysses Klaue]] to obtain some Vibranium. The meeting is interrupted by the [[T'Challa (Earth-32938)|Black Panther]] but shortly after his interference, Erik Stevens arrives and kills both Rhodey and Black Panther, framing the scene to look like they had killed each other.

When Erik arrived back at Tony's [[Retreat (Tony Stark's Malibu Mansion)|mansion]] he noticed Tony watching a news report on Rhodey's death, Erik tried to lie about the incident but Stark knew about what happened as [[Just A Rather Very Intelligent System (Earth-32938)|J.A.R.V.I.S.]] had seen it. Tony released he couldn't kill Erik by himself, so he used the drone that they had both built to fight Stevens. Eventually Erik overpowered the drone by improvising his attacks, he then killed Tony with the [[Dora Milaje (Earth-32938)|Dora Milaje]] spear to frame the attack on the [[Wakanda|Wakandans]].{{r|What If...? (animated series) Season 1 6}}

Iron Man initially declined joining the [[Avengers (Earth-3488)|Avengers]], as he is accustomed to working alone, but he would eventually join the team. During the Avengers first mission, Iron Man is wounded and begins to suffocate under his mask. [[Steven Rogers (Earth-3488)|Captain America]] removes it to reveal his true identity. Iron Man helps the Avengers during the [[Chitauri]] attack and the [[Bruce Banner (Earth-3488)|Hulk]]'s rampage.{{r|Ultimate Avengers: The Movie}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-3488) from Ultimate Avengers 2 Rise of the Panther 002.jpg|thumb|left|With the War Machine Armor]]
When [[Wakanda]]n warriors damage his armor, Stark replaces it with the War Machine armor to fight the Chitauri invasion. He and [[Henry Pym (Earth-3488)|Giant Man]], armed with a gamma generator, destroy the Chitauri mothership but Hank is wounded and dies from his injuries. Stark risks his own life to divert the crashing mothership away from the Wakandan city, draining his suit's life-support function and leaving him in a lifeless state. [[Thor Odinson (Earth-3488)|Thor]] revives Stark with the magical powers of his hammer. When Stark wakes, he simply says to Thor "You really are a God."{{r|Ultimate Avengers 2: Rise of the Panther}}

(July 21, 2004) | Death = | History = Due to [[Howard Stark (Earth-37946)|father]]'s experimentation on him, Tony Stark possesses neural tissue throughout his body, making him one of the smartest people in the world.{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: Wave 27]]}} Due to his extreme intelligence, Tony Stark graduated the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] at an early age and took over his father's company, [[Stark Industries (Earth-37946)|Stark Industries]], at just 21. While visiting a Stark plant{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates - Toys R Us Two Packs: Wave 7]]}} in [[Afghanistan]],{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates - Toys R Us Two Packs: Iron Man 2 Wave 1]]}} Stark demonstrated one of his latest weapons{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: The Classic Heroic Age Box Set]]}} before an explosion sent a piece of shrapnel dangerously close to his heart.{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates - Toys R Us Two Packs: Wave 7]]}} Stark was then kidnapped by a [[Raza Hamidmi Al-Wazar (Earth-37946)|local warlord]] and created the first Iron Mar armor to save his life. Escaping captivity,{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: Wave 41]]}} Stark was initially hesitant to become a superhero but he eventually came around and became the hero known as Iron Man.{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: The Classic Heroic Age Box Set]]}} During a confrontation with Iron Monger, Iron Man's [[Iron Man Armor Model 3|Model 3]] armor was pushed to its limits.{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: Hostile Takeover Box Set]]}} After defeating Iron Monger, Tony Stark reveled to the world that he and Iron Man were one in the same.{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: Wave 35]]}} Fresh off the heels of his creation of the Iron Man armor, Iron Man was drawn to the [[Avengers (Earth-37946)|Avengers]] when [[Richard Jones (Earth-37946)|Rick Jones]]' radio transmissions warning of a [[Bruce Banner (Earth-37946)|Hulk]] attack.{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: Avengers Box Set]]}} Iron Man soon helped the other Avengers fight off the [[Chitauri]] invasion of [[Manhattan]].{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: Wave 49]]}} Iron Man remade his [[Iron Man Armor Model 1|first armor]] to do battle with a rampaging [[James Rhodes (Earth-37946)|Jim Rhodes]].{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: Iron Man Through the Ages Box Set]]}} While wearing his [[Iron Man Armor Model 7|Silver Centurion armor]], Iron Man confronted [[Obadiah Stane (Earth-37946)|Iron Monger]]. Following the Iron Monger's defeat, Stark and his company, Stark Industries, entered a time of prosperity.{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: Wave 36]]}} Once the Silver Centurion armor was destroyed in a battle with the [[Basil Sandhurst (Earth-37946)|Controller]], Stark created the [[Iron Man Armor Model 9|Neo-Classic armor]].{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: Wave 36]]}} Later, he also created a [[Iron Man Armor Model 13|modular armor]] to defeat the very powerful [[Ultimo (Earth-37946)|Ultimo]].{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: Iron Man Through the Ages Box Set]]}} During the [[Superhuman Civil War]], Iron Man was the leading proponent of the [[Superhuman Registration Act]] and began to enforce it by force.{{r|[[Marvel Minimates|Marvel Minimates: Civil War Box Set]]}} | Powers = | Abilities = | Weaknesses = | Equipment = [[Iron Man Armor Model 3]], [[Iron Man Armor Model 6]] | Transportation = | Weapons = | Notes = | Trivia = | Links = }} [[Category:2004 Character Debuts]]

After making the world a better place, including inducing global peace with a [[World Energy Shield]], Stark became the [[Glossary:Sorcerer Supreme|Sorcerer Supreme]] of the entire galaxy by the [[Earth-39234|year 2099 A.D.]].{{r|Generations: Iron Man & Ironheart Vol 1 1}}

===Tempus===
When [[Eva Bell (Earth-616)|Tempus]] traveled to the year [[Marvel 2099|2099]], thinking it was [[Danny Warburton (Earth-51246)|her husband]] and [[Doll Warburton (Earth-51246)|her daughter]]'s reality, [[Earth-51246]], she went to the [[Stark Tower|Sanctum Sanctorum]] where she met Anthony Stark. He revealed to her that her family's timeline was erased from existence and that she could never go back. He took her to [[Tabula Rasa (Montana)|Tabula Rasa]], where he convinced her to return to her real [[Earth-616|time]].{{r|All-New X-Men Annual Vol 1 1}}

===Iron Man===
Tony was able to reach out to the past and contact the Iron Man of that time, [[Victor von Doom (Earth-616)|Victor von Doom]]. He warned him to give up the Iron Man mantle before he was captured, but lost connection before he could elaborate on the circumstances.{{r|Infamous Iron Man Vol 1 6|9}}

===Ironheart===
The [[Next Avengers (Earth-39234)|Next Avengers]] delivered [[Riri Williams (Earth-616)|Ironheart]], who was visiting their time in the [[Vanishing Point]], to Stark's doorstep. He vaguely explained to her the events that transpired in the years prior. Stark, among other individuals she encountered, inspired her to prepare for an exciting future before [[Kobik (Earth-616)|Kobik]] returned her home.{{r|Generations: Iron Man & Ironheart Vol 1 1}}

Tony gave a young [[Peter Parker (Earth-TRN1344)|Peter Parker]] from an [[Earth-TRN1344|alternate universe]] a [[Spider-Man's Suit|tech suit]] for him to have a better performance. He took the suit away after Peter disobeyed his orders and fought his world's [[Adrian Toomes (Earth-TRN1344)|Vulture]]; however, he gave it back after Peter successfully apprehended Toomes. When [[Thanos (Earth-41940)|Thanos]] was making his way to [[Earth]], he recruited adult Spider-Man back into the Avengers and gave him a new Iron Spider Armor. He valiantly defended the [[Mind Stone]] from Thanos' lackeys, but was unable to defeat Thanos one-on-one.{{r|Spider-Man Unlimited (video game)}}

| History                 = Tony Stark was a ruthless genius who hid his ambitions to rule the world behind a veneer of philantrophy. Stark committed his first known murder at the age of 14, when he killed his own father.{{r|Exiles Vol 1 24}}

In adulthood, Tony created the [[Iron Man Armor]]. When the world was torn apart by a conflict between [[Mutants (Homo superior)|mutantkind]] and [[Humans (Homo sapiens)|humanity]], Iron Man saw his chance. He secretly funded [[Max Eisenhardt (Earth-42777)|Magneto]] and his world-wide army of mutants, with Magneto promising that Iron Man would rule what remained of humanity when the war was over.

Stark's plan was for the war to thin out the world's superhuman population. He eventually turned on Magneto, murdering his former ally on live television, making him a hero in the eyes of the world. Next, Stark engineered a famine that caused millions of deaths worldwide. After curing this famine, Stark's fame grew further and he soon won the presidency of the [[United States of America]]. He next developed technology that allowed him to control the climate, using it to bring about massive natural disasters in [[Europe]] and [[Asia]], to prompt those countries affected to relinquish control to him. Economic downspins in the Americas had the same effect, soon uniting the planet under Stark's rule.{{r|Exiles Vol 1 23}}

One of few who evaded Stark's direct control was [[Victor von Doom (Earth-42777)|Victor von Doom]], the monarch of [[Latveria]]. The two entered a secret alliance, with Doom agreeing to attack [[Washington, D.C.]] to give Stark a pretext for ending democracy. Doom delivered on this deal, but also betrayed Stark and challenged him for global dominion. While Stark succeeded in killing him, Doom managed to leave Stark permanently disfigured.{{r|Exiles Vol 1 23}}

By this point, the only people he did not rule over on the planet were the [[Inhumans (Inhomo supremis)|Inhumans]], led by [[Blackagar Boltagon (Earth-42777)|King Black Bolt]] and [[Susan Storm (Earth-42777)|Queen Susan Storm]]. Stark coveted the secrets of the Inhumans, hoping to use them as an army that would allow him to conquer the stars. He searched for the hidden city of [[Attilan]], eventually discovering it when the Inhumans' cloaking technology was temporarily disrupted by repairs. Unable to pierce the city's shields, Stark was surprised by a visit from [[Weapon X (Multiverse)|Wepaon X]], a multiversal group of exiles forced to travel the multiverse in order to repair damaged realities.{{r|Exiles Vol 1 23|25}}

Weapon X had been charged with ensuring the fall of Attilan, and helped Stark's forces secure the key dropping the shield from [[Simon Williams (Earth-42777)|Wonder Man]]. When Stark's victory was assured, Black Bolt chose to destroy the city, along with all of its inhabitants, to prevent their secrets from falling into the hands of Stark. Susan Storm was the lone survivor, and she managed to assassinate Stark shortly after the city's fall, at the cost of her own life.{{r|Exiles Vol 1 25}}

| History                 = The Iron Man of [[Earth-49487]] exist in a reality that closely mirrors the early days of the [[Glossary:Modern Age|modern age]] of [[Earth-616]] when the group was still in their early beginnings. His era was visited by the [[Fantastic Four (Earth-616)|Fantastic Four]] of [[Earth-616]] who ended up in this reality trying to search for their missing leader [[Reed Richards (Earth-616)|Mister Fantastic]]. When the [[Susan Storm (Earth-616)|Invisible Woman]] of Earth-616 accidentally mistook Earth-49487's [[Reed Richards (Earth-49487)|Mister Fantastic]] as her husband, the 616-FF were confronted by their 49487 counterparts. {{r|Fantastic Four Vol 1 387}} 

Although a possible battle was put aside while cooler heads prevailed, thanks to the machinations of a [[Susan Storm (Malice) (Earth-616)|Malice]] controlled [[Franklin Richards (Earth-6311)|Psi-Lord]], a fight broke out between the two versions of the Fantastic Four. As the battle raged on, the 616-FF's [[Scott Lang (Earth-616)|Ant-Man]] attempted to contact ants to aid in their battle. This led to Earth-49487's [[Henry Pym (Earth-49487)|Henry Pym]] (formally an Ant-Man himself) to change into his identity of Giant-Man and gather his teammates in the [[Avengers (Earth-49487)|Avengers]] to help the Fantastic Four from the "impostors" they were battling against. As the battle raged on, the combatants were interrupted by the arrival of the [[Reed Richards (Earth-944)|Dark Raider]], an agent of [[Aron (Earth-616)|Aron the Rogue Watcher]]. He slew both Mister Fantastic and the [[Susan Storm (Earth-49487)|Invisible Girl]] of this reality before retreating from the rest of the heroes. With the death of half of the team, the Fantastic Four was no more. In the confusion the Earth-616 heroes returned on their quest to find their lost leader, leaving their Earth-49487 counterparts to pick up the pieces of their shattered lives. {{r|Fantastic Four Vol 1 388}}

| History                 = The world that the Tony Stark of [[Earth-5012]] was born into was ravaged in a war with [[Titannus (Earth-5012)|Titannus]]. Many heroes died as a result, with Stark becoming a more violent individual due to the losses suffered.{{r|Marvel Team-Up Vol 3 13}} 

At some point, he became opposed to [[Reed Richards (Earth-5012)|Reed Richards]] - his words imply that Richards did something that resulted in several deaths and caused him to view Richards as a psychopath. Adopting an armor that resembled Doctor Doom, he fought the [[Fantastic Four (Earth-5012)|Fantastic Four]] of his world and killed the [[Jonathan Storm (Earth-5012)|Human Torch]] after the Torch burnt his face.{{r|Marvel Team-Up Vol 3 4}}

He was eventually sent to the 'main' [[Earth-616|Marvel Universe]] by Richards, for reasons unknown (Stark commented that it was a neat way for Richards to get rid of him without killing him, but the veracity of this is unclear).{{r|Marvel Team-Up Vol 3 4}} The [[Fantastic Four (Earth-616)|Fantastic Four]] and [[Stephen Strange (Earth-616)|Dr. Strange]] confronted who they thought to be the returning [[Victor von Doom (Earth-616)|Dr. Doom]], after Stark confirmed his true identity he escaped by using a power dampening device on the Fantastic Four.{{r|Marvel Team-Up Vol 3 2|4}}

Posing as the real Iron Man, he obtained a number of devices and planned to use the mutant [[Paul Patterson (Earth-616)|Paul Patterson]] to power a portal.{{r|Marvel Team-Up Vol 3 4|5}}

The unlikely duo of [[Peter Parker (Earth-616)|Spider-Man]] and [[Laura Kinney (Earth-616)|X-23]] assisted [[Steven Rogers (Earth-616)|Captain America]] and [[Natalia Romanova (Earth-616)|Black Widow]] in stopping him.{{r|Marvel Team-Up Vol 3 5|6}}

Stark was placed in [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-616)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] custody alongside the [[Rachel Leighton (LMD) (Earth-616)|LMD of Diamondback]]. His body somehow adapted to the sedatives used. He attacked the agents watching him, then activated the LMD, coercing it to help. He then took her apart to build himself a new suit of armor.{{r|Marvel Team-Up Vol 3 22}}

With the new armor, he went on a rampage, taking on the [[New Avengers (Earth-616)|New Avengers]]. [[Curtis Doyle (Earth-616)|Freedom Ring]] and [[Z'Reg (Earth-616)|Crusader (Skrull)]] also responded. Freedom Ring and Captain America were able to defeat him at the cost of Freedom Ring's life.{{r|Marvel Team-Up Vol 3 24}}

He was later killed by an [[Earth-71986|alternate reality]] [[Wade Wilson (Earth-71986)|Deadpool]] who was on a mission to kill every evil variant of the heroes in the Multiverse.{{r|Deadpool Kills the Marvel Universe One Last Time Vol 1 5}}

| History                 = Gravely injured by an act of industrial sabotage, billionaire genius Tony Stark saved his own life by designing a life-sustaining shell---the hi-tech armor that makes him the invincible Iron Man. Today the world thinks Iron Man is an employee---Stark's personal bodyguard. In this dual role, he faces corporate intrigue and superpowered menaces. Iron Man is a modern-day knight in shining armor. He is the co-leader of the [[New Avengers (Earth-50701)|New Avengers]].<ref>Marvel Nemesis: Rise of the Imperfects (Instruction Booklet)</ref>

===Marvel Nemesis: Rise of the Imperfects===
Iron Man appeared at Roekel's headquarters just after the [[Jonathan Storm (Earth-50701)|Human Torch]] and the [[Benjamin Grimm (Earth-50701)|Thing]] ended their battle. He heads towards the Power Plant for answers.

*'''Scuttle:''' [[Avengers Mansion]] is overrun with enemies. Iron Man must defeat all the enemies and destroy the central computer so the aliens can no longer use it.
::Reward: For beating Iron Man's first mission, the player is awarded the '''''Iron Man''''' Card.

*'''Call of Heroes:''' Iron Man must protect the communications array from the alien forces.
:Iron Man: "''If they destroy these relay dishes, it'll cut off the team's communication. If they try, they'll have to get through me first.''"
::Reward: For beating Iron Man's second mission, the player is awarded the '''''Roekel Battle Suit''''' Card.

*'''Eternal Soldier:''' Iron Man is attacked by [[Rick Landau (Earth-50701)|a powerful new foe (Brigade)]] when he searches the Power Plant for clues about the origin of the alien enemies.
:Iron Man: "''I don't suppose you're here to talk?''"
:Brigade: "''I hate talking. I hear enough voices already; Sir Yes Sir!''"
After defeating Brigade, Tony is met by another threat, who also sports an armored suit.
:[[Niles van Roekel (Earth-50701)|Roekel]]: "''Well done Mr. Steel Man.''"
:Iron Man: "''I am Iron Man.''"
:Roekel: "''Not for long.''" Roekel blasts Tony's armor with an energy blast,temporarily shutting him down/knocking him out.
[[Erik Lehnsherr (Earth-50701)|Magneto]] witnessed the entire event, simply stating, "''Very interesting.''"
::Reward: For beating Iron Man's third mission, the player is awarded the '''''Brigade''''' Card and '''''unlocks both Iron Man and Brigade''''' as playable characters.

*'''Hot Iron:''' Defeat altered Human Torch!

*'''All Or Nothing:''' Defeat all enemies without suffering any damage.

| History                 = 
===Cosmic Civil War===
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-517) from Marvel Contest of Champions 001.jpg|thumb|left]]
After the Collector used most of the [[ISO-Sphere]]'s energy to defeat [[Bruce Banner (Maestro) (Earth-517)|Maestro]], Iron Man decided to take the opportunity to defeat him, seize control over the ISO-Sphere, and end the Contest of Champions once and for all.

To accomplish this mission, Iron Man sought out the other Champions of [[Earth-517|Battlerealm]] to help him, but not all of them agreed with him. Those who agreed with him joined his [[Iron Faction (Earth-517)|Iron Faction]], while those who didn't joined [[Steven Rogers (WWII) (Earth-517)|Captain America]]'s [[Blue Faction (Earth-517)|Blue Faction]], and what was a disagreement between Iron Man and Captain America quickly escalated into an open conflict between the two forces.

Iron Man was also joined by his fellow [[Illuminati (Earth-517)|Illuminati]], who helped him to take the Blue Faction down through special missions. In one of said missions, the Illuminati were ordered by Iron Man to take a [[Steven Rogers (Earth-517)|Captain America]] who had just entered the contest down, to their dismay.<!-- "Cosmic Civil War" Event Quest -->

As time passed, Iron Man became colder and more ruthless, hunting down his enemies without mercy. That led many of his allies to leave his side in order to help [[Stephen Strange (Earth-517)|Doctor Strange]] find the legendary [[Steven Rogers (Earth-TRN634)|Civil Warrior]] to convince him to end the war.

Iron Man, along with Captain America, were defeated by the Civil Warrior in the site of their final battle, thus ending the Cosmic Civil War. He was among the champions who were recaptured by the Collector by the end of the war.<!-- "Cosmic Civil War: Endgame" Event Quest -->
