===Early Life===
Tony Stark was the gifted son of inventor [[Howard Stark (Earth-534834)|Howard Walter Stark]] and his wife [[Martha Stark (Earth-534834)|Martha]]. On his tenth birthday, Walter took him to the zoo, where he wanted to let all the animals out of their cages. He and Walter never shared a close relationship.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 4}} Despite admiring his father, Tony felt unworthy of his legacy. This insecurity drove him to adopt a self-indulgent lifestyle, becoming a frivolous and self-absorbed playboy in his late teens, much to his father's chagrin. Walter had founded the aircraft company [[Stark Enterprises (Earth-534834)|Stark and Son]] to provide cutting-edge defense technology for their country, and he believed Tony had to use his intelligence responsibly. Although Tony contributed to the business, he often fell short of his father's expectations. One notable failure occurred when Tony disregarded Walter's specifications while helping design a military helicopter. Its poor performance at a demonstration cost them a government contract. While Tony dismissed the blunder, Walter tried to make him understand how his carelessness impacted their employees and the lives their technology could have saved in combat.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) and Howard Stark (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 1 11 001.png|thumb|left|Tony with his father]]
As a young adult, Tony's life changed when Walter was severely injured in a factory accident; Walter cited that the accident was orchestrated by their major rival, [[Justin Hammer (Earth-534834)|Justin Hammer]], though it was later revealed that [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-534834)|A.I.M.]] were responsible.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 1 11}}{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 4}} Tony visited his father shortly before he died in the hospital, where Walter made peace with the fact that he needed to let Tony lead his own life. However, his death galvanized Tony, who took over Stark and Son. Combining his inventions with his father's patents, Tony elevated the company into a global conglomerate called [[Stark Enterprises (Earth-534834)|Stark Enterprises]]. Tragedy struck again when Hammer, in partnership with the would-be world conqueror known as the [[Arnold Brock (Earth-534834)|Mandarin]], masterminded Tony's kidnapping. Held captive in the Mandarin's castle, Tony was forced to design an invincible suit of armor for his captor. Work was torturous, especially as Tony suffered a debilitating spinal injury during his kinapping, which left metal shards embedded near his spine that threatened paralysis.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 1 11}}

Seeing Tony's slow progress, the Mandarin brought him an assistant in the form of physicist [[Wellington Yinsen (Earth-534834)|Dr. Wellington Yinsen]]. The pair bonded as they worked together on an armor, albeit one that responded exclusively to Tony's neuromimetic signature to break out of captivity. On the day of their escape, Yinsen urged Tony to disguise himself as his own anonymous liberator, crafting a life-size dummy of Tony from straw and makeup for the ruse. The red and gold armor alleviated Tony's injuries and the power it provided made him realize his obligation to use it wisely, thus making peace with his father's memory. When the Mandarin and his minions stormed their cell, the armor's neuromimetic interface was still loading, so Yinsen sacrificed himself to intercept a vaporizing blast fired by the Mandarin at Tony. Carrying the decoy doll to maintain his cover, Stark escaped from the Mandarin's fortress.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 1 12}}

===Iron Man and Force Works===
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 1 9 001.jpg|thumb|left|The original Iron Man Armor]]
Embarking on a path of heroism, Tony used his armor as the super hero named Iron Man. He also founded, financed and led the private pacekeeping team [[Force Works (Earth-534834)|Force Works]], which included Stark Enterprises' Senior Vice President of Security and Tony's best friend [[James Rhodes (Earth-534834)|Jim Rhodes]], and the company's Vice President of Research and Development [[Julia Carpenter (Earth-534834)|Julia Carpenter]], both in their costumed identities of War Machine and Spider-Woman, respectively. The team was rounded up by the sardonic archer [[Clinton Barton (Earth-534834)|Hawkeye]], the enigmatic alien [[Century (Alien) (Earth-534834)|Century]] and the [[Wanda Frank (Earth-534834)|Scarlet Witch]]; the former competed against Julia for Tony's affection. Force Works routinely clashed with the forces of the Mandarin, who attempted to steal Stark's inventions for himself to further his plans of global domination.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 1 1}}

At an undisclosed point in time, Tony regrettably fired [[Simon Gilbert (Earth-534834)|Simon Gilbert]] from Stark Enterprises, after he attempted to embezzle money from the company due to poor investment decisions. When Simon attempted to destroy the company as revenge, Iron Man tried to stop him, resulting in Gilbert dying in an explosion.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 2}} He also encountered [[Dark Aegis (Earth-534834)|Dark Aegis]] for the first time, who armed Stark's Asteroid Blaster to fire at the Earth. Iron Man managed to fire at the device, causing it to tilt towards Aegis' position and blast him into space.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 7}}

===The Beast Within===
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 1 001.png|thumb|right|Tony with his new armor]]
Tony eventually created the A.I. [[Heuristically Operative Matrix Emulation Rostrum (Earth-534834)|H.O.M.E.R.]] to help him monitor Stark Enterprises' security and his vitals. He would also install a chest piece onto the left side of his pectoral muscles. The chest piece included a plug socket for an external cable, allowing him to recharge himself without the Iron Man Armor. One night, Justin Hammer rigged his car to explode as he unlocked the door. Just the day before, Tony also received an explosive package. Donning the Iron Man Armor, he flew to confront Hammer in his private area. This resulted in Iron Man facing off against Hammer Industries' defences, only to be caught and hurled into the building. [[Hypnotia (Earth-534834)|Hypnotia]] told Hammer to take off the suit's front torso piece, as it was required for the Mandarin's plans, but Tony reversed the suit's polar field to force them back and escape. While he worked on a new armor, H.O.M.E.R. found that the damage to his chest plate had worsened the condition of his central nervous system, potentially causing paralysis. Stark chose to hide the new armour and his condition to Rhodey, who told him that [[Nicholas Fury (Earth-534834)|Nick Fury]] was waiting for him in the conference room. When meeting with Fury, he complained that [[Strategic Hazard Intervention Espionage Logistics Directorate (Earth-534834)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] was unable to go after Hammer for his attacks, though they could not take any action without definitive proof.

Fury explained to Tony that four of the world’s richest industrialists had recently gone missing, with a satellite snapshot showing four men trekking into a hidden valley in [[China]]. When investigating the image closer, he noticed [[Fin Fang Foom (Earth-534834)|Fin Fang Foom]]'s shadow and discovered that the four industrialists were found in pictures ranging from 75-150 years ago. Believing the Mandarin to also be involved, he took a jet to travel to China. Rhodey tried to accompany him, only for Tony to force him out and ask if he could make sure a package was delivered. Just before Hypnotia and Blizzard destroyed the jet, he used a Hydro Armor to escape. Tony left a second armor inside, convincing Force Works and Mandarin's allies that he died in the explosion. Sometime later, he arrived at [[Beijing International Airport]] to receive his package, containing his new armor. He used it to save War Machine from Fin Fang Foom and battle the Makluans. They overpowered him, forcing Iron Man to ally with the Mandarin. Combining his armour's power with the Mandarin's rings, they destroyed the Makluans and their portal to Kakaranthara. The event also resulted in the Mandarin's rings being scattered across the world. Rhodey and the rest of Force Works confronted him over his fake death, which he tried to justify. The deception resulted in Hawkeye, Scarlet Witch and Century deciding to relocate Force Works, while Rhodey and Julia remained at Stark Enterprises. Left alone and believing the Mandarin to be dead, Tony felt like he was finally able to let his guard down.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 1}}

===After Force Works===
Following the separation of Force Works, Tony continued to manage Stark Enterprises. He developed a defence system called Goliath, designed for the military's national security needs. When a power plant explosion caused Goliath to go into Emergency Defense Mode, it opened fire on War Machine at Fort Goodwin. Iron Man went to the site to help War Machine while evading a missile. Once the missile was destroyed, he rushed into the river to save a drowning Rhodey. The city-wide power outage was caused by a man named [[Gary Gilbert (Earth-534834)|Firebrand]], claiming to represent the People's Freedom Front. After two more attacks on a power plant and Stark Enterprises' headquarters, Tony discovered that Firebrand was Gary Gilbert, the son of ex-Stark board member Simon Gilbert. Confronting Gilbert at the Rockson Refinery resulted in the armor's power becoming depleted, with the remaining weapons power being diverted to the thrusters. Iron Man confronted Firebrand after he destroyed the city dam, with debris damaging the arsonist's jetpack. As Stark tried to save Firebrand from drowning, his armor lost power, causing both to almost die. After Rhodey managed rescued both of them, he used the War Machine Armor to transfer energy to Iron Man and they prevented the city from being flooded by redirecting the water. Following Firebrand's arrest, Tony was reminded of his failure to save Simon's life. Rhodey, traumatised by his near-death experience, told Stark that he refused to wear the War Machine Armor again.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 2}}

===The Star Well===
[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 3 002.jpg|thumb|left|Iron Man's Space Armor]]
Completing the modifications to his new armor at 3:07 a.m., including nuclear thrusters and deep space adaptability, Tony's ironic comments confused H.O.M.E.R. just as [[Timothy Dugan (Earth-534834)|Dum Dum Dugan]] contacted him. He chose to wear his new armor to meet with Dugan, ignoring H.O.M.E.R.'s warnings. When arriving at the factory, Iron Man was confronted by S.H.I.E.L.D. agents wearing [[Guardian Armor (Earth-534834)|Guardian Armor]], with Dugan claiming ownership of the location. In retaliation, Iron Man destroyed Dugan's automated tank and demanded an explanation. He was then shown an attack on a tea plantation's school, with the Chinese Government blaming Stark Enterprises for the incident. S.H.I.E.L.D also initially suspected the company to be responsible, only to find a recording from A.I.M. The organisation took responsibility for the fire and threatened to destroy 10 of the world's largest population centers if the governments of the world did not give in to their demands.

Iron Man chose to investigate a potential attack satellite used by A.I.M., destroying the roof of Dugan's trailer during his set off. Using the armor's infrared scan, he discovered the Star Well and met [[Arthur Dearborn (Earth-534834)|Sunturion]], who warned him to stay away from the space station. Finding an airlock to enter the station, he met Arthur Dearborn, the creator of the Star Well. Questioning him on the school attack, Dearborn claimed it to be an accident caused by A.I.M., who were previously hired to help him with the satellite technology. When an A.I.M. scout ship approached the Star Well, Iron Man battled against its duplicating drones, eventually destroying them all.

Losing consciousness, he was saved by Sunturion and Dearborn discovered his identity. Arthur tried to force Tony to stay and protect the Star Well, but H.O.M.E.R. managed to redirect the station's feeder circuit to the Iron Man Armor. Tony used his repulsor rays to escape the life support room, planning to shut down the Star Well. A distressed Dearborn then revealed that he and Sunturion were the same person, banishing himself to the Star Well to make sure that the rest of mankind would be safe from his invisible rays. Tony related to Dearborn's situation of being trapped in "a cell of iron", only for more A.I.M. ships to arrive. Stark attempted to destroy the Star Well before A.I.M. could take it over, leading to an enraged Dearborn to attack him.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) and Arthur Dearborn (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 3 001.jpg|thumb|right|Iron Man and Sunturion]]
When Sunturion failed to stop the A.I.M ships, Iron Man opened fire on them. The ships quickly fled once the Star Well had been damaged, falling towards [[New York City]]. Sunturion once more struck at Iron Man, only to be pushed aside. With the amors energy too low to push the Star Well into the ocean, Dearborn realised Stark was right and gave his life to destroy his dream. Tony found irony in the fact that Dearborn's ultimate gift to mankind wasn't the Star Well, but instead his sacrifice. A confused H.O.M.E.R. failed to see the humor in his ironic comment, believing irony to be always funny. Tony told him that sometimes, irony wasn't funny at all.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 3}}

===Pursuit of A.I.M.===
Tony and Rhodey later worked with S.H.I.E.L.D. to track down an A.I.M. transmission. In stealth mode, Iron Man investigated the source of a tracker signal, discovering a transmission from his father, Walter Stark. Disobeying Fury's commands, Iron Man engaged A.I.M.'s force, with the assistance of Rhodey in a helicopter. Entering the base, he located Walter and struck at the armory to destroy the complex. In spite of claiming to make peace with the memory of his father,{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 1 11}} wounds were still left open when Walter supposedly died, only made worse by his apparent survival. Tony questioned the recovering Walter, unconvinced that it was really his long-presumed-deceased father. With Walter claiming he couldn't remember how he ended up in A.I.M.'s captivity, Tony viewed an old news report about his father after the factory accident, finding Dum Dum Dugan as part of the medical team assigned to perform surgery on Walter. Stark confronted Fury over the discovery, who himself was frustrated over Iron Man compromising his surveillance mission. When Walter reacted negatively upon seeing Fury, later claimed to be an anxiety attack, Tony pushed the S.H.I.E.L.D. agent aside.

Julia provided him with the DNA results of a positive match, convincing Tony that the man was indeed his father. When he found Walter using H.O.M.E.R. to access security codes for the military and information on S.H.I.E.L.D., his father stated that he was learning about the changes in Stark Enterprises. When asked if he remembered anything, Walter recalled taking his son to the zoo on his tenth birthday, which somewhat embarrassed the older Tony. His father commented that, even back then, Tony was a rebel. This then lead to a heated debate between the two Starks, with Tony believing that nothing he did was ever good enough. Walter retorted that his son never tried hard enough, that it all came too easy. They were interrupted by H.O.M.E.R., claiming that a classified S.H.I.E.L.D. report confirmed that Walter was swapped for a captured agent 10 years ago, following A.I.M.'s failed attempt at capturing him that resulted in his severe injuries.

Enraged, Tony went after Fury, whose security systems had been compromised and opened fire at his jet. Iron Man entered the Helicarrier and shut down their security systems, Fury then asked to speak with Tony. Fury confessed that Walter didn't die in the hospital, A.I.M. had tried to capture him for a mind-reading experiment. However, the robots they rigged went ballistic and nearly killed him instead. When Fury heard of the incident, he sent a team to guard him, only to find that A.I.M. already caught him. Reliable sources had claimed that Walter was killed at A.I.M. headquarters, Fury saw no reason to cause the Stark family grief and kept it secret. The trade story was made up by A.I.M. to trick Tony into going against S.H.I.E.L.D. Rhodey then called Tony to tell him that H.O.M.E.R. had been hacked, locking down Stark Enterprises' defences and allowing A.I.M. agents into the building with Walter still inside. When Tony met up with Rhodey, they found that H.O.M.E.R.'s files were being downloaded. With the assistance of S.H.I.E.L.D., Rhodey fought against A.I.M. while Iron Man went inside of the building. 

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) and Howard Stark (Clone) (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 4 002.jpg|thumb|left|Walter reveals he's a clone]]
With Fury pursuing the fleeing A.I.M. agents, Rhodey and Iron Man found a transmission from Walter, asking where his son was. When Tony reunited with his father, he was tricked and knocked out by [[Yuri Bezukhov (Earth-534834)|Crimson Dynamo]]. With Tony captured, Walter revealed that he was in fact a [[Howard Stark (Clone) (Earth-534834)|clone]], and that the real Walter Stark was dead. The revelation devastated Tony, with Walter's clone planning to take his technology, already incorporating it into Crimson Dynamo. With Rhodey restoring power, Tony was freed, using one of the armors to fight Crimson Dynamo. After defeating him, Crimson Dynamo vowed to meet him again as Iron Man pursued the fleeing clone. Unable to follow him, he said goodbye to the clone, referring to him as "father".{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 4}}

===Beauty Knows No Pain===
When Julia and a few workers went missing during a cave-in, Tony and Rhodey travelled to Egypt in the hope of finding them. After workers broke through to a vast chamber below the cave, Stark chose to descend into the chamber on his own. Rhodey told him to use the Iron Man Armor, but it still required recharging and Tony remarked that War Machine could also help out, a statement that made Rhodey defensive. After reaching the bottom in an elevator, Tony found the tunnelling machine, with no sign of Julia or the missing workers. After finding Egyptian hieroglyphics, his radio went static, cutting him off from contacting Rhodey; after discovering the radio was manufactured by Hammer Industries, he stated "typical." He was then captured by members of the Maggia, led by [[Whitney Frost (Earth-534834)|Madame Masque]], who Tony quickly realised was a former lover, Whitney.

Madame Masque showed him hieroglyphics depicting the Eye of Isis, a jewel which granted great power to the person controlling it. Masque was particularly interested by the hieroglyphics depicting a crippled man being restored after bathing in the light of the Eye, in the hope that finding the eye will heal her face. Previous attempts to find the eye resulted in 60 of her men being lost, so she proposed that Iron Man retrieves it for her. Tony initially refused, but Masque showed him Julia trapped in a low-voltage field, she increased the voltage to cause Julia pain. After witnessing Julia being tortured, Tony complied with Masque's demands in exchange for Julia's freedom, with the workers being freed after Iron Man recovered the Eye. After acquiring his armor, Tony witnessed Whitney crying over her disfigured face. He attempted to apologise for what happened to her, but she disregarded it, only concerned about the retrieval of the Eye. 

Traversing the through the chamber's traps, Iron Man discovered the Eye's location, being encased in a tiara. H.O.M.E.R. was unable to identify the energy from the crystal, but stored the hieroglyphics above it. When picking up the Eye, the chamber began to collapse, forcing Iron Man to escape while at low power. The armor shutdown just as he escaped and Madame Masque was given the tiara. When later checking on Whitney, Tony found that the Eye had restored her face. Whitney now believed that Tony would never leave her, but her told her that it was her craving for power that drove them apart, that he felt she wanted Stark Enterprises more than she ever wanted him. At just that moment, War Machine and Spider-Woman attacked the Maggia, leading an angered Whitney to aim her gun at Tony. Before she could shoot, the Eye transformed into the goddess Isis and swiftly dealt with War Machine and Spider-Woman. Tony grabbed her gun, but hesitated to shoot. This allowed Isis to escape the cave, with Julia and Rhodey pursuing her while Stark recharged his armor.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) and Whitney Frost (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 5 001.jpg|thumb|right|Tony leaves Whitney]]
As Isis overpowered both Spider-Woman and War Machine, Iron Man arrived to fight her, with Rhodey breifly providing assistance. He failed to stop her and she took off his mask, demanding that he give himself to her. Tony stated that what she wanted wasn't love and removed the tiara from her head, destroying it with a repulsor ray. Whitney became heartbroken over her face becoming disfigured again and believed Tony couldn't stand the sight of her. He kissed her and said that the beauty that won his love was inside her, but that she had killed it a long time ago. Tony left with Julia and Rhodey, as Whitney begged him to not let them see her. Later, he found a remaining shard of the tiara and felt sorrow for Whitney. When Julia asked if he really loved her, he said that he once did, a long time ago. Julia commented on the fact that he would risk his life 100 times over, but never his heart. When he asked if she was referring to their engagement, she answered that she was talking about his cold, lonely life and also expressed pity for Whitney. Tony tried to tell her something, but she instead told him to hold her as they stood beneath the night.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 5}}

===Iron Man, on the Inside===
At Stark Enterprises, Tony was working on a Molecular Expander late at night. His tiredness resulted in him misreading 10 angstroms as 100, which lead to H.O.M.E.R. suggesting that he get some sleep. Julia arrived and reminded him that they needed to be at the Detroit Computer Conference in half an hour. She continued by making a comment about their relationship and how their marriage would've been a mistake. Upon noticing the expander, Tony told her that the device would be able to produce bigger, healthier and more reliable sources of food in about two years. After a failed demonstration resulted in a plant dying, they made their way out of the building. It was there that they encountered Hawkeye, still bitter at Tony for his fake death. Tony initially tried to being friendly to his former ally, but Clint stated he was only there to clean out his locker and refused to speak with him. When Julia tried to defend Stark, Hawkeye continued to blame him for Force Work's separating and saw her as complicit in his actions. Tony then snapped at him before Julia stopped both of them, taking Stark to his jet.

As they began to take off, [[Ultimo (Earth-534834)|Ultimo]] appeared and attacked the jet. Julia broke the jet free from its grasp, as Tony opened fire on the machine. Hawkeye also came to assist both of them, allowing Iron Man to save Julia from the damaged jet. The plane crashed into a radio tower, with one of its broken wings falling onto Clint just as he defeated Ultimo. Clint was taken back to Stark's building to be analysed by H.O.M.E.R., who found that he suffered extreme neurological damage to the lumbar region of his spine. With a 99% chance of total paralysis and a 73% chance of death, Tony blamed himself for what happened. He recalled of a neuro-chip developed by Stark Enterprises in Europe, a device that had been 97% effective at restoring motor activity to victims with severe spinal trauma. However, there was no known medical technique for reaching the area of the spine affected, with any surgical attempts almost certainly resulting in immediate death. Tony theorized that if he could re-program the Molecular Expander for reverse polarity, he could shrink himself to the size of an atom and save Hawkeye. A glitching H.O.M.E.R. told him that, even if this worked, he would need to leave Hawkeye's body within 118 minutes, otherwise he'd be crushed.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 6 001.png|thumb|left|Iron Man travels through Hawkeye's body]]
The device successfully reduced his size and he changed into the Hydro Armor to grab the neuro-chip. Subsequently entering Clint's body via a syringe injection into his bloodstream. Not wanting to risk firing his thrusters inside of Hawkeye, he struggled to traverse against his blood current and entered his heart chamber. Trying to escape, he accidentally jammed one of Clint's, giving him a heart attack. Iron Man activated his Magnetic Armor to generate an electrical charge in the valve, stabilising Clint and freeing himself in the process. His guidance system lead him into Hawkeye's liver, which began absorbing his armor. H.O.M.E.R. continued to glitch, forcing Tony to make his own way through the liver with his Lava Armor. After leaving, he reverted back to the Hydro Armor. While Iron Man made his way to Hawkeye's brain through the carotid artery, a compromised H.O.M.E.R. shut down Stark's defences. Julia soon realised that H.O.M.E.R. had a virus and began searching for the anti-virus program intended to be shown in Detroit. Ultimo broke through the roof of the building, with the Molecular Expander shrinking him down. Julia successfully installed the anti-virus program as Iron Man made it to Hawkeye's brain. With H.O.M.E.R. fixed, he revealed that Tony only had 9.5 minutes to leave Hawkeye, as opposed to the 2 hours he stated earlier. Iron Man located the spinal injury just as Ultimo entered the body.

The neuro-chip's implantation process was a success, but Ultimo shortly arrived to soon after. Iron Man led him away from the injury, with their fight affecting Clint's motor functions along the way. Changing into the Radiation Armor, he shot at Ultimo's eyes and pushed him into Hawkeye's adrenal gland. Blasting the gland caused Ultimo to be electrocuted and shutdown. With only two minutes left before resizing, Iron Man grabbed Ultimo's body and headed towards the lungs. He told Julia to find some pepper and shake it near Clint's nostrils. Hawkeye then sneezed, allowing Tony to escape his body. He and Ultimo were resized, with Julia kissing him before quickly moving back. Ultimo briefly reactivated and attacked them both. With the Iron Man Armor at low power, Julia fought him. Hawkeye then shot an arrow into the giant's right shoulder, causing it to shutdown once more. Iron Man and Hawkeye later confronted [[Hacker (Earth-534834)|The Hacker]], the person responsible for reactivating Ultimo and H.O.M.E.R.'s glitching. They used a computer-generated video to trick him into believing Ultimo was still active and had defeated them both. The Hacker turned out to be a teenager, disgruntled over the fact that his application to Stark Enterprises' computer science division was rejected six times due to his age. The boy was arrested by the police and Tony tried to amend his relationship with Hawkeye. Clint was hesitant to shake his hand, but thanked him for saving his life.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 6}}

===Dark Aegis===
After checking his vital signals, Tony and HOMER analysed the adaptational feature in the Iron Man Armor while the former exercised on a treadmill. After changing it into the Samurai Armor, there was a 10% depletion in his energy core. The armor then struggled to change into the Radiation Armor, with a 13% depletion. HOMER was distressed by the power drains, with Tony sharing similar concerns. Before they could continue, Rhodey arrived to tell Tony that a UFO had been discovered, with HOMER finding that it would impact Malibu in 14 minutes, 10 seconds. Tony used the Space Armor to head towards its position, with the energy core dropped at an additional 10% below acceptable standards. HOMER warned Tony not to use the armor further, but he ignored it and continued to head towards the UFO. As he grabbed it, his systems shut down and he was sent back into the Earth's stratosphere. Rhodey came to assist Iron Man in a chopper, firing a net at the UFO and allowing Tony to grab on to the helicopter. Stark and Julia later investigated the ship, discovering a message by Jessik, the monarch of Elysian. Jessik begged for Iron Man's help in stopping Dark Aegis, whose survival shocked Tony. After reviewing footage of his last encounter with the villain, Julia tried to tell Tony that he wasn't blame Aegis' actions on Elysian. While he couldn't stop thinking about it, his mood was lifted when she made a passing joke that he was no [[Steven Rogers (Earth-534834)|Captain America]]. The two prepared to kiss, but were interrupted by HOMER, who asked if they were doing facial inspections. HOMER found that the ship had only launched yesterday. It was able to do so because its propulsion system was equipped with Space Fold Module. With the ship pre-set to return to Elysian in 2 hours, Tony chose to go to the planet and confront Dark Aegis.

On his way to the ship, Rhodey decided to wear the War Machine Armor and come with Tony. Julia then contacted them both, noting a unaccounted weight differential of 1,270 pounds and movement in the cargo bay. Before they could investigate, the ship launched. While travelling through space, they checked the ship to look for the unaccounted figure. War Machine discovered that the figure was [[Boris Bullski (Earth-534834)|Titanium Man]], who had previously been hurled into space by the two.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 1 1}} He swiftly dealt with both of them, used a laser to create a hole in the ship, and sent Rhodey into space. Iron Mam changed into his Space Armor to rescue War Machine, but Titanium Man grabbed him, telling him that he was needed. He resisted and used three claws to stab into Titanium Man's armor, continuing to go after Rhodey. As War Machine drew close to one of two suns, Iron Man changed into his Inferno Armor to save him.  With his energy levels down, he chose to slingshot his way around the suns to Elysian. After landing, they found that the planet was decimated by Aegis and filled with toxic air. Tony then had to calm down a distressed Rhodey, who was still uncomfortable with wearing his armor. With his core level lowering and the ship destroyed, Iron Man searched the area for survivors while he told War Machine to find the Space Fold Module, in the hopes that he could adapt it to take them home.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) and Dark Aegis (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 7 001.png|thumb|right|Iron Man confronts Dark Aegis]]
While searching, Iron Man found Dark Aegis, who continued destroying the planet. He demanded to know why Aegis decimated Elysian, but he asked why Iron Man went after him, sighting "the need" as the answer to both questions. Tony argued that he came over feeling responsibility and then asked why Titanium Man worked for him. Aegis explained that he promised to arm him an Oracle weapon, in exchange for bringing Iron Man to Elysian. Aegis intentions were not to harm Iron Man, but instead "elevate" him to a higher power. He believed that they were destined to march side by side, like brothers in armor. After obliterating a nearby moon, he offered Iron Man an Oracle weapon to destroy another. Tony refused and argued that all life had value, even Aegis' twisted one. Aegis was disappointed in Iron Man, but believed that he was merely transitioning from a hero to an almighty god. He then offered that both of them destroy the two suns, which would devastate Elysian's solar system. 

As Aegis demanded he take the weapon, Tony realised that he needed him, as it would take the highest settings of two Oracle weapons to destroy the suns; Titanium Man's Russian energy core was too outdated to handle the weapons as it would sizzle and burn in seconds. Tony once more refused to take the weapon, enraging Aegis and causing a fight between the two. Both War Machine and Titanium Man assisted with Iron Man in the fight. With all three continuing their attack, the Oracle's force field prevented it from firing. With the force field broken, Aegis fired missiles at them and tried to escape in his ship. Feeling regret for his actions, Titanium Man chose to sacrifice himself to amend for his sins. Tony encouraged his redemption and Titanium Man gave him the Space Fold Module before flying into Aegis's ship. He watched as the ship exploded, with Titanium Man and Dark Aegis still fighting inside. Using the module, Tony and Rhodey returned to Earth, commenting that Titanium Man had died with honor. Reuniting with Julia, he remarked that a little sabbatical would be nice as the two kissed. Rhodey then came into the room, asking if Tony could fix a piece of his chest plate, being more open to wearing the War Machine Armor again. When Rhodey asked what was wrong with them, HOMER questioned if they were doing more facial inspection. Rhodey replied that it had been too long since he had one himself, with HOMER joking that, "At least you can have one." Both Julia and Tony laughed at the comment, with HOMER joining them.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 7}}

===The Armor Wars===
S.H.I.E.L.D. asked Iron Man for help when former Soviet Union soldiers, accompanied by Crimson Dynamo, attacked a Russian missile base to try to nuke Moscow and frame the West for its destruction. When arriving, he engaged in a rematch with Dynamo. HOMER noted that the Crimson Dynamo Armor had been recently improved, when Tony questioned how, a heat-seeking missile was targeted at him. He activated his armor's refrigeration system, redirecting the missile to target Dynamo. Crimson Dynamo chose to take his own life by directing the missile to a recently opened nuclear silo, Iron Man changed into his Radiation Armor just before the blast hit him. The nuclear explosion created a radioactive cloud that spread around Russia, causing thousands of citizens to be poisoned and sent to hospitals for care. The majority of the blame and anger was focused on Iron Man, with the UN choosing to condemn him and the Russian government framing it as an isolated battle between him and Crimson Dynamo. 

Nick Fury went to a frustrated and regretful Tony to give the remains of the Crimson Dynamo Armor. Upon analysing it, he discovered that the armor had somehow been modified with his own designs, increasing his guilt and anger. When Rhodey and Julia check on him, he ordered HOMER to withhold the information, choosing to combat the situation on his own. Speculating that the Iron Man technology had been stolen by others, he tried to use his lawyers for assistance. Since Stark didn't have a patent, as doing so would make the technology public knowledge, he couldn't pursue legal action. Days after, Julia and Rhoey once again tried help him, but he shut them out. After they left, HOMER completed the tests for his new Negator Packs, designed to disable his stolen technology. Tony told HOMER to generate a list of every know armored warrior, planning to confront them all.

Later, he went to the Center for the Achievement of Eternal Bliss, where he found [[Basil Sandhurst (Earth-534834)|The Controller]] attempting mind-control a group of executives to steal their financial assets. The Controller then ordered the mind-controlled minions to destroy Iron Man, though he blasted the weapons out of their hands. When two of them tried to grab him, he pushed them to the ground. Iron Man then engaged in a fight with The Controller, defeating him and placing a Negator Pack on his chest. From there, he went on to place Negator Packs onto [[Abner Jenkins (Earth-534834)|Beetle]] at the Museum of Modern Art, [[Wilbur Day (Earth-534834)|Stilt Man]] in a city, and then [[Marco Scarlotti (Earth-534834)|Blacklash]] and [[Gregor Shapanka (Earth-534834)|Blizzard]] on an airplane.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834), Clinton Barton (Earth-534834) and Mandroid Armor (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 8 001.jpg|thumb|left|Confronted by Hawkeye and Mandroids]]
Iron Man's actions were criticised by the public, due to his disregard for the safety of innocent bystanders. Despite this, Tony continued his quest and infiltrated the [[Vault (Prison)|Vault]], believing the [[Mandroids (Earth-534834)|Mandroids]]' armor may contain his stolen technology. He placed a sleeping gas into the Vault's ventilation system, causing a guard and the imprisoned villains to lose consciousness. After entering the Vault, Iron Man was caught by the Mandroids and Hawkeye, who'd taken a leave of absence from Force Works. After defeating the guards, he redirected Clint's electrical arrow back towards him and placed Negator Packs on the Mandroids' armor. He apologised to Hawkeye, who told him that he was crazy, which he accepted may be the case. 

Fury confronted Stark over Iron Man's actions and told him that if he didn't deal with Iron Man, S.H.I.E.L.D. would permanently shut down Stark Enterprises. Tony decided to hold a press conference, during which his heart suffered from the pressure he'd built up. He framed Iron Man as going rogue, declaring him to be a fugitive and firing him from Stark Enterprises. While at his beach house, Tony's heart continued to suffer from the pressure when Julia called out to him. Julia confronted him over the press conference and asked why he continued to keep pushing the people who cared most about him away. She also brought up that he'd jerked her around during their wedding and told him if his actions were worth it. Tony replied that he didn't know and once more shut her out.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 8}}

Iron Man later pursued [[Walter Newell (Earth-534834)|Stingray]] at a restricted U.S. Navy area, believing that he was using his stolen technology. When fighting the Naval Command Officer, he used his Hydro Armor to fire a sonic blast at him underwater, causing falling rocks to land on Stingray. Taking him back to land, he placed a Negator Pack on him, only to find out that Stingray hadn't used his technology. Immediately realising what he'd done, Rhodey arrived in the War Machine Armor to confront him. Tony quickly realised that the War Machine Armor was one of his designs and attacked Rhodey. Rambling to himself that he couldn't stop his quest, he almost drowned Rhodey, before HOMER told him what he was doing. Regaining some sense of rationality, Iron Man continued the fight in the air. He changed into the Stealth Armor to overpower Rhodey before placing the Negator Pack onto the War Machine Armor, continuing to justify his actions as being for the greater good. He promptly left Rhodey with the unconscious Stingray.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 9 001.jpg|thumb|right|Fighting Firepower]]
When watching Hammer Corporations' demonstration of [[Firepower]] on a television, Tony realised that Justin Hammer was the one responsible for stealing his armor and went to destroy his new machine. Arriving at Hammer's trap, Iron Man was shot at by Firepower. Julia tried to talk sense into Tony via radio, but he cut her off. Firepower proceeded to fire a missile at him, causing his heart rate to increase. Moving erratically to compromise Firepower's systems, Ieon Man managed to land behind the machine and placed a Negator Pack on its left leg. The pack failed to work on Firepower, as Hammer had found a way to neutralize their effects, allowing the machine to continue operating. Tony tried to escape, but another missile hit him, damaging his armor and breaking two of his ribs. As continuing to fight could result in death, Tony set the Armor to remote control and allowed it to be destroyed by Firepower. 

Faking his death once more, Tony contacted Julia as he evaded the military. Rhodey later arrived in a chopper to pick him up on the Interstate 5 outside Camp Pendleton. Back at Stark Enterprises, HOMER analysed that Tony had broken ribs, extensive bruises and hematomas, with multiple symptoms of neural and cardiovascular dysfunction. Tony confessed to his friends that his actions had ultimately solved nothing and planned to stop being Iron Man. Both Rhodey and Julia were angered by his actions and he admitted that he was wrong. Tony asked for their forgives and while Julia was initially hesitant, a joke from HOMER broke the tension between them. With his plans to put Iron Man in the past, he believed that Stark Enterprises could continue business as usual. As Firepower continued to attack Stark Enterprises, investors began selling their stock in the company. Using a cane to get to his car, Tony was approached by Nick Fury, who recognised that Hammer was responsible for the attacks. Knowing that Iron Man survived, Fury encouraged Tony to fight against Firepower, or else his company would continue to suffer. 

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 9 002.jpg|thumb|left|Iron Man's Exo Armor]]
After a few days, Tony had finished working on a new Exo Armor to fight Hammer's machine. Finding Firepower at the construction site of the Stark Business Plaza, Iron Man used his new armor to fight the robot. As Firepower armed itself with a limited-yield neutron bomb warhead, aiming to destroy the construction site of Stark Towers. Tony pushed Firepower into a wall and exited the Exo Armor to neutralise the still-active bomb. When he failed to find the code, he simply destroyed the keypad just two seconds before the bomb exploded. Tony then used his armor to access Firepower's database. Confronting Hammer, he told him that S.H.I.E.L.D. and Stark would be heading a task force to explain his actions, but couldn't prove that Hammer was responsible for stealing the Iron Man technology or Firepower attacking Stark property. However, Iron Man had brought a drive with him that he then used to install a computer virus into Hammer's computer, destroying all records of the technology stolen. He had done so with the internet as well, and told Hammer that he'd erased everything else in Hammer Industries' computers. Back at the beach house, Tony reiterated that his previous actions were wrong, that by trying to prevent the pain of others, he hurt the people closest to him. Julia then kissed him on the head and told him to rest.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 9}}

===Empowered===
When [[George Tarleton (Earth-534834)|M.O.D.O.K.]] robbed a local bank, Iron Man arrived to the scene, discovering that he'd recently acquired one of Mandarin's rings. M.O.D.O.K. fired at the bank's roof, with the debris falling onto Stark and allowing him to escape. Tony used his damaged armor to escape through the sewage system and open a manhole cover, though he found that M.O.D.O.K. had already escaped. While recharging, he grew irritated over his defeat at M.O.D.O.K.'s hands, with the possibility rings surviving the defeat of the Makluans never even occurring to him. HOMER failed to detect M.O.D.O.K.'s location due to a storm, making his ship's ion trail difficult to track. Though he assumed M.O.D.O.K. may have hid himself somewhere in the San Jacinto mountain range. Iron Man rushed towards the area, with HOMER later pinpointing his last known whereabouts. M.O.D.O.K.'s mountain base exploded just as he made his way towards the locations, throwing him off course. Viewing the destroyed mountain, he was left with a feeling that his problems had only just begun.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 10}}

===The Hulk===
Iron Man, Rhodey and Julia investigated a phenomenon of light beams originating from the desert. A police sheriff informed them that [[Bruce Banner (Earth-534834)|Dr. Bruce Banner]] was analysing them. Stark had previously supplied Banner with the materials and funds to make his gamma reactor, which ultimately lead to disastrous results.{{r|Incredible Hulk (1996 animated series) Season 1 4}} A beam trapped Bruce on a ridge, immediately striking Julia's position soon after. Iron Man tired to grab Julia as she fell, but a second blast caused her to disappear before his very eyes. Believing her to be dead, he saved falling Bruce and told him to stay below ground level. Tracking the beams found that they had originated from one of Mandarin's rings. Bruce told him to keep it from the sun, with solar energy powering it.

After Banner found that the encased gemstone was creating gaps in the electromagnetic field, resulting in temporal gaps, Tony realised that Julia must have been sent back in time. The ring was then stolen by the [[Samuel Sterns (Earth-534834)|Leader]]'s drones, leading both to search for hiom in a chopper piloted by Rhodey. Fearing for Julia's safety, Tony regretted the fact that he'd never really told her how he felt, but Rhodey comforted him by saying she knew. When faced with the Leader's defences, Bruce's anger overcame him, revealing him to be the Hulk. Iron Man followed Hulk into the Leader's base, where it was subsequently destroyed. With Hulk grabbing one of the rings out of the Leader's hands, he tried to destroy it. Tony tried to stop him, causing the sun to shine on the ring and send them both back to a time with dinosaurs. Hulk tried to throw the ring into a volcano, only for Iron Man to activate his Lava Armor to grab it and descend into the lava. Rising back up, he grabs Hulk and journeys to another period in time.

Hulk misunderstood his intentions, believing that Iron Man intended on hurting him. Tony explained that he was trying to save Julia to the Hulk, considering them both innocent in the situation. As Hulk began to give him the ring, the sun appeared, with Iron Man's attempts at blocking it causing Hulk to believe he was tricked. They were then teleported to a snowy environment, where Tony finally found Julia clinging onto the other side of the area. Iron Man flew in to save her, only to be stopped by Hulk, with the sun appearing once more, they were teleported away. Julia was left behind, being saved by Rhodey from a falling meteor. The Leader then cut the time rift between her and the present, sending Julia to Iron Man and Hulk's position. Hulk tore of the left arm of the Iron Man Armor, before realising that they had been sent back to be the site where Banner had been struck by gamma radiation. Iron Man tried to convince Hulk that they could prevent the event by saving the past Banner and [[Richard Jones (Earth-534834)|Rick Jones]], enraging him, as doing so would prevent his creation.

[[File:Bruce Banner (Earth-534834) and Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 11 002.jpg|thumb|right|Iron Man fights the Hulk]]
With another time rift opened, Rhodey gave him the heavy demolition Exo Armor, upgraded into the Hulkbuster Armor. With the armor, Iron Man had one final battle with the Hulk. A time-travelling Leader then tried to take the ring from Julia, holding her hostage. While she freed herself, Hulk sent him back into the time rift, his whereabouts left ambiguous. Tony attempted to prevent Banner's fate, but the Hulk grabbed onto him. With the rift closing, he apologised to the past Bruce and pushed the Hulk back into the present with him and Julia. With the Hulk reverting back into Banner, he apologised for his actions, but the understanding Iron Man and Julia told him that it wasn't his fault. With Bruce's identity as the Hulk now revealed, Tony took off his mask and told him that he wouldn't tell his secret if Banner didn't tell his. Bruce thanked him as he left with Rhodey to the infirmary. Left alone with Julia, he confessed his love for her and the two kissed.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 11}}

===Final Battle with the Mandarin===
Just as Tony was about to test a surveillance missile, Rhodey informed him that the Mandarin had returned. Planning to land at the John F. Kennedy International Airport, HOMER informed him that all communication with New York City had been shut down. A fog, later identified as an anti-technology field, then engulfed New York and Tony used his Hydro Armor to investigate. As soon as he entered [[Manhattan]], he lost power and reverted back to his standard armor, falling into a building and left stranded. If he remained inside the field for 2 hours, he would die due to a lack of life support. Hawkeye would later pick him up, using his glider and arrow skills to traverse through the city. As they set off, the wind damaged the left side of Clint's glider, with Tony using his armor to keep the wing stable. Stark decided to reunite with Force Works and used one of his jets to confront the [[Hand (Earth-534834)|Hand]] in [[Hong Kong]], consisting of Blacklash, Blizzard, Hypnotia and [[David Cannon (Earth-534834)|Whirlwind]]. After watching a news report of the group, he deduced they were affiliated with the Mandarin. Joining Force Works once more, he was particularly glad to have Wanda and her hex powers again, only for Julia to tell her that she should have backup plans if Tony ever asked her to marry him. He then had to stop an argument between War Machine and Hawkeye, stating that Clint was justified for leaving and that Rhodey was a true friend for staying. 

As they got to Hong Kong, Force Works begun their battle with the Hand. Hypnotia briefly forced Iron Man and War Machine to fight, but they stopped once Rhodey was affected by the anti-technology fog. Tony tried to get them both to safety, but the fog caught up to them and they fell to the ground. They were subsequently attacked by Blacklash, Blizzard and Whirlwind, but were saved by the rest of Force Works. Hypnotia's second attack was thwarted by Century's arrival. After tying up the Hand, Century mind linked with Hypnotia and discovered that the Mandarin was using the [[Heart of Darkness (Mandarin)|Heart of Darkness Crystal]] to create the anti-technology field. The Mandarin planned to place the field around the entire Earth, with the Crystal de-powering all of society once it accumulated sufficient energy. As the fog continued to spread, Iron Man searched for the Crystal and the Mandarin.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 12 002.jpg|thumb|left|Defeated by the Mandarin]]
Tony located them in a citadel and quickly defeated M.O.D.O.K. Upon seeing the Mandarin, he asked HOMER to get some readings on the Crystal, detecting Alien technology which appeared to feed on bioenergetic fields and finding that it had tremendous destructive potential. Mandarin then redirected the negation field from Hong Kong to the citadel, causing both Tony and M.O.D.O.K. to lose power. Iron Man tried to fight back, but was overpowered and brought to his knees. The Mandarin grabbed his helmet and liquified it, discovering that Tony Stark and Iron Man were the same. As Force Works arrived in his jet, the Mandarin tricked them into flying into the citadel's anti-technology field by using Tony's voice. Tony tried to tell Rhodey not to fly in, but his words were unable to reach him and the Mandarin mocked him.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 12}}

Tony was then strapped to a x-shaped plank of wood and was forced to watch as the jet crash into the citadel. While all of Force Works survived, they were swiftly defeated by the Mandarin, though Rhodey had been separated from the rest of the group and found his way into the citadel's sewage system. As a weakened M.O.D.O.K. and the Mandarin strapped the Force Works members to thrones surrounding the Heart of Darkness, Rhodey freed Tony from his restraints. While he initially tried to free the rest of the team, Tony told him that they currently weren't powerful enough to fight the Mandarin. He told Rhodey to get them out of the citadel and take him Stark Enterprises, Hong Kong. M.O.D.O.K. initially halted them, but agreed to let them escape when they promised to restore his life support.

After leaving the citadel, Tony and Rhodey traversed through the desert, only to be attacked by mountain bandits. While running from them, the War Machine Armor's power was restored, allowing him to fight off the bandits and fly Tony to Hong Kong. At Stark Enterprises, Hong Kong, Rhodey met with [[Su Yin (Earth-534834)|Su Yin]] and allowed Tony to recover. Yin revealed that Tony and her had recently completed years of collaboration on a prototype of a bioenergy microprocessor, currently installed into a new Iron Man armor. While not tested outside of the lab, if it worked, it would restore Tony to full health and allow him to enter Mandarin's anti-technology field. Mandarin used the combined powers of the captured Force Works members to extend his negator field to the citadel and Hong Kong, betraying the Hand to further extend it to the entire world. This affected Stark Enterprises' Hong Kong building, with a helicopter crashing into its entrance, causing a fire. Su Yin tried to connect Tony to his new armor, but the DNA-based circuitry was still in a state of stasis, requiring infrared heat in order to activate. As the building shut down, the fire began to spread and caused an explosion upon contact with some canisters. The flames' heat stimulated the armor's bioprocessors, allowing it to jump-start.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-534834) from Iron Man The Animated Series Season 2 13 001.jpg|thumb|right|Iron Man's new armor]]
Attaching his helmet, Tony cleared a way through the flames, taking Rhodey and Yin to safety. Before returning to the citadel, Su Yin told him of a time-honored Eastern martial arts principle: to overcome your enemy, turn his own energy back on itself. When he asked how, she told him to use a time-honored Western principle: improvise. Iron Mam broke through the citadel, just as Mandarin used the Crystal to spread his field across the entire planet. As they fought, Tony realised that the Mandarin still overpowered him. As the Mandarin struck him, he was reminded of the Eastern principle from Su Yin and clung onto Hawkeye. This short circuited Hawkeye's throne and allowed Iron Mam to free Clint. As Hawkeye distracted Mandarin, Stark started to free Scarlet Witch as well. While being pushed back by the Mandarin, Hawkeye was able to remove the rest of Wanda's straps. Initially, Tony asked Hawkeye to come up with a plan on how ton defeat the Mandarin. As Clint started planning, Stark quickly stopped him and moved onto his plan; improvise. Placing himself on one of the thrones linked to the Heart of Darkness, Iron Man had Wanda absorb the Mandarin's energy to destroy the Crystal, disintegrating five of the Mandarin's rings in the process. With the Heart of Darkness destroyed, power was restored to the entire world and the Mandarin escaped. M.O.D.O.K. emerged from a piece of rubble, leading Tony to ask why he continued to serve the Mandarin, with the constant abuse he suffered. M.O.D.O.K. claimed that the Mandarin made him laugh, liking him. Tony agreed, but only behind bars. 

Iron Man tracked the Mandarin down for one final battle, discovering him in an Exo-Armor. He called out the Mandarin for his hypocrisy in using technology, but the Mandarin explained that, while he was anti-technology, he was not a fanatic. Tony gained the upper hand once he blasted one of Mandarin's thrusters, allowing him to damage the chest piece. With the remaining rings' power linked to the Exo-Armor circuitry, the armor exploded and sent the Mandarin to a nearby mountain. While he initially presumed the Mandarin to be atomized in the blast, he later heard his screams as he was attacked by the mountain bandits, confirming the Mandarin survived, at least, for a while longer. When meeting up with Hawkeye, Tony said that it felt like old times at Force Works. He'd finally that he wasn't the only superhero in town and didn't have to face everything by himself. When Julia arrived, they kissed just as Rhodey noticed the power had returned, complaining about his bumpy travel to the citadel. Tony remarked that it was a bumpy road for everyone, with a lot of surprises and rewards along the way. He embraced Julia under the night's sky as they kissed once more.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 13}}

===A cure for Banner===
Bruce Banner fled to [[Hollywood]] in hopes that Tony could help cure him, as he tried to call him, the bridge he was standing on broke. Rick Jones later went to Stark Enterprises to meet Tony while he was recharging, being brought in by War Machine. Tony played the phone call from Bruce to Rick, 20 minutes after he'd received it. As Rick asked where they could find him, he was startled by HOMER appearing, who'd found that the call originated from an emergency call box at 5th and Thomas. Rick immediately ran to the area, as HOMER prepared the Iron Man Armor. After Bruce suffered amnesia from the fall, he threw Rick towards one of the bridge's pillars, only to be saved by Iron Man. Tony engaged in a rematch with the Hulk, protecting Rick from him. When Hulk threw a scrap magnet at Iron Man, it shut down his repulsors and put his energy core at dangerous levels.

Rick managed to calm the Hulk, reminding him of their friendship, and he transformed back into Banner. Bruce was taken to Stark Enterprises' infirmary, where Tony reunited with him. After explaining what happened to the recovering Banner, he offered to try and cure him. Tony began work on the possible cure, replacing several outdated components in Bruce's design, primarily the gamma filters. He told Bruce that he would have to put him into stasis sleep and artificially induce his Hulk state in order to purge the gamma mutations. Bruce agreed the the procedure. [[Thaddeus Ross (Earth-534834)|General Thaddeus Ross]]' army, along with [[Gabriel Jones (Earth-534834)|Gabriel Jones]], began to surround Stark Enterprises. Tony told Rhodey to place the building's auto-security to level 10, then telling HOMER to continue the gamma purge. Tony contacted Ross and demanded he leave, defending Bruce from him. Ross refused to leave and ordered his [[Hulkbusters (US Military) (Earth-534834)|Hulkbusters]] to move in.

Stark's security defences combated the army as the work on the cure continued on. However, Bruce's mutagenics remained stable, his mutated DNA manufacturing defences against the purging. As Bruce transformed into the Hulk, Ross' forces were breaching Stark's defences and he ordered [[Glenn Talbot (Earth-534834)|Talbot]] to blow up his breakers. The blast caused the building to lose power briefly, before converting to the alternate grid. Tony sent War Machine out to defend the backup generators. Rhodey was unable to stop the army from firing one of their missiles at the generators, causing all power to be lost and allowing Ross and Jones' forces to move in. With power levels down at 70%, an amnesiac Hulk escaped the containment chamber. Tony used one of his Hulkbuster Armors to fight against the Hulk as Ross' own Hulkbusters went into the building.

Rick used a hand from one of the Iron Man armors to help War Machine fight of the Hulkbusters, while Tony attempted to restrain the Hulk. The Hulk grabbed hold of his leg while it was in the air and proceeded to crush the Hulkbuster. Iron Man escaped in his primary armor just as the Hulkbuster Armor was destroyed. Hulk was then trapped inside of a cage and sent out of the building via one of Ross' helicopters, Rick grabbed onto the cage as Iron Man and War Machine fought the Hulkbusters. Rick tried to break the cage open, only for him to receive an electrical shot and fall; Iron Man was able to grab him as he fell. Hulk, remembering Rick to be his friend, broke the cage open and went to check on him. Iron Man told him to escape with a hurt Rick, allowing him and War Machine to destroy all remaining Hulkbusters in the building. Iron Man claimed that the Hulk died in a lab explosion to Ross, while the general was unconvinced, he chose not to search him. Before they left, he asked Ross and Gabriel Jones if he should submit the bill of damages to S.H.I.E.L.D. or the Pentagon. HOMER calculated the damage caused to Stark Enterprises and deduced that helping Banner wasn't cost effective. Tony disagreed, arguing that there was nothing more valuable than friendship.{{r|Incredible Hulk (1996 animated series) Season 1 4}}

===The Avengers===
[[File:Avengers (Earth-534834) from Fantastic Four (1994 animated series) Season 2 6 0001.jpg|thumb|left|Iron Man with the Avengers]]
At a later point in time, Iron Man joined the [[Avengers (Earth-534834)|Avengers]], with former Force Works ally Hawkeye also joining (now under the alias "Goliath"). He was present with the team as New York City suffered an intense earthquake. When [[Reed Richards (Earth-534834)|Mister Fantastic]] failed to save a falling civilian, Iron Man flew in and grabbed them. Reed thanked him for the assistance, to which he gave a thumbs up in response. As the Avengers continued with their rescue operations, they noticed a sky fire, later revealed to have been generated by [[Thor Odinson (Earth-534834)|Thor]]'s hammer, [[Mjolnir|Mjonir]], following his defeat by [[Egros (Earth-534834)|Ego the Living Planet]].{{r|Fantastic Four (1994 animated series) Season 2 6}} When [[Victor von Doom (Earth-534834)|Doctor Doom]] stole the [[Norrin Radd (Earth-534834)|Silver Surfer]]'s board, Tony and his company helped with the manufacturing of Reed's [[Anti-Cosmic Flying Wing]] to combat him. Iron Man was present with [[Hercules Panhellenios (Earth-534834)|Hercules]] and [[Jennifer Walters (Earth-534834)|She-Hulk]] as Reed ordered [[Crystalia Amaquelin (Earth-534834)|Crystal]] to send the device towards the Earth's stratosphere, activating [[Galan (Earth-534834)|Galactus]]' cosmic barrier and defeating Doom.{{r|Fantastic Four (1994 animated series) Season 2 13}}

**In ''Fantastic Four'' Season 1, Iron Man used the former design with additional yellow weapons attached to his arms and right shoulder.{{r|Fantastic Four (1994 animated series) Season 1 13}} When Iron Man appeared in ''Fantastic Four'' Season 2, his armor was based on the latter design, but with gold legs and red knees.{{r|Fantastic Four (1994 animated series) Season 2 6}}
* Tony likes pepper on his popcorn.{{r|Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 2 6}}
* In [[Fantastic Four (1994 animated series) Season 1 12|"Behold the Negative Zone"]], a boy is seen wearing a yellow T-shirt with a picture of Iron Man on it. The helmet design resembles the one from the [[Iron Man Armor Model 12]] and Model 13.

| History                 = Born in 1938, this world's '''Tony Stark''' was a lackluster student whose father owned a failing [[Stark Industries (Earth-555)|Stark Industries]]. After the "Fireworks" (a minor version of the [[White Event]]) 1953, Stark began designing "technology five years ahead of everything everyone else" was developing on. At age 16 he was recruited into an early-admission program at [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology|M.I.T.]], where he spent more time drinking than doing assignments, yet he would show up for every test and ace them. 

In 1959, the plane he was riding in crashed in [[Vietnam]] and he was taken captive by North Vietnamese troops. Held for nearly a week, he escaped on his own to South Vietnam wearing a mechanical suit he designed from spare parts. Returning to the US, he was held at a naval base in [[San Diego]] so he could be interrogated. There, he was visited by [[National Security Agency|NSA]] agents [[Philip Voight (Earth-555)|Philip Voight]] and [[Joe Swann (Earth-555)|Joe Swann]] who believed his powers were connected to the Fireworks event. Confirming this, Voight walked behind Stark and shot him through the skull, killing him.{{r|Newuniversal 1959 Vol 1 1}}

| Powers                  = '''Superhuman Intelligence:''' After having his intelligence augmented by the White Event, Stark was capable of designing super-advanced devices, including a toy car made out of foil the size of his thumb that was capable of going 100 MPH and a mechanical suit made out of spare parts that enabled him to battle an army of North Vietnamese troops.

| History                 = The history of how this Anthony Stark became Iron Man is identical to that of his Earth-616 counterpart. At some point between becoming a superhero and his first appearance, he joined the [[Avengers (Earth-5631)|Avengers]].

When [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-5631)|A.I.M.]] broke into one of his facilities using security codes stolen by [[Anthony Masters (Earth-5631)|Taskmaster]], and stole a prototype for a new Iron Man armor, Tony investigated. Unbeknown to him, the young superhero team named [[Power Pack (Earth-5631)|Power Pack]] was also on the trail of the stolen armor. They found it first, but then [[Jonathan Power (Earth-5631)|Jack Power]] decided to try the new armor himself, accidently activating it. This caused Tony to mistake him for the thief and fight him, disabling the stolen suit by using the override protocol. When the mistake was cleared up, Tony and Power Pack teamed up against A.I.M. and defeated them.

Some time later however, it turned out that A.I.M. had already reverse engineered the stolen suit enough to replicate it, and that they were working for [[Nathaniel Richards (Kang) (Earth-5631)|Kang the Conqueror]]. Along with the Avengers and Power Pack, Tony fought against Kang and his army. At Jack's suggestion Tony tried his override protocol against the A.I.M. soldiers and discovered it to be working since A.I.M. had apparently failed to remove this security program from the suits when replicating them. However, Tony was incapacitated by Kang before he could take out the other suits. He was saved from the villain when Power Pack, after a trip to an alternate future, defeated both Kang and his army.

Tony was also among the various heroes that responded to the Hulk's rampage in New York after a battle with the Abomination. With Power Pack's help, they were able to calm Hulk down.

The paths of Tony and the Power Pack crossed again when [[Ghost (Earth-5631)|The Ghost]] broke into [[Stark Tower]] and released [[Ultimo (Earth-5631)|Ultimo]] to aid in his escape. He stole a cyber-neural interface chip. Tony and Power Pack defeated Ultimo, but the Ghost escaped and delivered it to [[Phillip Masters (Earth-5631)|Puppet Master]].

When [[Donald Gill (Earth-5631)|Blizzard]] and [[James Sanders (Earth-5631)|Speed Demon]] kidnapped Irena Crumb, daughter of Tony's rival and friend Arnold Crumb, Tony offered his help to get her back, once again teaming up with Power Pack. The heroes were able to rescue Irena and capture the villains. In return for their help, Tony supported [[Julie Power (Earth-5631)|Julie Power's]] campaign for a position in the student government.

When Tony donated all his old suits to the New York Museum for their new Superhero Expo, it became clear why Puppet Master had The Ghost steal the cyber-neural interface chip for him; so he could use it in combination with his psychokinetic clay to take control of all the suits and send them on a rampage. With Power Pack's help, Tony was able to stop the rampaging armors, and then track down Puppet Master himself. Using puppets of the four young heroes, Puppet Master turned Power Pack against Tony, forcing him to fight them off. Tony was able to hold them off until he could break Puppet Master's control. With the villain arrested and the threat over, Tony and Power Pack parted ways again. For now.
| Powers                  = Tony Stark has no powers of his own but they are derived from his [[Iron Man Armor]].

| History                = Born to [[Howard Stark (Earth-58163)|Howard]] and Maria Stark, the leaders of [[Stark Industries (Earth-58163)|Stark Industries]], Tony Stark showed remarkable inventiveness from a young age. Working alongside his father, he had already surpassed Howard’s technical skills by sixteen. After a series of missteps, Howard stepped down, leaving Tony in control of the company.

Under Tony's leadership, Stark Industries thrived by developing advanced technology, particularly weapons used in the global fight against mutants. Although not all of his creations were successful, Stark remained at the forefront of technological innovation. As the Mutant-Human war concluded, Tony had nearly completed a prototype suit of armor capable of challenging powerful mutants.

With the war over, Stark’s combat suit designs were repurposed into Robo Death Match, a popular televised sport featuring mechanized combatants. Tony and his father became fierce rivals and top contenders in the game.

The company's biggest success came when it secured the production rights for the [[Sentinels (Earth-58163)|Sentinels]], surpassing rival [[Jason Wyngarde (Earth-58163)|Jason Wyngarde]]. Awarded the contract by [[Erik Magnus (Earth-58163)|Magneto]] and [[Sebastian Shaw (Earth-58163)|Sebastian Shaw]], Stark agreed to hire [[Henry McCoy (Earth-58163)|Beast]] and [[Forge (Earth-58163)|Forge]] to oversee the project. McCoy later collaborated with [[Henry Pym (Earth-58163)|Doctor Pym]] on developing the Vision.

Meanwhile, Tony secretly began developing a new personal suit of armor beneath the Stark Industries complex, intending it for his next entry into Robo Death Match.

| History                 = Little is detailed about Tony Stark's life before the great battle against [[Victor von Doom (Earth-6109)|Dr. Doom]], however it can be assumed to follow much of the same path as [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Iron Man]] of [[Earth-616]] shortly after the [[Decimation]] of the Earth's mutant population.{{r|Marvel: Ultimate Alliance}}

In this universe, [[Stark Industries (Earth-6109)|Stark Industries]] and [[Strategic Hazard Intervention Espionage Logistics Directorate (Earth-6109)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] had a recent falling out due to Stark, for personal reasons, stopping the development of weapons for the organization. Unable to cope with this, S.H.I.E.L.D. filed lawsuits against Stark for contract breaching, while secretly tampering with his tax contributions, making him lose more money than expected in the process. Eventually, Stark won the case.{{r|Marvel: Ultimate Alliance}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-6109) from Marvel Ultimate Alliance 2 005.png|200px|left|thumb|As Tony Stark]]
One of his adventures involved him having to defeat a version of [[Ultimo (Earth-6109)|Ultimo]] sent by The Mandarin which he managed to destroy.

After Dr. Doom's attack to the [[S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier]] UNN Alpha, [[Nicholas Fury (Earth-6109)|Nick Fury]] felt the need of finding a new headquarters for the large team of heroes that was assembled for the occasion since the Helicarrier sustained too much damage to serve as a base. In spite of their late differences, Tony offered his [[Stark Tower]], since it had plenty of facilities to supply the team's needs. He was also responsible for bringing in [[Henry Pym (Earth-6109)|Hank Pym]] and [[Vision (Earth-6109)|Vision]] for technical support, as well as [[Wyatt Wingfoot (Earth-6109)|Wyatt Wingfoot]] to serve as the team's pilot.{{r|Marvel: Ultimate Alliance}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-6109) from Marvel Ultimate Alliance 007.jpg|200px|right|thumb|Iron Man during the [[Ultimate Alliance (Earth-6109)|Ultimate Alliance]] conflict]]
All through the journey against Doom, Iron Man fought many of his old foes, like [[Valentin Shatalov (Earth-6109)|Crimson Dynamo]], [[George Tarleton (Earth-6109)|M.O.D.O.K.]] and [[Mandarin (Earth-6109)|Mandarin]].{{r|Marvel: Ultimate Alliance}}

What is presumably one year after Doom's defeat Iron Man joined Nick Fury's Secret War on [[Latveria]]. A year after that, Latveria retaliated and attacked [[New York City|New York]]. The attack was stopped and as Iron Man and [[Steven Rogers (Earth-6109)|Captain America]] were busy clearing up the in the aftermath, Nick Fury appeared and explained that the attack was his fault and that he was going into hiding. In a fit of rage, Iron Man blasted Fury who turned out to be a life model decoy. After the [[Stamford]] incident, Stark became the leader of the Superhuman Registration movement and battled Captain America's Anti-Registration movement.

[[File:Tony Stark, Peter Parker, Thor Odinson, Reed Richards (Earth-6109).jpg|150px|left|thumb|Leading the [[Superhuman Registration Act]] heroes]]
However, when the nanites that Stark and his team used to control supervillains developed a collective consciousness of their own and started to spread the infection all over the world, Iron Man and Cap decided to temporary throw away their war to save the world. After the nanite threat was eliminated, Stark became a new director of S.H.I.E.L.D. {{r|Marvel: Ultimate Alliance 2}}

Tony was among the heroes and citizens in a refuge from [[Ultron Drones]], which guarded the streets looking for any fugitive, and he provided them enough technology to keep them safe from Ultron.{{r|Age of Ultron Vol 1 1}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-61112) from Age of Ultron Vol 1 1 001.jpg|thumb|left]]

[[Emma Frost (Earth-61112)|Emma Frost]]'s mental powers detected [[Lucas Cage (Earth-61112)|Luke Cage]] in the proximity, who survived an attack from Ultron's forces and managed to get to the Savage Land using a [[Quinjet]], via Frost, he told the heroes Ultron was actually in the future, using [[Vision (Earth-61112)|Vision]] as a conduit to punish humanity. In that moment [[Marc Spector (Earth-61112)|Moon Knight]], [[Natalia Romanova (Earth-61112)|Black Widow]] and [[Thaddeus Ross (Earth-61112)|Red Hulk]] arrived, revealing they had a plan made by [[Nicholas Fury (Earth-61112)|Nick Fury]] to defeat Ultron.{{r|Age of Ultron Vol 1 4}} Tony was one of the heroes who decided to form a team and use one of [[Time Platform]]s to travel to the future and defeat Ultron, but as soon as they got to what was [[Manhattan]], they were overpowered by a huge swarm of Ultron sentinels. His following fate is unknown.{{r|Age of Ultron Vol 1 6}}

| History                 = 
===Hydra Bullies===
When [[Nicholas Fury (Earth-61284)|Nick Fury]] created [[Avengers Academy (Earth-61284)|Avengers Academy]], Tony Stark was the first student to be recruited, upon arriving at the Academy the first thing he did was begin construction of the Academy's very own [[Stark Tower]] so he could keep his way of living and his gadgets while staying at the Academy.

After construction of the Tower, a [[Hydra (Earth-61284)|Hydra]] bully showed up at the Academy and tells Tony that Hydra is going to attack it soon, but he wanted to be the first to beat up the rich kid that has been saying he will take down Hydra. [[Natasha Romanova (Earth-61284)|Black Widow]] then appears out of nowhere and scares the bully off, Tony tries to chat and flirt with her, but she ignores him and tells him to get new recruits to the Academy to beat the incoming Hydra attack and that they would talk about real threats to the Academy afterwards.

Tony is then approached by [[Virginia Potts (Earth-61284)|Administrator Pepper Potts]] and tasked with the recruitment of the Academy's next student, [[Janet Van Dyne (Earth-61284)|Wasp]]. Upon meeting him, Wasp tells him she was going to contact him when she saw the Stark Tower being built at the Academy, but she had wrecked her phone so was unable to. Tony then tells her that the Academy is looking for new superheroes to join and that he can get her a new phone if she joins the Academy and helps them fight Hydra, she accepts his proposal and joins the academy.

After getting Wasp to join the Academy, she proposes that they should build a Blasting Range to train their abilities. Tony says he is having trouble with his aim and he blew up his lab the last time he used his repulsor, so Janet helps him train at the blasting range. After Tony Stark finishes his training he asks Janet how many recruits does she think they need to defeat the Hydra henchmen force that were planning to attack the Academy and take over [[New York City]]. Janet tells him they only need one recruit. Tony is surprised by her answer and wonders who that person is. Administrator Pepper Potts is then contacted by Janet about that person, Administrator Pepper Potts agrees with her and asks her and Tony to recruit the new student, [[Loki Laufeyson (Earth-61284)|Loki]] an immortal [[Asgardians|Asgardian]] sorcerer.

Loki was initially angry at Janet for spreading embarrassing pictures of him on the internet and ruining his reputation. He tells them if they want to recruit him, Janet better apologize to him and they have to somehow fix his reputation. Tony uses his hacking skills to remove all the photos from the internet, while Loki and Wasp work out their issues. He then joins the Academy and helps them beat the Hydra forces.

===Civil War===
After an Hydra Invasion, when arguing whether a [[Ultron (Earth-61284)|robot army]] or training was a better way to defend humanity, Iron Man and [[Steven Rogers (Earth-61284)|Captain America]] split Avengers Academy into two teams. After creating [[Team Iron Man (Earth-61284)|Team Iron Man]], Stark started mass producing [[Ultron (Earth-61284)|Ultron staff bots]].

[[File:Steven Rogers (Earth-61284) and Anthony Stark (Earth 61284) from Marvel Avengers Acaddemy 001.png|thumb|200px|left]]
After numerous weeks of battling Hydra split into two teams, Captain America and Iron Man finally ended their rivalry when Iron Man was able to bring Captain America's friend [[James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-61284)|Bucky]] back to his senses, he had been brainwashed by Hydra and Iron Man was able to built a machine to counter the mind control, they both realized that their rivalry made no sense, and working together was the better solution, united again they defeated Hydra and imprisoned their leader the [[Johann Shmidt (Earth-61284)|Red Skull]].{{r|Marvel Avengers Academy}}

During [[Malekith (Earth-61284)|Malekith]]'s invasion of Earth, by Odin's demand Tony worked as a blacksmith to create weapons to help defeat the [[Dark Elves]] using a special Iron Ore that was particularly effective against them.{{r|Marvel Avengers Academy}}

===Avengers Under Siege===
Iron Man was one of the Avengers Academy students that helped defeat and recapture the villains that were freed from their cages by [[Helmut Zemo (Earth-61284)|Baron Zemo]] after he was manipulated by [[Mephisto (Earth-61284)|Mephisto]] into believing they would serve him if he freed them.{{r|Marvel Avengers Academy}}

===The Future===
Sometime in the future, Iron Man would engage in a battle that would cost him his helmet. His damaged helmet would be thrown into the TimeFog and found in the past.{{r|Marvel Avengers Academy}}
