| History                 = Following [[Reed Richards (Earth-61391)|Reed Richards]]' discovery of a cosmic flare headed toward [[New York City|New York]], Tony Stark moved the city to a pocket dimension to prevent its destruction, ensuring the safety of his family first by sending them ahead. Before he could return everybody, the pocket dimension collapsed, leaving Stark alone in a barren New York for decades. By this time, Stark mastered hard-light constructs that he used as a giant-sized Iron Man Armor. He waited for the arrival of [[Tami (Earth-61391)|Tami]], a time-travelling fangirl of his from further into the future who had antagonized Iron Man two other times throughout his career.

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-61391) from I Am Iron Man Vol 1 1 005.jpg|thumb|left|Using a virtual avatar to fight Tami's automatons]]

When Tami appeared in Tony's time, he deceived her with his constructs, using a virtual avatar of himself pilot his hard-light suit and destroy her clay-like automatons. Tami impaled the fake Tony with a giant sword in turn, prompting her to let her guard down. Stark dropped the pretense and subdued Tami with his hard-light suit, aiming to use the guitar that she used to time-travel to reverse New York's relocation. Manifesting hard-light amplifiers, Tony augmented the guitar's final charge to transport the city from just before it had been sent to the pocket dimension. However, Stark had to sacrifice his chance to reunite with his family since they had been displaced ahead of the rest of the city. Despite Tami warning him about it, Tony chose to prioritize the city itself over his personal desires, tearfully playing Tami's guitar as New York materialized back into existence.{{r|I Am Iron Man Vol 1 1}}

===Early Life===
Some time after [[Thanos (Earth-61893)|Thanos]] assembled the [[Infinity Stones]] in his [[Infinity Gauntlet]], the [[Illuminati (Earth-61893)|Illuminati]] decided to hunt them down in order to keep them safe as they were too powerful to remain at large. They split the Infinity Stones among themselves and vowed never to use them. However, when over eight hundred civilians died during a fight against [[Robert Hunter (Earth-61893)|Nitro]] in [[Stamford]], Stark started to carry the [[Reality Stone]] with him and eventually began to use it to subtly change reality during the [[Civil War|Super Hero Civil War]].

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-61893) from Contest of Champions Vol 1 10 007.jpg|thumb|left|Using the [[Reality Stone]]]]
With the power of the Reality Stone, Tony Stark undid [[William Foster (Earth-61893)|Goliath]]'s murder by the hands of [[Thunderstrike (Earth-61893)|Thunderstrike]] ([[Thor Odinson (Earth-61893)|Thor]]'s cyborg clone) and [[Steven Rogers (Earth-61893)|Steve Rogers]]' assassination at the courthouse steps, as well as manipulating the results of the election to become the president of the [[United States of America|United States]].{{r|Contest of Champions Vol 1 10}}

===Contest of Champions===
Five years after the end of the Civil War, President Stark and his [[Mighty Avengers (Initiative) (Earth-61893)|Mighty Avengers]] attended the presidential parade held in commemoration of the Registration Day when [[Bruce Banner (Earth-69413)|Maestro]], a [[Hulk]] from [[Earth-69413|an alternate universe]], showed up. Using the power of the [[ISO-Sphere]], Maestro took the Mighty Avengers to [[Earth-15513|Battlerealm]] and altered their memories to make them think they were still on [[Earth-61893|their Earth]] confronting a group of unregistered superhumans, while in reality they were confronting the unwilling contestants of Maestro's Contest of Champions.{{r|Contest of Champions Vol 1 9}}

Their battle was interrupted by the arrival of the [[Thunderbolts (Earth-61893)|Thunderbolts]], who had been sent to Battlerealm to rescue President Stark and his Mighty Avengers. It was then that [[Elektra Natchios (Earth-16034)|Bullseye]] took advantage of the moment to kill [[Robert Baldwin (Earth-61893)|Penance]] in cold blood. Stark tried to resurrect him using the Reality Stone, but it didn't work.

An all-out battle between the three groups soon broke out, ending with Tony killing [[Steven Rogers (Earth-61893)|Steve Rogers]], leader of the Thunderbolts. Stark was promptly attacked by a furious [[Susan Storm (Earth-61893)|Invisible Woman]], who created an expanding force field inside his [[Iron Patriot Armor Model 1|Iron Patriot Armor]] to destroy it from within, ending up revealing the Reality Stone in his chest.

After revealing how the Reality Stone came to be with him and how he used it to manipulate the events on their home universe, Stark tried to use it undo the recent events, but it didn't work again. Stark was then crushed by Maestro, who explained to him that the Infinity Stones just worked on their home realities before finishing him off.{{r|Contest of Champions Vol 1 10}}

| History                 = When genius inventor and wealthy businessman '''Tony Stark''' was kidnapped by terrorist and forced to a build them a weapon of mass destruction, he instead created a set of [[Iron Man Armor|armor]] of his own design and used it to escape. Emerging from his captivity a changed man, Tony decided to use his armor to protect the world as the hero '''Iron Man'''. He eventually joined a team of heroes known as the [[Avengers (Earth-64460)|Avengers]], using his dual identity as Tony Stark to help fund the team and serve as the public-facing head of the group.

In the midst of the [[Annihilation Wave (Earth-64460)|Annihilation Wave]]'s invasion of [[Earth]], Iron Man teamed up with fellow Avenger [[Steven Rogers (Earth-64460)|Captain America]] as they attempted to stop [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-64460)|A.I.M.]] from freeing their leader, [[George Tarleton (Earth-64460)|M.O.D.O.K.]], from his captivity aboard a [[S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier]]. Despite their best efforts, the Avengers failed and the Annihilation Wave was able to escape with M.O.D.O.K., leading the pair to join a growing collation of heroes seeking to end [[Annihilus (Earth-64460)|Annihilus]]' invasion. Later, Iron Man joined [[Phyla-Vell (Earth-64460)|Phyla-Vell]] for an infiltration mission into [[Thanos (Earth-64460)|Thanos]]' ship, the [[Sanctuary (Spaceship)|Sanctuary II]], which culminated in a battle between them and the Mad Titan in which they emerged victorious. Finally, Iron Man joined the other heroes when they took the fight to Annihilus himself, stopping the invasion once and for all.

Following the end of the invasion, Iron Man worked alongside Captain America and [[Jennifer Walters (Earth-64460)|She-Hulk]] to help rebuild [[New York City]].{{r|Marvel Cosmic Invasion}}

===''Disney Infinity 2.0''===
====''Avengers Galaxy Playset''====
Iron Man and the [[Avengers (Earth-64492)|Avengers]] worked with [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-64492)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] and other allies to stop [[Loki Laufeyson (Earth-64492)|Loki]] and [[George Tarleton (Earth-64492)|M.O.D.O.K.]]'s [[Frost Giants|Frost Giant]] invasion.{{r|Disney INFINITY: 2.0 Edition}} After a battle with Frost Giants at the Stark Tower, he along the other Avengers was frozen but his suit was able to free him from the ice after which Tony unfroze the other Avengers.{{r|Disney INFINITY: 2.0 Edition}}

====''Spider-Man Playset''====
During [[Norman Osborn (Earth-64492)|Green Goblin]] and [[Quentin Beck (Earth-64492)|Mysterio]]'s [[Symbiotes|Symbiote]] invasion on New York with Symbiotes cloned from the [[Edward Brock (Earth-64492)|Venom]], Green Goblin stole tech from Stark Industries for his plan. ====''Guardians of the Galaxy Playset''====
When [[Ronan (Earth-64492)|Ronan the Accuser]] invaded [[Knowhere]] with his [[Sakaarans]], [[Taneleer Tivan (Earth-64492)|The Collector]] sent out a distress signal to Iron Man which was received and answered. Stark aided the [[Guardians of the Galaxy (Earth-64492)|Guardians of the Galaxy]] as they fought to defeat Ronan, starting with Knowhere‘s mining area.{{r|Disney INFINITY: 2.0 Edition}}

===''Disney Infinity 3.0''===
====''Marvel Battlegrounds Playset''====
Hulkbuster was part of the team of superheroes enlisted by [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-64492)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] to travel to [[Asgard (Realm)|Asgard]] and thwart Loki and [[Ultron (Earth-64492)|Ultron]]'s plan to steal Asgard's [[Infinity Stones|Infinity Stone]]. In the course of the story he was taken out by a Hulk robot copy made by Ultron, needing the other heroes to step in. Later he found out about S.H.I.E.L.D.‘s Lunar Base and teleportation technology which he did not know about, with Maria Hill noting that he had his secrets and S.H.I.E.L.D their own. At Asgard, he blew open Ultron‘s giant self-copy for the heroes to fight Ultron.{{r|Disney INFINITY: 3.0 Edition}}

| History                 = After inventing his first Iron Man armor and successfully used it to escape his captors, the Tony Stark of this reality decided to patent his technology and sell it to the world.

This however proved to be a great mistake. It started a new arms race between the various governments of the world, ended the age of heroes since non-tech heroes could not compete with the technological advanced Heroes and Villains that now rose up, and the US government build stronger and better [[Sentinels]] to hunt the [[Mutants (Homo superior)|Mutant]] Race into near-extinction.

In the aftermath, Stark became a recluse. He sealed himself away from the world when everyone started using the armor as weapons, and during his rare public appearances he only appears in full armor out of fear that he would become the target of a assassination or kidnap attempt.{{r|What If...? Vol 1 64}} He secretly kept working on new technology to stay ahead of the rest of the world.

When [[Max Eisenhardt (Earth-64894)|Magneto]] declared war on the United Nations for what has been done to the mutant race, Iron Man decided to use his new giant [[Overload Armor]] to capture the villain and absorb all of Magneto’s magnetic energy, causing the Overload armor to explode, send the energy to a series of satellites, and have it wash over the entire planet. All Stark tech will become useless.This also means that all technology will be useless and the world will be in a new dark age. This way Stark hoped to redeem himself for what he had done.

With the overload armor, Tony interrupted a fight between the newly assembled [[Avengers (Earth-64894)|Avengers]] and Magneto and his [[Acolytes (Earth-64894)|Acolytes]]. Iron Man managed to capture Magneto, but [[Thor Odinson (Earth-64894)|Thor]] managed to convince him no to kill the villain. He claimed Stark could make up for what he had done by being a hero, to which Tony agreed.

For a while after that, Tony Stark has no plans to leave his armor. He and [[James Rhodes (Earth-64894)|Jim Rhodes]] forced the government to halt Sentinel production and use their funds for more helpful technology. The rest of the world soon follows suit. Of course, if they don’t, then Tony will be forced to use Overload Iron Man to put an end to technology. The story ends with the remaining heroes forming a new Avengers team.{{r|What If...? Vol 1 64}}

When he and the rest of the [[Avengers (Earth-66755)|Avengers]] responded to a distress call from the [[Fantastic Four (Earth-66755)|Fantastic Four]], they encountered the [[Fantastic Four (Earth-616)|Earth-616 Fantastic Four]] instead. Unable to understand the humans, the Avengers concluded their allies had been corrupted. Tony called in the Four's children to calm their parents and created a cage for them, but they escaped and fought back. After [[Reed Richards (Earth-616)|Reed Richards]] created a translator, Tony took the visitors back to his lab, where Reed realized their universes were on the verge of destroying each other. Quickly building a device to push the realities apart, Stark and the Fantastic Four tried to use it before being interrupted by [[Victor von Doom (Earth-66755)|Doctor Doom]].{{r|Fantastic Four Vol 7 12}}

When [[Hala (Earth-616)|Hala the Accuser]] suddenly appeared on Knowhere and began to rampage,{{r|Guardians of Knowhere Vol 1 3}} the Nova Corps tried to stop her, but they failed, and were killed in the attempt.{{r|Guardians of Knowhere Vol 1 4}}

| History                 = Tony Stark came to [[London]] for business and tried to talk to [[Margaret Carter (Earth-76)|Captain Carter]] while he had the opportunity. He met at her a bad time, as she had just been ambushed by a number of [[Special Tactical Reserve for International Key Emergencies (Earth-76)|S.T.R.I.K.E.]] agents and was on the move, though he explained that she knew his grandfather, Howard. Captain Carter kept moving, chasing a [[Jacqueline Falsworth (Earth-76)|mysterious blonde woman]] who had been involved in her ambush. She followed her to an abandoned warehouse, where she was immediately attacked by a man with a rocket launcher. Luckily, Tony swooped in at the right moment, flying her to safety. Together, they tracked the mysterious woman further, until they found themselves ambushed by masked men.{{r|Captain Carter Vol 1 3}} 

Though they fought bravely, eventually they had to admit that they were outnumbered and fled the scene to go to Tony's London lab. There, they picked up gadgets to disguise Tony and turn Peggy invisible. Afterwards, they reconvened with Peggy's neighbor [[Harley Davis (Earth-76)|Harley]]. After Tony found out that Peggy and her allies were investigating the [[John Falsworth (Earth-76)|prime minister]], he realized that he moved in a lot of the same circle as him and could be of assistance. He met with an old friend to ask more questions, but when he pushed too far, his friend took a call from the PM and then jumped off the roof, only explaining that he made him do it.{{r|Captain Carter Vol 1 4}}

After Peggy got arrested for breaking into 10 Downing Street and attempting to attack the PM, who turned out to be vampire John Falsworth, Tony assisted in freeing her from a high security facility. In the process, a fight broke out and he came to a clash with the mysterious blonde woman, who was revealed to be John's daughter Jacqueline. She quickly overpowered him, ripping out his left arm, which appeared to be completely cybernetic. He was saved just in time by Harley, who drove a stake through Jacqueline's heart, killing her.{{r|Captain Carter Vol 1 5}}

After his adventure with Captain Carter, Tony returned to the [[United States of America|United States]], where he was seen amongst debris, facing an unknown foe.{{r|Captain Carter Vol 1 5}}

| Powers                  = Tony possesses a number of abilities due to being a cyborg:
* '''{{Power|Flight}}:''' Tony was able to propel himself forwards via boosts emerging from his feet.{{r|Captain Carter Vol 1 3}}
* '''{{Power|Repulsor Ray|Repulsor Blasts}}:''' Tony could shoot repulsor beams from his hands and feet.{{r|Captain Carter Vol 1 3}}
* '''{{Power|Infrared Vision}}:''' Tony could see infrared.{{r|Captain Carter Vol 1 4}}
* '''{{Power|Force Field}}:''' Tony was able to project hard-light force fields from his arms.{{r|Captain Carter Vol 1 5}}

| History                 = Tony Stark seemingly had a similar history as his [[Earth-616]] [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|counterpart]]. As the superhero [[Iron Man]], he was a founding member of the [[Avengers (Earth-7642)|Avengers]].{{r|Incredible Hulk vs. Superman Vol 1 1}}

===Red Nose Day===
[[File:Earth-7642 from Comic Relief Comic Vol 1 1 001.jpg|left|thumb]]
In 1991, during Red Nose Day, a bi-annual fundraising event organized by the charity Comic Relief, Iron Man was one of many superheroes who took part by making donations.{{r|Comic Relief Comic Vol 1 1}}

===Man and Machine===
[[File:New Avengers Transformers Vol 1 3 Textless.jpg|left|thumb|Iron Man vs. {{wc|transformers|Skywarp (G1)|Skywarp}}]]
Hearing rumors of giant alien robots, called {{wc|transformers|Transformer|transformers}}, Tony created the [[Anti-Transformer Armor]] to specifically combat them.{{r|New Avengers/Transformers Vol 1 2}} When he learned his [[New Avengers (Earth-7642)|New Avengers]] teammates had allied with the {{wc|transformers|Autobots}} to infiltrate the {{wc|transformers|Decepticons}}' hideout, Tony rendezvoused with them, clad in his Anti-Transformer Armor.{{r|New Avengers/Transformers Vol 1 3}} When {{wc|transformers|Megatron (G1)|Megatron}}, powered by [[Peter Parker (Earth-7642)|Spider-Man]]'s blood, confronted the heroes, he was challenged by Iron Man. Stark stood no chance, but the battle was distract for the Autobots and [[James Howlett (Earth-7642)|Wolverine]] to break into the facility. With the Anti-Transformer Armor destroyed, Tony continued fighting with his [[Iron Man Armor Model 29|Extremis Armor]]. Once Logan destroyed [[Psycho-Prism]], their dome collapsed and the Decepticons retreated.{{r|New Avengers/Transformers Vol 1 4}}

===Gods and Monsters===
Following the superhuman [[Civil War]], he created a new Avengers team, the [[Mighty Avengers (Initiative) (Earth-7642)|Mighty Avengers]] and was made the new director of [[Supreme Headquarters International Espionage Law-Enforcement Division (Earth-7642)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]].

His team came into conflict with a possessed {{Image Wiki|Ellis}}, and informed Tony and [[Ares (Earth-7642)|Ares]]. They mistook him for {{Image Wiki|Cyberforce}} member {{Image Wiki|Robert Berresford (Top Cow)|Ripclaw}} and they went to confront him at their base on [[Misquit Island]].{{r|Fusion Vol 1 1}} After a brief scuffle, Ripclaw explained that Ellis and the creature had been taken to [[Thunderbolts Mountain]]. They left to see the creature, which [[Norman Osborn (Earth-7642)|Director Osborn]] reluctantly agreed to. Suddenly, Iron Man, Osborn, and Ripclaw were attacked by the creature, which had bonded to the [[Venom (Symbiote) (Earth-7642)|Venom Symbiote]].{{r|Fusion Vol 1 2}} Ellis was able to use [[MacDonald Gargan (Earth-7642)|Venom]]'s connection to his [[Symbiotes|symbiote]] to hurt the creature, allowing the heroes to seemingly destroy the creature. Afterwards, the Avengers let Cyberforce leave to spite Osborn, despite them not being registered under the [[Superhuman Registration Act]].{{r|Fusion Vol 1 3}}

===Attack on Avengers===
Iron Man joined his fellow Avengers when they responded to {{wc|attackontitan|Titan (Attack on Avengers)|Titans}} attacking [[New York City]]. They teamed-up with [[Guardians of the Galaxy (Earth-7642)|Guardians of the Galaxy]] and S.H.I.E.L.D., which had reinstated [[Maria Hill (Earth-7642)|Maria Hill]] as director, in an attempt to stop them.{{r|Brutus Vol 1 790}}

===Finding a new Avenger===
When [[Lilandra Neramani (Earth-7642)|Empress Lilandra]] of the [[Shi'ar Empire]] sent a distress call to the Avengers, they sent [[Carol Danvers (Earth-7642)_|Captain Marvel]], [[Vision (Earth-7642)|Vision]], and [[Bruce Banner (Earth-7642)|Hulk]] to [[Chandilar]]. Unfortunately, [[Victor von Doom (Earth-7642)|Doctor Doom]] intercepted this distress call. Now knowing that the Avengers were down three heavy hitters, he planned to send his entire [[Doombot]] armada to [[New York (State)|New York]], forcing Tony and the Avengers to hold auditions for replacement members, which led to many of the {{wc|Muppets|Muppets}} applying for the job.{{r|The Muppets Take the Marvel Universe Vol 1 1}}

| History                 = The past history of Iron Man of [[Earth-776]] mirrors that of [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|his Earth-616 counterpart]] up until shortly after the [[Bruce Banner (Earth-776)|Hulk]] left the [[Avengers (Earth-776)|Avengers]]. In this reality the Avengers couldn't agree on how to deal with the Hulk after his departure from the Avengers, Iron Man being the only one wanting to go after him. With no agreement being made the group disbanded. Still thinking the Hulk was a threat, Iron Man got in touch with [[Richard Jones (Earth-776)|Rick Jones]] who agreed and joined his cause.

When the Hulk attacked Rick, Iron Man came to his rescue fighting off the Hulk, and his armor sustained serious damage. When the Hulk teamed-up with the [[Namor McKenzie (Earth-776)|Sub-Mariner]] and issued a challenge to the Avengers (unaware that they had broken up) Iron Man called back [[Henry Pym (Earth-776)|Giant-Man]] and the [[Janet Van Dyne (Earth-776)|Wasp]] and revealed to them and Rick additional suits of Iron Man armor for them to wear, giving them an edge against Hulk and Sub-Mariner. However, in training them how to use the armor, Iron Man grew impatient with their inability to handle the suits and yelled at them. His negative attitude caused them to abandon him.

With no other chase, Iron Man super-charged his armor and faced Namor and the Hulk alone. He had the upper hand at first, but as his energy drained out he was easily beaten into submission and Namor left him for dead. Giant-Man and the Wasp arrived to battle the Sub-Mariner and the Hulk after being convinced by Rick to help. When Giant-Man was injured in battle, Iron Man used the last of his power to revive him, dying in the process. The others would eventually defeat the Hulk and Sub-Mariner and learn that Iron Man was none other than Tony Stark, and recognized that it was his sacrifice what allowed them to win the battle.{{r|What If? Vol 1 3}}

| History                 = The past history of Iron Man of [[Earth-7812]] mirrors that of his [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Earth-616 counterpart]] up until the formation of the [[Avengers (Earth-7812)|Avengers]]. In this reality, [[Richard Jones (Earth-7812)|Rick Jones]] would become the Hulk and be manipulated by [[Loki Laufeyson (Earth-7812)|Loki]]. Iron Man would be one of the many heroes who would be gathered to battle the Hulk, the group would discover Loki's trickery and defeat him. After the battle, Iron Man and the others would band together to form the Avengers.{{r|What If? Vol 1 12}}

On their second mission against the [[Space Phantom (Earth-7812)|Space Phantom]], the invader would sow descent between the Avengers and the Hulk. Finding the Hulk a menace, Iron Man would attempt to contain him until [[Bruce Banner (Earth-7812)|Bruce Banner]] would blast the brute with a gamma ray device that would temporarily cure Rick.

Iron Man's subsequent activities likely mirrored his Earth-616 counterpart, and he would upgrade his armor. He would be involved in Earth-7812's version of the [[Kree#Earth-7812|Kree]]/[[Skrulls#Earth-7812|Skrull]] War, however his involvement and his subsequent activities remain unrevealed.{{r|What If? Immediately afterward, [[Heinrich Zemo (Earth-78721)|Baron Zemo]] attacked the [[Avengers Mansion]] with a new weapon that petrified the veteran heroes, including Iron Man. Captain Avenger attacked Zemo in revenge, but the villain's weapon broke during the beatdown, prompting him to gloat that the Avengers would never return to normal without it.

This reality manifested on [[Earth-616]] in the form of a daydream experienced by [[Richard Jones (Earth-616)|Rick Jones]]. When he was about to deliver Zemo a final blow, [[Steven Rogers (Earth-616)|Captain America]] jolted Rick back to reality, causing him to become disillusioned that he didn't actually become a super hero.{{r|Captain America Vol 1 221}}

While [[Steven Rogers (Earth-804)|Captain America]] and [[Vision (Earth-804)|Vision]] would go off to the Skrull Throneworld to rescue their friends [[Mar-Vell (Earth-804)|Captain Marvel]], [[Wanda Maximoff (Earth-804)|Scarlet Witch]], and [[Pietro Maximoff (Earth-804)|Quicksilver]], Iron Man and [[Thor Odinson (Earth-804)|Thor]] would stay behind and attempt to cripple the Skrull invasion fleet. Iron Man would be seriously injured in the battle, prompting Thor to rush him to [[Asgard]] where his people's healers could help Iron Man. 

Having fully recovered from his injuries, Iron Man would join the other heroes of Earth stave an invasion fleet of the [[Kree#Earth-804|Kree]] until the war was ended. Iron Man would reunite with his fellow Avengers on Earth and mourn the loss of their friend Rick Jones.

| History                 = Somewhere over the [[Mediterranean Sea]], a terrorist attempts to hijack a Stark Air 797. As luck would have it, Tony Stark happens to be one of the passengers on board. He quickly dons his Iron Man armor, grabs the terrorist and flies through the top of the plane. The terrorist detonates a belt of explosives and dies. Iron Man flies back to the jet and tries to calm the passengers, but they appear to be more afraid of him than the terrorist. Flying away, he grumbles "I need a vacation".

Sometime later, Tony Stark visits the Stark Casino on the [[Las Vegas]] [[Las Vegas Boulevard|strip]]. He entertains two attractive female patrons and invites them up into his suite. Across town, the statue of the gold dragon is mounted on the roof of the Golden Dragon Casino. Suddenly, hundreds of lizards begin scurrying across the streets of Vegas. They are all running in the same direction and there does not appear to be any reason for their odd behavior. At the Golden Dragon Casino, the eye pieces on the artifact begin to glow.{{r|Iron Man: Viva Las Vegas Vol 1 1}}

[[Elsa Bloodstone (Earth-80734)|Elsa Bloodstone]] comes to Las Vegas to meet with Tony Stark. She fears that she might inadvertently be responsible for the recent plague of lizards and wants Stark to find out the identity of the man or woman who hired her. Stark is frustrated at disrupting his vacation but agrees to help Elsa. She tells him of the Golden Dragon artifact which she recovered in [[China]] and is scheduled to be unveiled at the grand opening of the Golden Dragon Casino. Tony makes arrangements to attend the grand opening. Naturally, he insists that Elsa accompany him as his date.

At the gala festival, Elsa uses Tony's Stark 1000 camera to zoom in on the glyphs at the foot of the artifact. Elsa translates the inscription as "He whose limbs shatter mountains and whose back scrapes the sun". Upon hearing the words, Tony now realizes exactly what they are dealing with now.

The dragon statue suddenly grows and comes to life, spreading its wings as it climbs off the pedestal. This is [[Fin Fang Foom (Earth-80734)|Fin Fang Foom]]! As guests begin to scramble in a panic, Tony retrieves his Iron Man armor from his briefcase. He has fought this creature once before. Changing into his battlesuit, he flies across the Las Vegas strip where he sees Fin Fang Foom wreaking havoc. The battle is about to begin.{{r|Iron Man: Viva Las Vegas Vol 1 2}}

| History                 = Iron Man's history is presumably similar to his [[Earth-616]] [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|counterpart]]'s. When the [[Earth]] was threatened with destruction by the [[Unmaker (Earth-80763)|Unmaker]] at its core, Iron Man was one the many geniuses that worked to find a solution. It was eventually agreed that a team of heroes would go to the Earth's core and fight the Unmaker. While the team fought the Unmaker, Iron Man and other heroes worked to mitigate the destruction the Unmaker did to the surface.{{r|Dark Ages Vol 1 1}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-80763) from Free Comic Book Day 2020 (X-Men Dark Ages) Vol 1 1 001.jpg|thumb|left|Iron Man shortly before the blackout]]
Iron Man told [[Virginia Potts (Earth-80763)|Pepper Potts]] to flee to the bunker built beneath [[Stark Unlimited HQ]]. Pepper agreed, though she was very reluctant as she doubted the bunker would be enough to protect her.{{r|Free Comic Book Day 2020 (X-Men/Dark Ages) Vol 1 1}} The team sent to stop the Unmaker was eventually successful, but [[Stephen Strange (Earth-80763)|Doctor Strange]] left open a portal that unleashed an EMP that wiped out all technology, including Iron Man's armor.{{r|Dark Ages Vol 1 1}} As Iron Man's armor began to fail, he crashed into a jet, resulting him in losing part of his left leg. He eventually crashed into Stark Unlimited HQ where he was found by a distraught Pepper.{{r|Free Comic Book Day 2020 (X-Men/Dark Ages) Vol 1 1}} Iron Man survived his crash, and 7 years later, society rebuilt itself.{{r|Dark Ages Vol 1 1}} He also created a new kind of Iron Man Armor that didn't require electricity to operate.{{r|Dark Ages Vol 1 1}}

Tony replaced his lost leg with a prosthesis and tried to find a way to block out the EMP that affected the world, including making Faraday cages made of adamantium and vibranium, but he was unsuccessful. After turning a cave into a workshop, he eventually began experimenting with alchemy and managed to turn lead into gold. One day, he was asked by [[Steven Rogers (Earth-80763)|Captain America]] to aid him in liberating [[Europe]] from the tyranny of [[En Sabah Nur (Earth-80763)|Apocalypse]]. Tony was then shocked to see Apocalypse approach him. He tried escaping but was subdued by Apocalypse's allies [[Vlad Dracula (Earth-80763)|Count Dracula]] and [[Raven Darkhölme (Earth-80763)|Mystique]] who had disguised herself as Rogers to lure out Tony. Apocalypse then brought Tony to to [[Paris]], [[France]] and tried to convince him to aid him. Tony refused at first, but Apocalypse had the [[Zebediah Killgrave (Earth-80763)|Purple Man]] brainwash Tony into serving him.{{r|Dark Ages Vol 1 2}}

Apocalypse later brought Tony and other geniuses other his thrall to the Earth's core where the Unmaker resided. Apocalypse expressed his interest in taking control of the Unmaker's powers, but first, the EMP admitted from Strange's portal needed to be blocked. Tony guessed that the EMP's source was a neutron star. Apocalypse stated that he needed the EMP to be blocked from a few minutes to an hour so he could take control of the Unmaker. Tony stated that it was impossible, but he liked a challenge.{{r|Dark Ages Vol 1 5}}

Tony and the other geniuses began work on a metal sphere to block the EMP long enough for Apocalypse to transfer mind into the Unmaker. When a group of heroes arrived to stop Apocalypse, mind-controlled prisoners were sent to stall them while Tony, [[Riri Williams (Earth-80763)|Riri Williams]], and [[Reed Richards (Earth-80763)|Reed Richards]] finished the sphere. The Purple Man's control was broken when he was killed by [[Wade Wilson (Earth-80763)|Deadpool]], and Apocalypse was killed by [[Eric Brooks (Earth-80763)|Blade]] after being vampirized by Dracula.{{r|Dark Ages Vol 1 6}}

| History                 = Iron Mandrill is a mandrill who is a member of the [[Ape-vengers (Earth-8101)|Ape-vengers]]. He encountered the [[Martin Blank (Earth-616)|Gibbon]] at [[Avengers Mansion|Ape-vengers Mansion]] after Gibbon had helped apprehend [[Otto Ooktavius (Earth-8101)|Doctor Ooktopus]]. He was present at Ooktavius' trial and proceeded to beat him nearly to death along with the other Ape-vengers after he refused to reform.

Iron Mandrill was tricked, along with the rest of the world, into believing that Gibbon had killed [[Reed Richards (Earth-8101)|Mister Fantastic]], While in reality, it was [[John Falsworth (Earth-8101)|Baron Blood]], who had been masquarading as Captain America for years after freezing him. He was further tricked into believing that Gibbon and his companion, [[Fiona Fitzhugh (Earth-616)|Fiona Fitzhugh]], were really part of an invasion from [[Earth-616]].

After Gibbon and Fiona were captured, Iron Mandrill and the other Ape-vengers were preparing a pre-emptive strike against the "invaders" from Earth-616. However, before the dimensional portal could be activated, the Ape-vengers were attacked by the [[Outcasts (Earth-8101)|Outcasts]]. During the battle, the Ape-vengers learned that Gibbon was telling the truth about their Captain America being Baron Blood, and witnessed how he fought against the real [[Steven Rogers (Earth-8101)|Captain America]], who was defrosted by Gibbon.{{r|Marvel Apes Vol 1 1|4}}

Later, Iron Mandrill and the other Ape-vengers repaired the dimensional portal in order to retrieve their [[Robert Baldwin (Earth-8101)|Speedball]],  The Ape-vengers discovered that for some reason it still didn't work, not realizing that [[Peter Parker (Earth-8101)|Spider-Monkey]] had sabotaged it, who had remembered the outcome of successfully doing so (which caused the invasion of the Marvel Zombies).{{r|Marvel Zombies: Evil Evolution Vol 1 1}}

Leader and founder of an {{M|Future Iron Man's Team (Earth-616)|unnamed team}} | Relatives = | MaritalStatus = | CharRef = | Gender = Male | Height = | Weight = | Eyes = Blue | Hair = Black | UnusualFeatures = Has a electromagnetic [[Arc Reactor|R.T. node]] implanted in his chest, which maintains his body functions. | Origin = Last survivor of [[Earth-81191]] | Reality = Earth-81191 | PlaceOfBirth = | PlaceOfDeath = [[Donald Birch (Earth-616)|Donald Birch]]'s Unlocated underwater | Identity = Secret | Citizenship = American | Occupation = * Adventurer * inventor | Education = | BaseOfOperations = * Formerly [[London]], [[England]] * [[New York City]], [[New York (State)|New York]] * [[Earth-616]]'s past | Creators = Rob Williams; Rebekah Isaacs | First = Iron Age: Alpha Vol 1 1 | Death = Iron Age: Omega Vol 1 1 | History = Anthony Stark was captured by the man he fired years ago, [[Donald Birch (Earth-81191)|Donald Birch]], who wanted him to witness what he had created in blowing Birch's life away. Witnessing the rise of the [[Phoenix Force (Earth-81191)|Phoenix]] brought from the past via a reconstructed [[Time Platform|Doctor Doom's Time Machine]], Tony Stark fled from the machine and ended up in [[Earth-616|the past]] while [[Earth-81191|his world]] and friends were consumed by the Dark Phoenix.{{r|Iron Age: Alpha Vol 1 1}} ===[[Ultron (Earth-616)|Ultron]] and the [[Avengers (Earth-616)|Avengers]]=== He first went to his hotel where he found his [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|younger, drunken self]], who gave him the armor in his delirium. Then he went to the [[Avengers (Earth-616)|Avengers]] who tried to take off the armor of him, thinking he was still drunk. He confronted them and fled to [[Henry Pym (Earth-616)|Pym]]'s lab where he hit him for having stolen his [[Janet Van Dyne (Earth-616)|wife Janet]] after their divorce, but Tony managed to explain to him he was from the future, telling him about Pym's future technology of [[Overspace]]. He then helped him and the Avengers defeat [[Ultron (Earth-616)|Ultron]] before Pym gave him the repaired part of the Time Machine, and he fled into the time-stream, after admitting to Hank that he would go through some bad events of his life.{{r|Iron Age Vol 1 1}} ===In [[James Jaspers (Earth-616)|Jaspers]]' [[Britain]]=== Tony arrived in [[Great Britain|Britain]] during [[James Jaspers (Earth-616)|James Jaspers]]' reign as Prime Minister, he witnessed the [[Beetles (Earth-616)|Beetles]] arbitrary arrests on [[Mutants (Homo superior)|mutants]] in [[London]] and met [[Brian Braddock (Earth-616)|Captain Britain]], who asked for help from him and the [[United States of America|USA]] against Jaspers. As the two heroes refused to help each other, Stark left. [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-81191) from Iron Age Omega Vol 1 1 0002.png|thumb|left]] He then presented himself as Tony Stark to [[Vixen (British Crimelord) (Earth-616)|Vixen]] for him to enter the [[Special Tactical Reserve for International Key Emergencies (Earth-616)|S.T.R.I.K.E.]] complex by Captain Britain. Knocking Vixen down, he went on a search for the time machine fragment, finding it on [[Donald Birch (Earth-616)|Donald Birch]], who was a prisoner of Vixen in this era. He debated the idea of killing him in order to prevent the fate of his world, but decided to leave instead. This was due to him feeling uncomfortable with the concept of preventive murder, having been confronted earlier with the Beetles arresting innocent [[Mutants (Homo superior)|mutants]] and having heard part of Jaspers' interview on the subject of preventive arrests of powered beings. Instead, he left, but was quickly surrounded by the Beetles. Captain Britain and the British resistance came to fight Jaspers' soldiers and Braddock once again asked for help from Iron Man who refused and left using the machine.{{r|Iron Age Vol 1 1}} ===Back to [[New York City|New York]]=== Back in [[New York City|New York]] he met the [[Heroes for Hire (Power Man & Iron Fist) (Earth-616)|Heroes for Hire]], [[Lucas Cage (Earth-616)|Power Man]] and [[Daniel Rand (Earth-616)|Iron Fist]]. He travelled then to [[Latverian Embassy|Latveria's embassy]], was made prisoner by [[Victor von Doom (Earth-616)|Doctor Doom]], escaped, made friends with [[Jonathan Storm (Earth-616)|Johnny Storm]], met his past self once again, and battled Doctor Doom in the timestream. While travelling aboard the [[Time Platform]] they arrived in various time points such as [[Pennsylvania (State)|Pennsylvania]] in 1863 during the [[American Civil War (Event)|American Civil War]], [[Pompeii]] causing the {{WP|Eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD}}, 270.000.000 B.C., [[Tunguska]] in 1908 [[Tunguska Event|causing a massive explosion]].{{r|Iron Age Vol 1 2}} ===The [[Hellfire Club (Earth-616)|Hellfire Club]]=== His next destination lead to him encountering the débutante artist [[Alison Blaire (Earth-616)|Dazzler]] who was being tracked by the [[Hellfire Knights (Earth-616)|Knights]] of the [[Hellfire Club (Earth-616)|Hellfire Club]]. Using his membership in the club, he infiltrated it to find a part of the time machine while being helped by Dazzler, who he counseled into thinking once again about joining the [[X-Men (Earth-616)|X-Men]]. He was made a prisoner by [[Sebastian Shaw (Earth-616)|Sebastian Shaw]] and battled him alongside the X-Men who came to battle the Black King. There he witnessed the Hellfire's [[Phoenix Force (Earth-616)|Dark Phoenix]], who destroyed the time-travelling machine before leaving to avoid meeting [[Scott Summers (Earth-616)|Cyclops]].{{r|Iron Age Vol 1 3}} For years, Tony Stark stayed stuck in the past, trying to complete the time machine. He was close to completing it, but his device was unstable. Realizing he could not complete the machine alone, Stark decided to visit Hank Pym and ask for his help. The two of them then decided to work together, but Pym thought they should inform [[Reed Richards (Earth-616)|Reed Richards]] in order to gain his help with the project. Stark, however, refused, stating that the only heroes who could be involved were the people he saw on Birch's screen: Captain Britain, Dazzler, Iron Fist, Cyclops, Power Man, Henry Pym, and Johnny Storm. Finally, he succeeded in recreating a time machine, and Stark gathered [[Future Iron Man's Team (Earth-616)|his allies]] to go confront Birch in the present, leaving Pym behind as a back-up plan.{{r|Iron Age: Omega Vol 1 1}} ===Return to present and death=== [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-81191) from Iron Age Omega Vol 1 1 0001.png|thumb|right|200px|Iron Man's death, saving [[Lucas Cage (Earth-616)|Power Man]]]] They came a little bit too late, as Donald Birch and Tony Stark of the present were already witnessing the arrival of the Dark Phoenix from the past. The team confronted Birch's robots and the Phoenix, but the future Iron Man was killed while saving Power Man from the Phoenix fire, much to Birch's enjoyment. They managed to defeat the Phoenix, and Birch died from a combination of his cancer and the severe shock of his failure. The team then headed back to their era with the unconscious Jean Grey after Luke Cage thanked Tony Stark for sacrificing his future-from-the-past-self in order to save him.{{r|Iron Age: Omega Vol 1 1}} | Powers = Tony Stark possessed only his special internal liquid armor, as well as the "natural" strength he gained from it. | Abilities = | Weaknesses = | Equipment = | Transportation = | Weapons = | Notes = * Stark was tempted to return to his alcoholic behavior during his adventure. | Trivia = | Links = }} [[Category:Armor Users]] [[Category:Time Travelers]] [[Category:Characters Displaced to Earth-616]] [[Category:Interdimensional Travelers]]

| History                 = Iron Man was one of the members of the [[Avengers (Earth-81223)|Avengers]] who found the original [[Steven Rogers (Earth-81223)|Captain America]] frozen in a block of ice at the [[North Pole]]. They brought him back to [[Avengers Mansion]] to try to reawaken him from his cryogenic sleep but after thawing him out Tony came to the conclusion that Rogers died from some sort of brain aneurysm before he hit the ice. Realizing a world without Captain America, the [[United States]] and it's society fell to chaos and disorder.

[[File:Avengers (Earth-81223) from What If? Age of Ultron Vol 1 4 0002.png|left|thumb|Avengers find the frozen body of Steve Rogers.]]
Stark decided to secretly assemble some of the [[Earth]]'s most powerful and influential members in order to help solve the major crisis that their world was facing. Naming themselves the [[Illuminati (Earth-81223)|Illuminati]], they decided to try to reignite the spark left behind by Rogers in hopes that with a new Captain the people will have someone to rally their hopes around again. After testing numerous candidates, Tony and the others chose [[Francis Castle (Earth-81223)|Frank Castle]], who was a vigilante known as the [[Punisher]].

[[File:Illuminati (Earth-81223) from What If? Age of Ultron Vol 1 4 0001.png|left|thumb|The Illuminati]]
Tony had [[Reed Richards (Earth-81223)|Reed Richards]] concoct a more powerful version of the [[Super-Soldier]] serum and then had it injected into Castle's body. Seeing that his abilities have become more advanced and stronger than Roger's ever was, Tony gave him a uniform and the shield to become the new Captain America. After months of tests and monitoring the fights Castle had been in, Tony decided to make Castle a member of the Avengers. Seeing this as a profitable and symbolic venture, Stark began to merchandise memorabilia through his business connections turning Castle into a superstar overnight. 

Tony expanded his operation by putting into effect an initiative called the [[Captain Americorps (Earth-81223)|Captain Americorps]], a peace policing force that would provide teams of super-soldiers throughout the U.S. and overseas. As the corps grew larger, Castle became disillusioned by Stark's idea and decided to end his run as a hero. After 20 years, Tony's Corps became so large to the point where alien species joined and they were patrolling space.{{r|What If? Age of Ultron Vol 1 4}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-89521) from What If...? (animated series) Season 1 5 001.jpg|left|thumb|Pre-zombification]]
Stark's history roughly followed that of his [[Earth-199999]] [[Anthony Stark (Earth-199999)|counterpart]] until [[Janet Van Dyne (Earth-89521)|Janet Van Dyne]] was infected by a virus from the Quantum Realm, Janet infected her husband [[Henry Pym (Earth-89521)|Hank Pym]] when he tried to take her out of the Quantum Realm which resulted in the spread of the virus around the world.

Tony and [[Steven Rogers (Earth-89521)|Steve]] assembled the [[Avengers (Earth-89521)|Avengers]] to combat the zombie infestation and landed in San Francisco to fight them, however, they failed and the Avengers, including Tony, were turned into zombies. Two weeks later, an infected Stark, along with the zombified [[Stephen Strange (Earth-89521)|Doctor Strange]] and [[Wong (Earth-89521)|Wong]], intercepted the [[Black Order (Earth-89521)|Black Order]] that arrived on Earth in search of the missing Infinity Gems for [[Thanos (Earth-89521)|Thanos]]. After zombifying the Black Order they tried to devour [[Bruce Banner (Earth-89521)|Bruce Banner]] but were stopped by the Cloak of Levitation for a few moments to then be attacked by insects commanded by [[Hope Van Dyne (Earth-89521)|Hope van Dyne]]. Stark was decapitated by Hope and his head was eaten by one of her giant insects. {{r|What If...? (animated series) Season 1 5}}

About five years later, Kamala Khan, Kate Bishop, and Riri Williams found his body, still in the armor. They recovered the Mark L armor, and Riri managed to reactivate [[F.R.I.D.A.Y. (Earth-89521)|F.R.I.D.A.Y.]]. Since then, F.R.I.D.A.Y. has controlled the Mark L to protect Kamala, Kate, and Riri from zombies.{{R|Marvel Zombies (animated series) Season 1 1}}

| History                 = Tony Stark was an industrialist who was also an adventurer, the exploits of which were recorded in the magazine known as ''Marvels: A Magazine Of Men's Adventure''. His adventures are always accompanied by his friend [[James Rhodes (Earth-90214)|James Rhodes]], his assistant and lover Doctor [[Gialetta Nefaria (Earth-90214)|Gialetta Nefaria]], and chronicler [[Virgil Munsey (Earth-90214)|Virgil Munsey]]. At some point, Tony suffered a weak heart condition due to unspecified causes and required an electrical support, with help from [[Edwin Jarvis (Earth-90214)|Edwin Jarvis]].{{Citation}}

During his latest expedition in British Honduras, Tony was in search of the Jade Mask, which is said to cure any kind of ailments and hoped to use it to heal his heart condition. Upon discovering the mask, which didn't cured Tony when he put it on, Tony was betrayed by Nefaria, who in reality worked for the Nazis led by [[Howard Stark (Earth-90214)|Baron Zemo]] and [[Wolfgang von Strucker (Earth-90214)|Baron Strucker]]. Virgil was killed before Tony and Rhodes escaped by causing a fire which severely burnt Nefaria's face.{{Citation}}

Tony returned to New York City where he hired [[Virginia Potts (Earth-90214)|Pepper Potts]] as Virgil's replacement and investigated Nefaria's belongings. He soon discovered a journal which told the location of [[Atlantis (Modern)|Atlantis]] and its fable power source orichalcum, which Tony plans to use it to repair his heart. Tony set out another expedition with Captain [[Namor McKenzie (Earth-90214)|Namor]] in his ship, the ''[[Lady Dorma (Ship)|Dorma]]''. The expedition succeeded in finding Atlantis and recovering the orichalcum in the form of a trident, but were attacked by Zemo and his forces. After Pepper Potts was taken hostage and the orichalcum taken, Tony and his allies again escaped by retreating in Namor's submarine and were soon picked up by Jarvin in an airship.{{Citation}}

Tony and Rhodes launched an assault on Zemo's base at Castle Donar and rescue Pepper. The rescue lead to a surprising turn of events to finding Zemo possessing an army equipped with armored suits, and Zemo revealed to be Tony's father, Howard. The elder Stark had long been brainwashed by Baron Strucker and staying loyal for the Nazis in which he helped them in creating their own armored suits. Tony singled-handedly faced his father and Strucker, and defeated them by supercharging the orichalcum, triggering an enormous power surge which destroyed the Nazis' airship fleet. Tony was left with a new resolve of abandoning adventuring and making the world safe.{{Citation}}

Suddenly several of the heroes fade as [[Thanos (Earth-90266)|Thanos]] activated the [[Infinity Gauntlet]]. 

The Fantastic Four enlist Iron Man to their team and try to solve what is happening when [[Stephen Strange (Earth-90266)|Doctor Strange]], the [[Norrin Radd (Earth-90266)|Silver Surfer]] and [[Adam Warlock (Earth-90266)|Adam Warlock]] arrive to gain their assistance. Warlock explains the situation to the Four and the threat of Thanos as being far greater than they have ever known. The Four and their allies are then teleport to Thanos' domain. Before he could annihilate his enemies, Mephisto, as his advisor, stops him. The Four confides with Warlock, Strange, and Surfer over how to defeat Thanos, but learns from Warlock that he and his associates won't reveal their plan to keep from alerting Thanos' omniscience. This creates distrust between the Four and their allies, in which Banner voices that Warlock hadn't done anything to stop Thanos when he wiped out half of all life across the galaxy. Warlock and his associates then leave in search of "more reasonable allies." 

Regrouping, they attempt to take on Thanos again and witnessed the Titan easily defeat the universe's cosmic entities, Wolverine decided to team up with Thanos, replacing Mephisto as Thanos' advisor. Iron Man, with the help of a seperated Hulk and Bruce Banner, took a recently defeated [[Celestials|Celestial]] armor and converted into a new suit to attack Thanos. This, however, doesn't work. As Thanos shielded himself, Wolverine ask him if he has ever touched Death as a part of love. After defeating Iron Man, Thanos is strongly convinced of Wolverine's suggestion and uses the Gauntlet to touch Death. Just as he did this, Wolverine cut off Thanos' arm with the Gauntlet and leaves him to be physically assaulted by the Hulk. Spider-Man then utilize the Gauntlet and successfully restores the damages done by Thanos.{{r|What If? Newer Fantastic Four Vol 1 1}}

| History                 = 
===Origin===
Anthony "Tony" Stark is the son of [[Howard Stark (Earth-904913)|Howard]] and [[Maria Stark (Earth-904913)|Maria Stark]]. Tony used to go to school like other kids but when his mother passed away, his father decided to keep him close by him. Staying isolated from school, Tony excelled in the corporate world, developing new technologies for [[Stark International (Earth-904913)|Stark International]], his only friend was [[James Rhodes (Earth-904913)|James "Rhodey" Rhodes]], son of his father's lawyer, [[Roberta Rhodes (Earth-904913)|Roberta Rhodes]]. He also designed a laser system for his father's new Earth Mover machine, meant to help in archaeological digs and disaster relief. However, [[Obadiah Stane (Earth-904913)|Obadiah Stane]] wanted to use the Earth Movers as a weapon, which Howard blatantly refused to do so.{{r|Iron Man: Armored Adventures Season 1 1}}

Returning from the dig site where his father was excavating Chinese ruins involving the [[Makluan Power Rings|Makluan Rings]], which Howard believed to be a form of advanced technology, Tony was planning on showing him the new flight-capable armor he developed. But something happened on the return trip and Howard apparently died in a plane crash. Tony barely survived with his armor on and passed out after he had autopilot take him to Rhodey. Because of Howard's mysterious death, Stane became CEO of Stark International. He barred Tony from any involvement in his projects, which meant weaponizing any of the Starks' innovations and claimed that his father's will was for him to go to school and live a normal life. Tony would only return to take control of the company once he's legally an adult.{{r|Iron Man: Armored Adventures Season 1 1}}

Tony had a hard time fitting in a normal life, as his high intelligence ostracized him from everyone else. He also got suspicious of Stane when [[Patricia Potts (Earth-904913)|Pepper Potts]] informed him that the FBI is investigating him. Tony then took his armor to check on Stane himself. As soon as he found out that Stane had weaponized the Earth Movers, he detected a runaway train headed for the building's power grid. He managed to save the tower and countless lives by stopping the train. Witnesses called him Iron Man, an identity he decided to take on to save Stark International from itself.{{r|Iron Man: Armored Adventures Season 1 1}}

As Iron Man and Tony Stark, he met new friends and foes along the way.{{r|Iron Man: Armored Adventures Season 1 2}}{{r|Iron Man: Armored Adventures Season 1 15}}

Over time, he build new types of armors to better combat his enemies, including the War Machine armor{{r|Iron Man: Armored Adventures Season 1 25}} and the Rescue armor{{r|Iron Man: Armored Adventures Season 2 24}} for his two friends, Rhodey and [[Patricia Potts (Earth-904913)|Pepper]].

| Powers                  = 
*'''Extremis Virus:''' After injecting himself with a small drop of a modified Extremis virus, he gained a few superhuman abilities. 
**'''{{Power|Technopathy}}:''' He has shown the ability to "talk" to computers & can control any earthly technology, even the technology which doesn't even belong to him. 
**'''Peak Human Strength:''' He gained an certain degree of increased strength, as he lifted Rhodey and Pepper into the air while hugging them, with no visible effort  & even slightly suffocate them with his hug. 
**'''{{Power|Superhuman Reflexes|Enhanced Reflexes}}:''' After his enhancements he has shown a much faster fighting & reaction rate than before. 
**'''{{Power|Regenerative Healing Factor}}:''' His body gained Extremis' regenerative properties, being able to regenerate his heart tissue completely within minutes of injection.
| Abilities               = *'''Genius-Level Intellect:''' Apart from his suit, Tony has a highly gifted intellect that specializes in hardware, computers, and his armored suits, and a {{Ability|Photographic Memory|photographic memory}}. Even the experts at Stark International never completely understood the technologies he designed there. Tony created his first Iron Man suit completely on his own (he mentioned that may have "out-genius" himself), memorized all of his school books on his second day of school, and found even the most advanced topics at the Tomorrow Academy to be out of date. In Ready, A.I.M., Fire, the Controller says that Stark's file mentions that he is smarter than the whole A.I.M. organization, which is one of the greatest think tanks in the world. Ever since he took Extremis, his inventive capacity has increased exponentially. He also knows how to think on his feet, coming up with solutions to get out of tough situations.
*'''Vast Wealth:''' Tony Stark has access to a monetary trust established by his father, which he uses to build his armors and repair damaged ones. But since he is still a teenager, he receives it as a monthly allowance, at least until he turns 18 when he completely inherits it. Since Justin Hammer bought Stark International, this trust fund now belongs to Hammer Multinational, forcing him to rely on the profits from his own personal business, Stark Solutions. He gained it back again when his father returned and took back Stark International.
*'''Skilled Combatant:''' Stark is a good melee fighter. He once stalemated the assassin Ghost without wearing his armor.
*'''Indomitable Will:''' Stark possesses a very strong will. He never gives up, even in the worst situations. When his mechanical heart was damaged by the Iron Man Mark I's destruction, his will was strong enough to survive until it was fixed. His will was even strong enough to resist the hold of a Controller-Disk for a short time and recover from Mandarin's hypnotic ring.

| History                 = Little was detailed about Anthony Stark's life before the [[Hunger (Virus)|zombie plague]] infected [[Earth-91126]], however it can be presumed that it followed much the same path as his [[Earth-616]] [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|counterpart]], becoming the superhero Iron Man after being kidnapped in [[Afghanistan]] until he became alcoholic as when his company [[Stark Industries (Earth-91126)|Stark International]] started to go bankrupt. Presumably, had the zombie contagion not infected this Earth, Tony Stark would have recovered from his alcohol addiction and continued with his role as crime fighter.

While in a stupor in his main company in Stark International as he suffered a tragic case of alcoholism, the [[Henry Pym (Earth-2149)|zombie Giant Man]] of [[Earth-2149]] teleported in the building's sub-basement that contains the [[Uatu (Earth-91126)|Watcher]]'s teleportation equipment, and causing a zombie outbreak to happen as he searches for a missing component that would allow him access to the [[Multiverse]]. Tony remained in his office and was unwilling to become Iron Man, and furthermore he couldn't find his suit as he lost it somewhere in one of the men bathrooms. Though he unlocked a safe containing a bottle of prototype nanites that would've cure cancer to be used against the zombies as it entirely stripped them of their flesh. After many of his staffers were killed, including [[Virginia Potts (Earth-91126)|Pepper Potts]] and [[Harold Hogan (Earth-91126)|Happy Hogan]], Tony directed [[James Rhodes (Earth-91126)|James Rhodes]], who is equipped with Tony's Iron Man armor, to a speed charger and allowed him to become his successor before sacrificing himself in letting the zombies to devour him, as well as killing them as Tony drank the nanites, in order to allow Rhodes to escape.{{r|Marvel Zombies Return Vol 1 2}}

Tony Stark shared a similar history to his [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Prime Universe counterpart]] until some point between [[Iron Man Vol 1 128|overcoming his alcoholism]] and the public learning his identity as Iron Man. At some point he married [[Bethany Cabe (Earth-9119)|Bethany Cabe]] and built up [[Stark Universal (Earth-9119)|Stark Universal]] as a global company. At least fifty years into the future, Stark began suffering from nerve damage due to his time as Iron Man and was forced to take medication to alleviate the symptoms, but started suffering from tremors. 

He began work on the construction of "Project Bigjump" the world's first space elevator. During routine underwater construction, a boulder dislodged itself and Stark had to save a worker and a sub. However, his initial response was delayed and incorrect and Stark began to worry he was becoming unfit, but didn't want to give up Iron Man. He suspected sabotage and eventually tracked the problem  down to [[Roxxon Energy Corporation (Earth-9119)|Roxxon]] in [[Siberia]]. He travelled there and was attacked by [[Arkady Vostok (Earth-9119)|Ultra-Dynamo (Arkady Vostok)]] and found himself outmatched by him. Before Ultra-Dynamo could kill him he managed to escape.

Returning to the States, he decided to give up being Iron Man and eventually decided his replacement should be [[Nicholas Travis (Earth-9119)|Nicholas Travis]]. He trained Travis to become Iron Man but Travis felt Tony was pushing him too hard and the two had a falling out and Tony stopped training him. After Big Jump was completed Ultra-Dynamo attacked Tony and he was saved by Nick in his Iron Man suit and Dynamo was defeated when it was revealed that Nick had built a counter into his suit. With Dynamo in custody, Tony and Nick reconciled. Tony then unrevealed the new Iron Man to the public and he and Beth used Project Big Jump to retire onto his space station.{{r|Iron Man: The End Vol 1 1}}

Tony Stark was the CEO of [[Stark Industries (Earth-92131)|Stark Enterprises]].{{r|Spider-Man (1994 animated series) Season 3 10}} At some point in time, an injured Stark created an armor to keep himself alive and became the hero known as Iron Man. Tony had to routinely charge himself with power, or else his heart would stop and he would die.{{r|Spider-Man (1994 animated series) Season 5 10}}

Stark Enterprises eventually developed inter-dimensional technology. At Tony's demonstration, [[Edward Brock (Earth-92131)|Venom]] interrupted on orders from [[Dormammu (Earth-92131)|Dormammu]] and attempted to steal the inter-dimensional probe. However, [[James Rhodes (Earth-92131)|War Machine]] and [[Peter Parker (Earth-92131)|Spider-Man]] tried to stop him but were defeated after [[Cletus Kasady (Earth-92131)|Carnage]] arrived to assist Venom. Venom and Carnage successfully stole the probe and delivered it to Dormammu. Since War Machine was too wounded to fight, Tony, as Iron Man, teamed up with [[Peter Parker (Earth-92131)|Spider-Man]] and a reformed Venom to stop Carnage and [[Karl Mordo (Earth-92131)|Baron Mordo]] from releasing Dormammu.{{r|Spider-Man (1994 animated series) Season 3 11}} Tony then terminated the inter-dimensional project because of the danger it had caused. [[Johnathon Ohnn (Earth-92131)|Johnathon Ohnn]] decided to quit Stark Enterprises in response and continue his research with the [[Wilson Fisk (Earth-92131)|Kingpin]].{{r|Spider-Man (1994 animated series) Season 3 12}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-92131) from X-Men '97 Season 1 10 002.jpg|thumb|left]]
Iron Man was later summoned to an alien planet by Spider-Man to be part of his team, after the [[Beyonder (Earth-92131)|Beyonder]] proposed a battle between good and evil to see which was superior. In the end, the heroes won and everyone, except for Spider-Man, was sent back to Earth without any memory of what happened.{{r|Spider-Man (1994 animated series) Season 5 11}}

When [[Charles Xavier (Earth-92131)|Professor X]] used is psychic power on  [[Erik Lehnsherr (Earth-92131)|Magneto]] in order to revert the world-wide blackout caused by the latter, he was present along with [[Steven Rogers (Earth-92131)|Captain America]] on the [[White House]], and together they fought against [[Sebastion Gilberti (Earth-92131)|Bastion]]'s [[Prime Sentinels (Earth-92131)|Prime Sentinels]] to protect President [[Robert Kelly (Earth-92131)|Robert Kelly]].{{r|X-Men '97 Season 1 10}}

Finally, Stark's technology and data fell in the hands of the [[Deviant Skrulls|Skrulls]], since [[Edwin Jarvis (Skrull) (Earth-9230)|Jarvis]] was a subversive. The [[Secret Invasion (Event)|Skrull Invasion]] was then launched without Stark to detect it.{{r|What If? Fallen Son Vol 1 1}}

| History                 = As a devoted agent of [[Strategic Hazard Intervention Espionage Logistics Directorate (Earth-9602)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]], Tony Stark once had a secret tryst with [[Selina Luthor (Earth-9602)|Madame Cat]], a member of the nefarious terrorist organization known as [[Hydra (Earth-9602)|Hydra]] and the daughter of the [[Alexander Luthor (Earth-9602)|Green Skull]]. During his affair with Madame Cat, Tony Stark smuggled out a jetpack prototype originally developed by the Green Skull to mimic [[Clark Kent (Earth-9602)|Super-Soldier]]'s flying power. The prototype was perfected by Tony Stark's expert tinkering, mass-produced, and is currently used by special S.H.I.E.L.D. operatives. Madame Cat's allegiance to Hydra and Tony Stark's devotion to S.H.I.E.L.D. eventually drove the two star-crossed lovers apart.

Tony Stark was crippled in his service to S.H.I.E.L.D., yet another casualty in the war between [[Bruce Wayne (Earth-9602)|Bruce Wayne]] and Green Skull.

Having finally located the secret location of the Green Skull's secret fortress, the [[S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier]] hovered above Hydra Base Omega. As S.H.I.E.L.D. Director Bruce Wayne prepared himself to lead a full-scale assault on Hydra Base Omega, Tony Stark, confined to his support chair, briefed Bruce Wayne on the use of his jetpack. Bruce Wayne accused Tony Stark of sounding like a "mother hen" and reminded Stark that he had almost one hundred hours training on the jetpack. But Tony Stark responded that the training sessions were not in combat conditions. Colonel Bruce Wayne promised Tony that he would bring the jetpack back in one piece.

As he was leaving for combat, Bruce Wayne told Tony Stark that he wished he could come with him. Tony responded that he wished he could come as well -- and that it might be possible someday because he was currently working on a device at Stark Labs that might finally allow him to get up from his souped-up support chair.

I won't become a traitor! I won't become [[Nathaniel Richards (Kang) (Earth-6311)|Kang]]'s pawn! Y' hear me [[Spider-Man (Android) (Earth-6311)|robot]]?! I won't!!''' | Speaker = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-96020)|Iron Man (Tony Stark)]] | QuoteSource = Spider-Man Team-Up Vol 1 4 | History = ===Arrival on Earth-616=== While under the influence of [[Nathaniel Richards (Immortus) (Earth-6311)|Immortus]], [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] of [[Earth-616]] committed a number of horrible acts. In a desperate move, the [[Avengers (Earth-616)|Avengers]] activated a time machine in [[Avengers Mansion]]'s hidden sub-basement. They hoped to find a young Tony Stark free of influence that could help them.{{r|Avengers: Timeslide Vol 1 1}} On his way home with girlfriend [[Meredith McCall (Earth-96020)|Meredith McCall]], a young Tony Stark noticed a traffic jam all the way up to the Stark home. The car was pointed out by a boy named [[Peter Parker (Earth-96020)|Peter]] to his ''[[Benjamin Parker (Earth-96020)|Uncle Ben]]'' and ''[[Maybelle Parker (Earth-96020)|Aunt May]]''. Tony left the car and Meredith fearing something had happened. He ran in to find his parents missing, two Jarvises, and a handful of costumed heroes. [[Edwin Jarvis (Earth-96020)|Jarvis]] explained where the heroes had come from, but that the evil [[Tobias (Space Phantom) (Temporal Limbo)|Tobias]] had also followed them. Tobias killed the maid to draw out the Starks, then held them hostage when the Avengers confronted him. Tobias then left with the Starks looking for a way to leave the reality. Along the way, the [[Vision (Earth-616)|Vision]] was found by [[Matthew Murdock (Earth-96020)|Matt Murdock]], bumped into [[Benjamin Grimm (Earth-96020)|Ben Grimm]] and [[Susan Storm (Earth-96020)|Susan Storm]], and finally arrived at the Mansion.{{r|Avengers: Timeslide Vol 1 1}} Tony was shocked, but agreed to go with the heroes to rescue his parents. He was able to locate them in [[Latveria]]. [[Maria Stark (Earth-96020)|His mother]]'s cameo, a birthday gift that also doubled as a class project, contained an emergency signal device. Tony grabbed a prototype gauntlet he was working on and they flew to [[Castle Doom (Doomstadt)|Castle Doom]]. The battle was fierce and Tony's parents were fatally wounded when part of the ceiling gave way. Tobias was able to escape with the help of his twin. A dying Maria told her son that whatever path he took would be the right one. Tony agreed to accompany the Avengers back to [[Earth-616]], wanting to avenge his parents. That world's [[Victor von Doom (Earth-96020)|Doctor Doom]] soon investigated. He allowed the heroes to leave using his time machine, recognizing [[Steven Rogers (Earth-616)|Captain America]].{{r|Avengers: Timeslide Vol 1 1}} ===Life on Earth-616=== [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-96020) from Iron Man Vol 1 328 0001.jpg|thumb|left]] Tony was able to access his elder self's Arctic bunker and found an armor waiting for him to put on. He was easily defeated and his heart seriously wounded battling the evil Iron Man. However, the sight seemed to free Iron Man from Immortus's control. He handed over a chestplate design that would save the young man's life, and then sacrificed himself.{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 325}}{{r|Avengers Vol 1 395}} After heart surgery and donning the chestplate, the young Tony remained at Avengers Mansion. He enrolled in school, and said 'no relation' as people asked if he was named after or related to ''the'' Tony Stark. While there, he recognized [[Meredith McCall (Earth-616)|Meredith]], now a professor.{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 326}} Tony designed gauntlets to accompany his chestplate 'just in case', but did not seem interested in making a full armor. A new version of the [[Zodiac (First Sign) (Earth-616)|Zodiac]] attacked, sealing parts of the city off. The Avengers stopped them with Tony doing his best despite needing to conserve power for his chestplate.[[First Sign]] crossover. The villainous [[Sloan Alden (Earth-616)|Frostbite]] later appeared at the school, looking to attack former colleagues including Meredith, his ex-wife. Tony cobbled together a full armor. A 'Therma-shield' stopped Frostbite and safely returned his victims to normal temperature. However, [[Edwin Jarvis (Earth-616)|Jarvis]] made him return the parts he had 'borrowed' from the Avengers rooms. So Tony made a new armor that had holograms instead of being fully metallic. He battled alongside his elder self's old friend [[James Rhodes (Earth-616)|James Rhodes]] against [[Stockpile (Earth-616)|Stockpile]] to prevent the theft of older Stark armors.{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 327|331}} During [[Onslaught (Earth-616)|Onslaught]]'s attack Tony accompanied the [[T'Challa (Earth-616)|Black Panther]] to the [[Wakandan Embassy (New York City)|Wakandan Embassy]] to construct psi-shields.{{r|Iron Man Vol 1 332}} He was one of many who gave their lives to stop Onslaught, carrying [[Victor von Doom (Earth-616)|Doctor Doom]] with him.{{r|Onslaught: Marvel Universe Vol 1 1}} When Teen Tony returned from the [[Counter-Earth (Heroes Reborn)|Heroes Reborn Universe]], [[Franklin Richards (Earth-616)|Franklin Richards]] merged him with the true Iron Man.{{r|Avengers Annual Vol 1 2000}} | Powers = [[Iron Man Armor]], giving him {{Power|Superhuman Strength|super strength}}, {{Power|Invulnerability|invulnerability}}, {{Power|Self-Propelled Flight|flight}}, and various weapons. | Abilities = Although nowhere near as experienced as the 'true' Iron Man, the teenage Stark was a genius inventor and {{Ability|Engineers|engineer}}. | Strength = | Equipment = Tony used materials | History                 = ===Preface===
Unlike [[Earth-616]], Earth-98 does not operate on a [[Glossary:Sliding Timescale|Sliding Timescale]] and as such the passage of time and the details of events have progressed much slower. In this reality the [[Glossary:Modern Age|Modern Age of Heroes]] (which is identified as the birth of the [[Fantastic Four (Earth-98)|Fantastic Four]] occurred in the year 1961. Whereas the Earth-616 universe currently<ref group="note">As of the year 2016</ref> measures the Modern Age as being in existence for about fourteen years. When this reality was visited by the [[Benjamin Grimm (Earth-616)|Thing]] of [[Earth-616]], the modern age of his reality had existed for ten years, while the modern age of Earth-98 had existed for 37 years at that time. It should also be noted that while "year ten" on of the modern age of Earth-616 will always be moving forward in time, the year that Ben Grimm-616 visited this reality will always be the calendar year 1998. Events on this world appear to be more or less analogous to Earth-616, despite the differences, but the timeframe moves much slower. 

===Mentions===

Not much is known about the Iron Man of Earth-98, presumably he share a similar history to his [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Earth-616 counterpart]] although the passage of time in this reality is much slower. The only known fact about the Stark of Earth-98 is that he began his career as Iron Man back in the year 1963.{{r|Fantastic Four Annual Vol 1 1998}}

| History                 = Tony Stark met [[Stephen Strange (Earth-9810)|Stephen Strange]] at a party in his past. After giving Strange a car ride, they ended up in an accident. This accident caused permanent nerve damage to Strange's hands. Stark swore he would find a way to fix the Doctor's hands. They went to [[Tibet]] to seek a cure from the [[Yao (Earth-9810)|Ancient One]], but he was unable to help. Stark discovered that [[Karl Mordo (Earth-9810)|Baron Mordo]] was holding a curse over the Ancient One, and confronted him, but had a spell placed over him himself that magically silenced him from revealing his treachery against his master. He trained in the mystic arts as the Ancient One's apprentice until he defeated Baron Mordo. The Ancient One then proclaimed him Earth's Sorcerer Supreme.{{r|What If...? Vol 1 113}}

In the present day, Tony discovered that [[Dormammu (Earth-9810)|Dormammu]] was planning an invasion of Earth. Stark was attacked by one of Dormammu's minions, who apparently defeated him, but the minion started casting spells with hidden arms. Tony defeated him, and attempted to interrogate him, but the minion exploded. Later Tony constructed a new armor to defeat Dormammu. Stark combined his understanding of technology as well as magic to create an armor which incorporated both. It held a vast storage of magical spells in its memory, ready to be deployed at a moment's notice.{{r|What If...? Vol 1 113}}

Tony then entered Dormammu's realm and defeated his giant sentry. He was soon detected by Dormammu, but Dormammu made no moves yet. Tony took out another sentry and a spell parasite before Dormammu intervened. Tony asked him to surrender, and Dormammu refused. Tony summoned his new armor, and they began fighting. He held Dormammu off for a little while, but Dormammu took his armor and chained him up. Dormammu was able to take his armor thanks to a model provided by Dr. Strange, who had his hands restored for his reward.{{r|What If...? Vol 1 113}}

Later, while Dormammu is rallying his troops, [[Clea (Earth-9810)|Clea]] shows Dr. Strange the error of his ways. Clea tricked her father [[Orini (Earth-9810)|Orini]] (the captain of the guards) into leaving the armor unattended. Strange put it on, had it take him to Tony, and freed him. Tony took back the armor, and challenged Dormammu to astral combat. He agreed, and while Stark stalled, the armor phased apart from his body, grabbed Dormammu's, and teleported it through the multiverse. Dormammu was forced to retreat in his astral form to pursue it. Tony returned to Earth, and Strange stayed in the [[Dark Dimension]] with Clea.{{r|What If...? Vol 1 113}}

During the fight,  [[Thor Odinson (Earth-985)|Thor]] quickly threw his hammer at the Carnage Cosmic, but the Carnage Cosmic wrapped the hammer in symbiotic webbing and transformed into a giant spike heading back to Thor's hand. Fortunately, Iron Man managed to use his repulsors to break the symbiotic webbing, returning the use of Thor's hammer. Before the Avengers could rally themselves, the Carnage Cosmic blasted them all to the ground and flew off to create for mayhem. 

After returning to [[Avengers Mansion]] to tend to the [[Vision (Earth-985)|Vision]]'s injuries and discussing the events that led to the Carnage Symbiote bonding with the Sulver Surfer.

During the second battle with the Carnage Cosmic, Iron Man and the others were once again easily bested by the Carnage Cosmic. Firestar managed to harm the symbiote enough to allow the Silver Surfer control over his body. Realizing that there was only way to stop the Carnage symbiote, the Silver Surfer flew himself into the sun, destroying both himself and the symbiote.{{r|What If...? Vol 1 108}}

| History                 = From all appearances the history of Earth-9966 closely mirrored that of [[Earth-616]] until the faithful day when Reed Richards and his friends tested out his newly built spacecraft. In this reality, the four people aboard were killed in the crash, thus the Fantastic Four never existed in this reality. As a result the [[Namor McKenzie (Earth-9966)|Sub-Mariner]] remained an amnesmatic derelict for a while longer. His memories were restored when his fellow tenants at a New York flop-house injected him with morphine and dumped his body in the ocean. The water revived Namor's memories. He then recovered the [[Horn of Proteus]] and used it to summon a massive sea creature called Gargantus to attack the surface. Even without a Fantastic Four in this reality, Namor was eventually driven back.

Finding his people in [[Atlantis]], Namor married his long time lover [[Dorma (Earth-9966)|Lady Dorma]] and then began plotting to take over the surface world. Allying himself with his counsin [[Aquaria Neptunia (Earth-9966)|Namora]] his daughter [[Namorita Prentiss (Earth-9966)|Namorita]] as well as [[Lemurians (Homo mermanus)|Lemurian]] rulers [[Llyra Morris (Earth-9966)|Llyra]] and [[Karthon (Earth-9966)|Karthon]] as well as the barbarian [[Attuma (Earth-9966)|Attuma]], Namor was able to accomplish this goal. Addressing the United Nations he told them surface dwellers that they could live their lives as long as they respected the will of New Atlantis. Namor then set up a new palace in New York City. 

Iron Man was a member of his realities [[Avengers (Earth-9966)|Avengers]]. When Namor first took over the world the Avengers resisted him. Eventually when they discovered Namor could not be overthrown the learned to live under his rule.

| History                 = The young Tony Stark lost his [[Howard Stark (Earth-99916)|father]] just as he was planning to show him the [[Iron Man Armor|armor]] he invented. The accident during which this happened seriously damaged Tony's heart, so he had an [[Arc Reactor|implant]] installed next to it to keep it stable. He eventually decided to start saving the day as Iron Man, using his armor to mask his identity. He eventually gained two confidants, [[Patricia Potts (Earth-99916)|Pepper Potts]] and [[James Rhodes (Earth-99916)|James Rhodes]], who assisted him in his superheroics. During one of his exploits, the villainous [[Arthur Parks (Earth-99916)|Living Laser]] attracted his attention by destroying the [[Roxxon Tower]], almost crushing a nearby child's dad under the rubble, though Iron Man defeated the villain and rescued the boy's dad.

Iron Man lated battled [[Ghost (Earth-99916)|Ghost]] in front of the [[Empire State University]], which was reported on the news. [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-99916)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]], a spy organization headed by [[Nicholas Fury (Earth-99916)|Nick Fury]], recruited rookie agent [[Clinton Barton (Earth-99916)|Clint Barton]], codenamed Hawkeye, to look for him. Meanwhile, he was on the roof of a building trying to track down Ghost's location with the help of Pepper. After [[Natalia Romanova (Earth-99916)|Black Widow]] and Hawkeye raided them, Iron Man cleared everything up and, not wanting to give up to S.H.I.E.L.D., flew away with Pepper. After that, Tony managed to track down Ghost's location, but Hawkeye snuck up on him, having figured out he is Iron Man. Still not wanting to get taken to Fury, Iron Man decided to firt head over to Ghost's lair using his Stealth Armor so Fury wouldn't be able to track him. After defeating Ghost, Hawkeye decided to spare Iron Man, having made sure he means no harm to anyone.{{r|Iron Man: Armored Adventures Vol 1 1}}
