| History                 = '''Tony Stark''' lost his parents in a car crash at the age of twenty-one and had to take over and learn how to navigate the family business of [[Stark Industries (Earth-99925)|Stark Industries]]. While in [[Sin-Cong]], he was injured by a shrapnel and captured by the warlord [[Wong-Chu (Earth-99925)|Wong-Chu]]. [[Ho Yinsen (Earth-99925)|Ho Yinsen]]'s sacrifice allowed him to escape in [[Iron Man Armor Model 1]], while marine [[James Rhodes (Earth-99925)|James Rhodes]] helped him get to safety.{{r|Iron Man: Femme Fatales}}

Tony soon began operating as armored hero '''Iron Man''' and joined the [[Avengers (Earth-99925)|Avengers]], while also working closely with [[Supreme Headquarters International Espionage Law-Enforcement Division (Earth-99925)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] despite refusing an official position. His fiancée [[Joanna Nivena (Earth-99925)|Joanna Nivena]] left him soon after his return, but despite the public reputation as a womanizer, Tony was unable to get intimate with any woman, as no matter how much they were over him, all turned cold the moment the clothes came off and they saw his chestplate that prevented a piece of shrapnel from reaching his heart and killing him.{{r|Iron Man: Femme Fatales}}

This was exploited by [[Ophelia Sarkissian (Earth-99925)|Madame Hydra]] who under the name "Katalin" injected herself into Stark's social circle and let him become obsessed with her. She was the only woman in Stark's life who was fascinated with his chestplate instead of being repulsed by it. Their physical relationship ensured that Stark was preoccupied at the precise time [[Hydra (Earth-99925)|Hydra]] was hitting Stark Industries facilities with attacks that covered their acts of theft, leaving Stark unable to respond in time as Iron Man. Other companies of Tony's peers in the industry were hit as well, but even after comparing the manifests of missing items he was unable to perceive a pattern or figure out what the stolen parts were for.{{r|Iron Man: Femme Fatales}}

As it turned out, Stark Industries was being hit by two unrelated parties at once. [[Whitney Frost (Earth-99925)|Madame Masque]] had infiltrated the company by getting a job as "Gabriella Marquez". Unlike Hydra, who were after specific components for their superweapon, Madame Masque would steal anything she could get her hands on and let her [[Maggia (Earth-99925)|Maggia]] contacts sell it on the black market to whoever was willing to pay. These completely unrelated items were assumed to be stolen by Hydra, leaving Tony Stark with no clue as to how these components would fit together. Hydra was able to complete and activate their superweapon, but with the help of S.H.I.E.L.D., Iron Man was able to stop them in time. Both Madame Hydra and Madame Masque managed to get away, with "Gabriella Marquez" falling completely beneath Stark's suspicion and only being exposed by [[Virginia Potts (Earth-99925)|Petter Potts]].{{r|Iron Man: Femme Fatales}}

| History                 = ===Early Life===
The early history of Tony Stark largely mirrors that of his [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Earth-616 counterpart]]. 

Tony Stark was a brilliant mind, a scientist and industrialist whose weapons were seen as the way to end conflicts around the world. One day, he fell victim to the same sort of weaponry he had created for his own country, and was mortally wounded and captured by the warlord [[Wong-Chu (Earth-9997)|Wong-Chu]]. Forced to produce weapons for Wong-Chu, Tony instead built a vest to prevent the shrapnel deep in his chest from reaching his heart. He was aided by [[Ho Yinsen (Earth-9997)|Professor Yinsen]], who helped him create an iron suit that would keep Tony alive and stop Wong-Chu. With Yinsen's sacrifice, Tony succeeded in escaping and became the hero known as Iron Man.{{r|Earth X Vol 1 12}} 

Tony gave himself over to the world's service, creating weapons and technology for [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-9997)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] and helped form the [[Avengers (Earth-9997)|Avengers]]. Struggling with his inner demons, Tony succumbed to alcoholism for a time.{{r|Earth X Vol 1 12}} 

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-9997) from Marvels X Vol 1 4 001.jpg|thumb|left]]
===Mutation of Humanity===
Following the mutation of the human race due to the release of [[Terrigen Mist]]s into the Earth's atmosphere, Tony isolated himself to avoid mutating, fearing how mutation would alter him, and what it would unleash upon the world.{{r|Earth X Vol 1 1}}{{r|Earth X Vol 1 12}} At first, Tony continually wore his armor in an effort to stave off the mutations. He forged an alliance with former super villain [[Norman Osborn (Earth-9997)|Norman Osborn]], now president of the [[United States of America|United States]]. Osborn granted Tony political asylum and the remains of the [[SJ3RX (Earth-9997)|Red Ronin Armor]] in exchange for Stark's help in fighting the [[Hydra (Earth-9997)|Hydra]] invasion and feeding the nation's citizens.{{r|Earth X Vol 1 11}} 

Tony used the Red Ronin Armor as the base of his new home, Iron Manor, situated in [[New York City]]. Tony secretly planned to seize control  of the country from Osborn in due time, planning to create an army of [[Iron Man|Iron Men]] to police the nation. Tony would spend 15 years building this army, but ultimately hesitated in launching them, unsure that he actually wanted to be in control of the country.{{r|Earth X Vol 1 11}} During this time, Stark also created the [[Seven Silver Samurai (Earth-9997)|Seven Silver Samurai]]. These seven robots were given to [[Sonfire (Earth-9997)|Lord Sunfire]], the son of the original [[Shiro Yoshida (Earth-9997)|Sunfire]], to help defend [[Japan]] and its neighboring regions.{{r|Paradise X: Xen Vol 1 1}} 

With his home under constant attack by mutated humans who resented Tony for remaining unchanged, he constructed the [[Iron Avengers (Earth-9997)|Iron Avengers]], programmed with the personalities and characteristics of all the [[Avengers (Earth-9997)|Avengers]] who fell in battle against the [[Carl Creel (Earth-9997)|Absorbing Man]]. This group was led by the lone survivor of the battle, the [[Vision (Earth-9997)|Vision]]. Stark would make the Iron Avengers available to President Osborn, using them to combat the [[Hydra (Earth-9997)|Hydra]], and also constructed various other weapons and devices for Osborn.{{r|Earth X Vol 1 1}} 
 
Tony was one of few to maintain contact with [[Reed Richards (Earth-9997)|Reed Richards]], who had isolated himself following the mutation of humanity and disbandment of the [[Fantastic Four (Earth-9997)|Fantastic Four]]. During a holographic call, Tony confided in him that he was being plagued by dreams of a [[Mar-Vell (Earth-9997)|man]] with the universe inside of him, and when looking for Earth inside this man, he found it covered by silver.{{r|Earth X Vol 1 2}} 

[[File:Iron Man 2020 Vol 2 1 Marvels X Variant Textless.jpg|right|200px|thumb|Old Man Tony]]
===Rise of the Skull and the Final Host===
Following the assassination of Osborn by the [[Benjamin Beckley (Earth-9997)|Skull]], Captain America came to Tony for help against the Skull's army. Tony refused to help personally, believing the Iron Avengers could stop the Skull's army. The Iron Avengers were easily destroyed however, and Tony remained passive even after their destruction.{{r|Earth X Vol 1 10}}  Captain America succeeded in killing the Skull and freeing his army of slaves. Shortly thereafter, the [[Celestials#Earth X (Earth-9997)|Celestials]] arrived on Earth, having come to scour it of all life. Tony was filled in on the Celestials' schemes and true nature by Reed Richards;  that they had impregnated the Earth with an infant Celestial, and genetically modified humanity's ancestors to serve as the infant's defenders. Now that humanity had prematurely mutated, they had come to destroy them.{{r|Earth X Vol 1 11}}  

In an effort to buy the Earth time, he transformed Iron Manor into a giant suit of armor, using it to distract the Celestials before the arrival of [[Franklin Richards (Earth-9997)|Galactus]], who had been summoned by [[Blackagar Boltagon (Earth-616)|Black Bolt]] of the [[Inhumans (Inhomo supremis)#Earth X (Earth-9997)|Inhumans]]. Before leaving, he gave [[Vision (Earth-9997)|Vision]] the schematics for the [[Iron Avengers (Earth-9997)|Iron Avengers]], asking him to rebuild them if he could.{{r|Earth X Vol 1 11}} During the fight, the Iron Manor was destroyed. While Stark survived its destruction, he was impaled by some of the wreckage, and died shortly after realizing he was finally outside in the open air for the first time in decades.{{r|Earth X Vol 1 12}}  

===Realm of the Dead===
Upon his death, Tony found himself trapped in the [[Realm of the Dead]], locked in eternal combat against other deceased superhumans, while still believing himself to be alive. He was recruited by [[Mar-Vell (Earth-9997)|Captain Mar-Vell]] in his quest to destroy [[Death]]
and free the souls of the dead. Tony helped Mar-Vell recruit others to his cause, and was one of the many heroes who participated in the final battle against Death.{{r|Universe X Vol 1 X}}   

Following Death's death, Stark was invited to live in [[Paradise (Mar-Vell)|Paradise]], a new afterlife constructed by Mar-Vell. There, Mar-Vell selected Stark to become one of his [[Avenging Host (Earth-9997)|Avenging Host]]. Using the [[Herbert Wyndham (Earth-9997)|High Evolutionary]]'s devices, Stark was transmogrified into an angelic being of metallic composition. Joining the Host - which comprised Captain America, [[Victor von Doom (Earth-9997)|Victor Von Doom]], [[Henry Pym (Earth-9997)|Henry Pym]], [[Jean Grey (Earth-9997)|Phoenix]] and [[Matthew Murdock (Earth-9997)|Matt Murdock]] - they defended the people of Paradise and helped guide other dead souls from the [[Realm of the Dead]] into Paradise.{{r|Paradise X Vol 1 1}}  

When the Host realized that with each new addition, Paradise would expand and consume a portion of the [[Negative Zone]], the Avenging Host began to question Mar-Vell's intentions. The Avenging Host confronted Mar-Vell at the same moment as the [[Kree#Earth-9997|Kree]] invaded Paradise. Tony and the rest of the Avenging Host were destroyed by Mar-Vell.{{r|Paradise X: A Vol 1 1}}   However, this was all an elaborate attempt to pass on the Cosmic Consciousness to [[Reed Richards (Earth-9997)|Reed Richards]]. Mar-Vell revealed that Paradise was not consuming the Negative Zone, but rather enveloping it and all the universe in a protective sphere that would guard all life from the [[Celestials]] and other [[Elders of the Universe]]. Before handing over the cosmic consciousness to Reed, Mar-Vell resurrected Tony and the Avenging Host. With Captain America departing the group, they recruited a new member; [[Clinton Barton (Earth-9997)|Hawkeye]].{{r|Paradise X: X Vol 1 1}}  

| Powers                  = During his mortal life, Tony Stark was a normal human and never developed any super human abilities, choosing to quarantine himself when the rest of humanity began to mutate. His potential for superhuman powers from exposure to Terrigen Mists was thus never explored.

As a member of the Avenging Host, Stark's skin was of an organic metal of unknown composition and durability, which had a close resemblance to the armor he wore in his mortal guise. Additionally, he had angelic wings of similar composition that allowed him to fly.

The extent of Stark's powers as a member of the Avenging Host have yet to be explored; however, it is entirely possible that his powers may be similar in kind to his armor when he was alive, drawing from biological means as opposed to technological.

| Abilities               = Tony Stark was a brilliant inventor and was able to build many high tech devices and weapons. It is presumable that his skill and ability in this regard is either the same as or rivaling that of his Earth-616 counterpart.
| Weaknesses              =

| AdditionalAttributes    = When Tony was alive, he was a recovered alcoholic who once had a powerful drinking problem. In his later life he had become a hypochondriac, fearing exposure to others would cause him to mutate.

In his past, he had a piece of shrapnel in his heart which threatened to pierce it.

| Equipment               = In his early career, Stark had access to the resources of his own company, Stark International, and utilized various items and peripherals to his Iron Man armor, chief among those a special pacemaker which prevented a piece of shrapnel from piercing his heart.

In later years, he had his own personal assembly line inside Iron Manor, which also utilized many sanitation and sterilization methods and defensive measures for himself to prevent him from being exposed to the contagion that caused the rest of the human population to mutate.

He also developed a new chest-plate which connected him to Iron Manor's computers, and possibly also acted as a pacemaker as well due to his advanced age.
| Transportation          = While Tony Stark never left Iron Manor, the building itself could convert into a robot which was capable of mobility and flight.
| Weapons                 = In his early career, Stark had the weapons resources of Stark International, and constructed himself various suits of armor which he used in the guise of Iron Man. All of these armors are similar in composition to that of his Earth-616 counterpart.

In later years, Stark's factory Iron Manor was built out of the Red Ronin armor, and utilized its many abilities and weapons, which were incorporated into the Manor's robot mode. He also created the Iron Avengers, robots based on a combination of his Iron Man armor and various members of the Avengers. Each one was programmed with the personality and similar abilities of the Avenger they represented. He created Iron Avengers based on the Wasp, Goliath, Hawkeye, Quicksilver and the Scarlet Witch.

Stark also had converted his various suits of Armor into Iron Men robots which presumably had the same abilities as the armors did when he wore them personally, but could act independently or via pre-programmed directives. The extent of these Iron Men robots abilities are unknown as all were destroyed by the Celestials.

In the Realm of the Dead, Stark wore a suit of armor resembling one of his earlier armor designs, while this suit of armor was metaphysical in its existence, it presumably operated on the same principles as the armor did in real life.
| Notes                   =
| Trivia                  = * This reality's Iron Man, bears similarities to the inspiration of the [[Earth-616]] [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Iron Man]]. This inspiration was {{WP|Howard Hughes}}; and this Iron Man and Howard Hughes are hypochondriacs, reclusive from society, and have long beards.

| History                 = '''Iron Man''' is a superhero. His past story possibly parallels to some point [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)#History|that]] of his [[Earth-616]] [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|counterpart]], with the variations due to the tongue-in-cheek, fourth-wall-breaking nature of [[Earth-TRN1046]]. For example, Iron Man kept his armor on even when it serves to no apparent use, such as while watching a movie in the theater.{{r|New Avengers (ES) Vol 1 29}} As a superhero, Iron Man specialized in stopping assaults.{{r|X-Patrol (ES) Vol 5 76}} Iron Man's armor is similar to [[Iron Man Armor Model 4]] in appearance, allowing him to fly,{{r|New Avengers (ES) Vol 1 19}} but it requires frequent oiling lest it would start squaking whenever Iron Man makes every single move. This noise does not bother Iron Man himself, but people close to him may find it annoying, especially in an otherwise silent environment.{{r|New Avengers (ES) Vol 1 29}}

In Christmas '87, [[Comics Forum (Earth-TRN1046)|Comics Forum]], the company printing [[Marvel Comics]] in [[Spain]], arranged for the superheroes to congratulate the [[Reader (Earth-TRN1046)|readers]] for Christmas in a card. Newcoming superhero [[Superioribus (Earth-TRN1046)|Superioribus]] hogged the microphone after giving his line, intent on singing a Christmas carol to the readers. The superheroes just behind him (including Iron Man, who was only two positions after him) booed at Superioribus, as they wanted their chance to address the readers too.{{r|New Avengers Christmas Special (ES) Vol 1 1987}}

At one time, Iron Man heard of an assault taking place - an elderly woman being mugged by a single assaulter. Iron Man flew to help her. Fellow superheroes Superioribus and [[Jonathan Storm (Earth-TRN1046)|la Antorcha Humana]] had also heard her cry for help and collided with Iron Man just over the crime scene. Their powers and speed interacted in a way that caused a nuclear-like explosion that destroyed several buildings, making the now-ash-covered woman to swear she'd never ask for help again.{{r|New Avengers (ES) Vol 1 19}}

Superioribus was thus not a person of the liking of several people in the superhero community. At one point, Superioribus was approached by a small kid who naïvely believed to be stronger than Superioribus because, as requested by his older relatives, the kid always finished off up his [[Tola-Tao (Earth-TRN1046)|Tola-Tao]] and [[La Vaca Que Llora (Earth-TRN1046)|La Vaca Que Llora]] teso; Superioribus armwrestled the kid and let him win so as to promote his lifestyle. Iron Man joined other superheroes, including la Antorcha Humana, [[Steven Rogers (Earth-TRN1046)|Capitán América]], [[Benjamin Grimm (Earth-TRN1046)|la Cosa]], and [[Peter Parker (Earth-TRN1046)|Spiderman]], reprimanding Superioribus for discreting the whole trade and accused him of looking for Tola-Tao and La Vaca Que Llora sponsorships. Iron Man was worried about what the people would think of superheroes.{{r|New Avengers (ES) Vol 1 23}}

At a later time, Iron Man was notified of a bank assault, and decided to take care of it - only to arrive and find several other superheroes in the bank's vicinity arguing on who would take care of the situation. Iron Man joined the heated debated, insisting that he was the most qualified hero for that kind of crime, then Superioribus said that he was to solve the situation solo, without any argument. The other superheroes joined forces to debate against Superioribus, but then Superioribus [[Glossary:Fourth wall|broke the fourth wall]] by showing the story's title, thus proving that he was the protagonist. Iron Man and the other superheroes begrudgingly allowed Superioribus to leave, accusing him of rudeness and minimising the event, while Superioribus believed they were just jealous - but they had taken so much time arguing, that the police had already arrested the thieves without superhero help.{{r|X-Patrol (ES) Vol 5 76}}

Apparently making peace with Superioribus, Iron Man joined him to watch a movie in the theater. However, Iron Man had failed to oil his armor and whenever he made a small move on his seat, the armor screeched, which was a nuisance for Superioribus enjoying the movie (apparently not affecting other viewers who were farther from Iron Man). After the end of the movie, it was Superioribus' turn to reprimand Iron Man and swear he wouldn't ever go to the movies with him again.{{r|New Avengers (ES) Vol 1 29}}

| History                 = 
Tony Stark was a billionaire inventor and the CEO of [[Stark Industries (Earth-TRN1222)|Stark Industries]]. After demonstrating his [[Jericho Missile]] in [[Afghanistan]], Stark was kidnapped by terrorists and forced to build for them but he instead built a [[Iron Man Armor MK I (Earth-199999)|suit of armor]]  and used it to escape. After returning to the [[United States of America|United States]], Tony created a new [[Iron Man Armor MK III (Earth-199999)|upgraded armor]] powered by an [[Arc Reactor]]. Sometime after, Tony ended up fighting against his former business partner [[Obadiah Stane (Earth-TRN1222)|Obadiah Stane]] in his own [[Iron Monger Armor (Earth-199999)|armor]].

After his fight with Stane, Tony was met by [[Phillip Coulson (Earth-TRN1222)|Phil Coulson]] who reviewed footage of Stark's fight and gave him a tour of the [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] base. Coulson told Stark that S.H.I.E.L.D.'s espionage unit had prepared an alibi to cover up Stark's identity which was dubbed "Iron Man" by the press. The next day, at the conference, Stark instead decided to make his identity as Iron Man public, much to Coulson's annoyance.{{r|Iron Man: Fast Friends Vol 1 2}}

Iron Man was monitored by [[Nicholas Fury (Earth-TRN1222)|Nick Fury]] as one of the heroes he wanted to join his [[Avengers (Earth-TRN1222)|Avengers initiative]].{{r|Marvel's The Avengers: The Avengers Initiative Vol 1 1}} Following the [[Battle of New York]], Stark had become a member of the team. Iron Man joined the rest of the Avengers in a battle against [[Hydra (Earth-TRN1222)|Hydra]] leader [[Doctor Jensen (Earth-TRN1222)|Doctor Jensen]], which ended with the heroes successful.{{r|Avengers: Operation Hydra Vol 1 1}}

For unknown reasons, Tony later left the Avengers, choosing to instead work on his technology in [[Stark Tower]]. [[Steven Rogers (Earth-TRN1222)|Captain America]] contacted Tony, asking him to join the Avengers as an advisor to stop the threat in eastern Europe, although tony declined as he said that the [[Quinjet]] would get there long before he could. Following the Avengers defeat of Hydra, Tony had completed a unique [[Iron Man Gauntlet]] that could be summoned from a wrist watch.{{r|Captain America: Road to War Vol 1 1}}

At some point, Iron Man teamed up with [[Peter Parker (Earth-TRN1222)|Spider-Man]], an event that was glimpsed by the [[Miles Morales (Earth-1610)|Miles Morales]] of [[Earth-1610]] while being pulled through the [[Web of Life and Destiny]].{{r|Spider-Verse Vol 3 1}}

| History                 = Tony Stark was on a business call with Warren Worthington. When finished, Tony allowed Pepper to speak to him, and Pepper asked Tony if Happy Hogan had spoken to him. Tony realized Happy hadn't and listened to his voice mails as he and Pepper got into the car. As he listened the voice mails in horror, he came to the realization that Happy was dead but refused to believe it until he saw for himself. Tony soon arrived on the scene of the attack and found the place where Happy's body lay, then looked around the scene and saw the Destroyer Armor. He tried to walk to the armor only for part of his clothing to get caught by Mjolnir, he tried to grab Mjolnir but the hammer didn't budge. Suddenly lightning struck and took the hammer to sky to Tony's shock, causing him to have a heart attack at which point Pepper called the EMTs. While in his limbo state of being both alive and dead Tony came to the conclusions that Happy had been killed, it was done by a machine, Tony needed to take revenge, and for that he needed to take the armor. When Tony woke up in a hospital room, Pepper informed him that due to his heart attack he'd been out for nearly 24 hours.

Tony pulled his connection in the government to get the Destroyer Armor to him, while he began working on where it came from and how to get there. He recruited astrobiologist [[Jane Foster (Earth-TRN1364)|Jane Foster]] to work on the project, but she turned out to be hiding secrets of her own. When an energy spike identical the one that preceded the first attack was detected, Stark sent Foster with a team to the site, but she ditched her escort with the help of [[Asgardians]]. Keeping tabs on her, Tony arrived in person and retrieved [[Mjolnir]] which was being carried by Jane's daughter [[Frigga Foster-Thorsdottir (Earth-TRN1364)|Quinn]]. With the Destroyer transformed into the Iron Destroyer Armor for himself, Stark used Mjolnir to open a dimensional gateway to Asgard. [[Loki Laufeyson (Earth-TRN1364)|Loki]] and [[Rūna (Earth-TRN1364)|Valkyrie]] arrived to stop him, and during their fight Tony's armor was disabled and his heart gave out once again. Loki used Mjolnir to restart it back, and Stark would live to begin a long process of recovery, for the time being using a wheelchair.{{r|''[[What If... Loki Was Worthy?]]''}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-TRN1382) from Marvel Super Heroes 4D (London) 001.jpg|thumb|left]]
Iron Man, alongside [[Peter Parker (Earth-TRN1382)|Spider-Man]], [[Steven Rogers (Earth-TRN1382)|Captain America]], [[James Howlett (Earth-TRN1382)|Wolverine]] and [[Bruce Banner (Earth-TRN1382)|Hulk]], were invited to a supposed hero awards gathering in [[London]]. Upon arriving at the location, Cap found a note saying that the gathering was cancelled. This was soon revealed to be a setup however, as shorthly after the heroes' arrival, [[Victor von Doom (Earth-TRN1382)|Doctor Doom]] ambushed them with an army of giant robots and tried to destroy the city with his drones, which would create a nuclear explosion when linked with each other. To prevent the explosion from devastating London, Tony reversed the polarity of his electromagnetic shield to become a giant magnet, attracting the drones. After taking the drones into space along with Doctor Doom, he reversed his polarity again, seperating himself from the drones and Doom, and quickly started flying back to Earth. However, he still got caught in the explosion, causing him to fall uncontrollably towards Earth. He was saved by [[Carol Danvers (Earth-TRN1382)|Ms. Marvel]] at the last second, with her subsequently carrying him to the [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] [[Helicarrier]]. There, Tony was given a medal alongside his fellow heroes for saving the day.{{r|Marvel Super Heroes 4D (first version)}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-TRN1382) from Marvel Super Heroes 4D (second version) 001.jpg|thumb|left]]
While Tony was presenting a new reactor technology to the public, the presentation was attacked by [[Victor von Doom (Earth-TRN1382)|Doctor Doom]] and his [[Doombot]] army with the intention of stealing the reactor. Tony immediately donned his armor and signaled the [[Avengers (Earth-TRN1382)|Avengers]], with Captain America, Hulk and [[Thor Odinson (Earth-TRN1382)|Thor]] responding to the signal. Alongside Spider-Man, who happened to be near the scene, the heroes managed to defeat the Doombot army. Meanwhile, Doctor Doom readied the reactor to power up a weapon satelitte with enough energy to level the city they were on to destroy the heroes with it. All of a sudden, [[Loki Laufeyson (Earth-TRN1382)|Loki]], who was in cohorts with Doctor Doom, emerged accompanied by a [[Frost Giant]] to keep the heroes busy and to prevent them from powering down the reactor. During all the chaos they managed to defeat the Frost Giant and capture Doctor Doom. However, they proves too late in stopping the reactor from powering up the satelitte. As the satelitte fired a beam immediately after, Iron Man quickly flew towards the sky to stop it with his repulsor blasts. While his repulsors proved unable to stop the beam for long, Thor came to his help and powered Iron Man's armor with his lightning. This boost gave Tony enough power to push the beam back to its source, destroying the satelitte.{{r|Marvel Super Heroes 4D (second version)}}

| History                 = [[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-TRN1444) from Marvel Rivals 006.png|thumb|left]]
Wounded by a weapon of his own design, billionaire inventor Tony Stark created a [[Iron Man Armor|custom-made suit of armor]] to keep himself alive. Though his wounds have healed, his upgraded armor now saves the lives of countless others when Tony dons it to become the world's greatest fighting machine — [[Iron Man|The Invincible Iron Man]]!

When the legions of the night descended upon [[New York City]], Iron Man and his fellow [[Avengers (Earth-TRN1444)|Avengers]] turned their tower into a stronghold. From there, Tony leads the effort to unravel the mysteries of [[Chronovium]] and to reverse the Timestream Entanglement.{{r|Marvel Rivals}}

Prior to the Timestream Entanglement, he and [[Emma Frost (Earth-TRN1444)|Emma Frost]] were married. He had also created the [[Stark Sentinel MK I|Stark Sentinels]] though these would remain in storage as [[Mutants (Homo superior)|Mutants]] would prove to be valuable allies.<ref>[[Marvel Rivals]] - Cerebro Database II: Iron Man lore: Stark Sentinel</ref>

===Eternal Night Falls===
Iron Man and the [[Avengers (Earth-TRN1444)|Avengers]] turned [[Stark Tower|Avengers Tower]] into a stronghold during [[Vlad Dracula (Earth-TRN1444)|Dracula]]'s takeover of [[New York City]].{{r|Marvel Rivals}} The Stark Sentinels were brought out of storage to combat the vampire threat, with [[F.R.I.D.A.Y. (Earth-TRN1444)|F.R.I.D.A.Y.]] piloting one of them.<ref>[[Marvel Rivals]] - Cerebro Database II: Iron Man lore: Stark Sentinel</ref><ref>[[Marvel Rivals]] - Invisible Woman lore: Built to Last</ref>

Iron Man and [[Reed Richards (Earth-TRN1444)|Mister Fantastic]] began working on the [[Timestream Reintegration Device]] to restore the damaged timelines to their original state.<ref>[[Marvel Rivals]] - Mister Fantastic lore: Reality Check</ref> While out on patrol, he encountered [[Marc Spector (Earth-TRN1444)|Moon Knight]], who had a plan to stop the vampire threat.<ref>[[Marvel Rivals]] - Iron Man lore: Universal Rules</ref> The pair would later argue against Reed and [[Stephen Strange (Earth-TRN1444)|Doctor Strange]] in the [[Baxter Building]] on the best plan of action to deal with the vampires.<ref>[[Marvel Rivals]] - Empire of Eternal Night: Midtown</ref> Later forming the [[Eternity Knights (Earth-TRN1444)|Eternity Knights]] to take the fight to the streets.<ref>[[Marvel Rivals]] - Eternal Night Falls: Midnight Missions</ref> He would later stop Reed and Strange from activating the T.R.D. without the [[Vampiric Verses]] and [[Montesi Formula]].<ref>[[Marvel Rivals]] - Iron Man lore: Turning the Pages</ref>

===Hellfire Gala===
Iron Man rebooted [[Ultron (Earth-TRN1445)|Ultron]]'s original body, creating a [[Ultron (Duplicate) (Earth-TRN1445)|duplicate]] who would fight on their side to defeat the original.<ref>[[Marvel Rivals]] - Hellfire Gala: A Lesser Evil</ref>

<!--===The Abyss Awakens===-->

===The New Marauders===
Iron Man joined [[Emma Frost (Earth-TRN1444)|Emma Frost's]] New Marauders, and he upgraded the [[New Marauder|New Marauder]] for space transport. Emma Frost explained the rescue mission they were about to begin and why they were doing it, as Stark couldn't comprehend Deadpool's brand of Lunacy. The mission ended up being a success as [[Edward Brock (Earth-TRN1444)|Venom]] located [[Jeffrey (Land Shark) (Earth-TRN1444)|Jeff]].<ref>[[Marvel Rivals]] - Night at the Museum: The New Marauders</ref>

Due to his intelligence, he was kidnapped by the [[Ten Rings (Earth-TRN1568)|Ten Rings]] who forced him to create weapons. However, Stark created an [[Iron Man Armor MK I (Earth-199999)|Iron Man Armor]] instead and broke free. He then went after the [[Maggia (Earth-TRN1568)|Maggia]], who took exception to him shutting down weapons manufacturing at his company when he returned home. Stark fought [[Marco Scarlotti (Earth-TRN1568)|Whiplash]] and [[Whitney Frost (Earth-TRN1568)|Whitney Frost]], killing them both and ending the Maggia.

Stark then found out about [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-TRN1568)|Advanced Idea Mechanics]], who were searching for a power source. Stark fought off their attempts at nuclear power and a power source from a prototype destroyer. He fought [[Boris Bullski (Earth-TRN1568)|Boris Bullski]] in this time as well as [[Basil Sandhurst (Earth-TRN1568)|Basil Sandhurst]] and [[Bruno Horgan (Earth-TRN1568)|Bruno Horgan]]. Eventually, Stark found out about [[Obadiah Stane (Earth-TRN1568)|Obadiah Stane]]'s betrayal as he was dealing with A.I.M. Once A.I.M. was defeated, Stark killed Stane in a battle.{{r|Iron Man (video game)}}

| History                 = ===Origins===
In the midst of a kidnapping at the hands of terrorists, billionaire industrialist '''Tony Stark''' suffered a near-fatal chest wound. Using skilled intellect, Tony was able constructed a sophisticated [[Iron Man Armor|suit of armor]] that helped stabilize his injury and allowed him to escape. Coming out his capture a changed man, he then vowed to use his resources and intellect to protect the world as the invincible '''Iron Man'''.{{r|[https://web.archive.org/web/20191202020911/http://www.marveluniverselive.com/ Marvel Universe Live! Age of Heroes Official Website]; Iron Man's profile}}

As Iron Man, Tony went on to serve as member of the [[Avengers (Earth-TRN1722)|Avengers]].{{r|Marvel Universe Live! Prelude Vol 1 1}} At some point, he also began mentoring the young hero [[Peter Parker (Earth-TRN1722)|Spider-Man]] aka Peter Parker.{{r|Marvel Universe Live! Age of Heroes Prequel Vol 1 1}}

===Super Heroes Assemble Prelude===
[[File:Avengers (Earth-TRN1722), Peter Parker (Earth-TRN1722), and Loki Laufeyson (Earth-TRN1722) from Marvel Universe Live! Prelude Vol 1 1 001.png|thumb|180px|left|Avengers v. Loki]]
When [[Johann Schmidt (Earth-TRN1722)|Red Skull]] sought to wield the [[Cosmic Cube]], Iron Man and the other [[Avengers (Earth-TRN1722)|Avengers]] set out to try and stop him. While Red Skull was initially able to down a majority of the team, including Iron Man, a one-two punch from [[Thor Odinson (Earth-TRN1722)|Thor]] and [[Steven Rogers (Earth-TRN1722)|Captain America]] knocked him out, allowing the Avengers to secure the cube. Taking it back to [[Avengers Tower]], Tony Stark began tinkering with it, inadvertently blowing a hole through the tower the process. As he did that, Tony tasked [[Peter Parker (Earth-TRN1722)|Peter Parker]] with running a diagnostic on his [[Lectro Link]] device, as he was afraid that Cosmic Cube was interfering with it. Before Peter could do this however, it was revealed [[Loki Laufeyson (Earth-TRN1722)|Loki]] had infiltrated the tower in the attempt to steal the cube. Shortly thereafter, a battle between Loki and the Avengers ensued, with the Avengers seemingly coming out victorious.{{r|Marvel Universe Live! Prelude Vol 1 1}}

| History                 = The son of industrialist and weapons manufacturer [[Howard Stark (Earth-TRN1755)|Howard Stark]], '''Tony Stark''' grew up to take over his father's company, [[Stark Industries (Earth-TRN1755)|Stark Industries]]. When he learned of the actual destruction his company's weapons were causing, Tony decided to get out of the weapons game and instead used his genius to become the hero known as '''Iron Man'''. 

His activities as Iron Man soon attracted the attention of [[Ivan Vanko (Whiplash) (Earth-TRN1755)|Whiplash]], who, with the help of [[Justin Hammer (Earth-TRN1755)|Justin Hammer]], was able to nearly defeat the armored hero. With the assistance of [[James Rhodes (Earth-TRN1755)|War Machine]], however, he was ultimately able to gain the upper hand and defeat Whiplash. Following this ordeal, Tony named his longtime assistant and love interest, [[Virginia Potts (Earth-TRN1755)|Pepper Potts]], to take over his role as CEO of Stark Industries.

A few years later, Iron Man assembled alongside other heroes to become a founding member of the [[Avengers (Earth-TRN1755)|Avengers]]. Together, the Avengers were able to defeat [[Loki Laufeyson (Earth-TRN1755)|Loki]] and his invading [[Chitauri]] forces during the [[Battle of New York]] before going their separate ways. Not long after this, Iron Man was forced to defeat [[Aldrich Killian (Earth-TRN1755)|Aldrich Killian]] and rescue Pepper Potts and President [[Matthew Ellis (Earth-TRN1755)|Matthew Ellis]] from his clutches.

Later, the Avengers reassembled to take back [[Loki's Scepter]] from [[Hydra (Earth-TRN1755)|Hydra]]. While they were able to require the scepter, Tony's attempts to use its power to create the ultimate peacekeeping force backfired and instead made the genocidal [[Glossary:Robot|robot]] known as [[Ultron (Earth-TRN1755)|Ultron]]. Luckily for the Avengers, they defeated Ultron before his plans could come to fruition. While the Avengers didn't disband after this battle, Tony Stark stepped back from active membership, serving only as the team's primary benefactor. During this time off, he became a mentor to the young hero [[Peter Parker (Earth-TRN1755)|Spider-Man]] and finally married Pepper Potts.

By the time [[Thanos (Earth-TRN1755)|Thanos]] and his [[Black Order (Earth-TRN1755)|Black Order]] arrived on [[Earth]] a few years later in search of the [[Infinity Stones]], the Avengers has become divided due to a conflict involving the [[James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-TRN1755)|Winter Soldier]]. This division ultimately allowed Thanos to collect all the stones and use their power to carry out his plan and kill half of all life in the universe. With Thanos having subsequently destroyed the stones, the Avengers had no further recourse and allowed five years to pass. During this time, Tony had a daughter with Pepper Potts, whom they named [[Morgan Stark (Earth-TRN1755)|Morgan]]. 

When [[Scott Lang (Earth-TRN1755)|Scott Lang]] reemerged with an idea to travel back in time via the [[Quantum Realm]] and reclaim the stones before they were destroyed, Tony created a [[Time-Space GPS]] to bring the plan to fruition despite his initial hesitancy. Following their successful retrieval of the stones, an all-out battle for them occurred between the Avengers and a [[Thanos (Earth-TRN1758)|Thanos]] from a [[Earth-TRN1758|branched timeline]]. In one final attempt to keep the stones out of Thanos' hands, Iron Man took the stones for himself and used their power to evaporate Thanos and his forces, sacrificing himself in the process.{{r|William Shakespeare's Avengers: The Complete Works}}

| History                 = Iron Man was one of the heroes who fought [[Godzilla (Earth-TRN1854)|Godzilla]] when the monster emerged from the ocean, though Iron Man was overwhelmed by his immense power.{{r|Godzilla Destroys the Marvel Universe Vol 1 1}} After Godzilla was sent to the astral plane by Doctor Strange, Iron Man helped clean up the remains of the wrecked [[Baxter Building]] and saved a police officer from falling debris.{{r|Godzilla Destroys the Marvel Universe Vol 1 5}}

Later, when Godzilla made his way to Wakanda, Iron Man was summoned by [[T'Challa (Earth-TRN1854)|Black Panther]] to help pilot his new anti-Godzilla weapon: the [[Mecha Adaptoid Centurion Mark-AX]].{{r|Godzilla Destroys the Marvel Universe Vol 1 4}} During the fight, Iron Man was positioned in a room inside the mecha's right shoulder, from which he could attack Godzilla with his armor. However, Iron Man had to abandon the mecha when Godzilla began to overpower it.{{r|Godzilla Destroys the Marvel Universe Vol 1 5}}

Later, after Godzilla had been taken over by [[Knull (Earth-TRN1854)|Knull]] and began to attack multiple planets in the galaxy, Iron Man was among the Avengers that set out to try and stop him.{{r|Godzilla: Infinity Roar Vol 1 1}}

| History                 = After setting up a trap for the [[Squadron Supreme (Earth-12041)|Squadron Supreme]] by attacking New York City using robots, the team freed themselves and defeated the villainous outlaw Iron Man. During his escape, Stark blasted [[William Roberts (Earth-12041)|Doctor Spectrum]]'s hand, which caused the [[Reality Stone|stone]] he was holding to cause a rift in reality. This rift offered Stark a glimpse of [[Earth-12041|an alternate reality]] in which he worked together with other known criminals. Familiar memories of this other life motivated him to assemble [[Natalia Romanova (Earth-TRN524)|Black Widow]], [[Steven Rogers (Earth-TRN524)|Captain]], [[Samuel Wilson (Earth-TRN524)|Falcon]], [[Clinton Barton (Earth-TRN524)|Hawkeye]], [[Bruce Banner (Earth-TRN524)|Hulk]] and [[Thor Odinson (Earth-TRN524)|Thor]] to investigate this event. As the Avengers, they came to the conclusion the Squadron Supreme had used the Reality Stone to alter reality into their own image, making the Avengers criminals.

Squadron member [[Nighthawk (Earth-12041)|Nighthawk]] pinned them down, in order to kill them, as they feared Stark's knowledge of the truth would affect their plans. Nighthawk planted a bomb in the Avenger's Aven-Jet, but Iron Man sacrificed himself to prevent the plane-turned-bomb from crashing into the city by taking the explosive and flying away. The surviving members decided to carry on Iron Man's plan, and stop the Squadron. They succeeded, and brought reality [[Earth-12041|back to normal]].{{r|Marvel's Avengers Assemble Season 2 9}}

| History                 = Iron Man's history in Earth-TRN561 is probably similar to [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|his Earth-616 counterpart]].

As a member of the [[Avengers (Earth-TRN561)|Avengers]], Iron Man went to the space on a [[Quinjet]] to deal with an alien threat that was revealed to be [[Kree]] Admiral [[Galen-Kor (Earth-TRN561)|Galen-Kor]] on an alien base. The [[Kree]] were at war with the [[Shi'ar|Shi-ar]], and Galen-Kor's fighting strategy endangered Earth. The Avengers defeated Galen-Kor, who destroyed his base to prevent it from falling in enemies hands, then was forced to run away to another base, [[Outpost 51K Sigma]]. The Avengers followed Galen-Kor there, but they were confronted by armored Kree [[Roco-Bai (Earth-TRN561)|Shatterax (Roco-Bai)]] and, after defeating him, the Avengers were forced to surrender to a numerically-superior Kree security contingent. The Avengers were taken to Kree capital [[Hala]] to be judged.{{r|Avengers in Galactic Storm}}

Once on Hala, however, Iron Man released the others. One lonely Avenger was chased by a powerful Kree, [[Korath-Thak (Earth-TRN561)|Korath]], and fought him. Defeated and barely conscious, Korath revealed that the Kree once had an [[Anti-Matter Bomb]], but had been stolen by the Shi-ar. The Kree had also launched an assassination mission against [[Lilandra Neramani (Earth-TRN561)|Empress Lilandra]] on Shi-ar planet[[Chandilar]]. The Avengers, siding with the Shi-ar, flew to Chandilar to stop the Kree.{{r|Avengers in Galactic Storm}}

When the Kree assassin [[Minn-Erva (Earth-TRN561)|Doctor Minerva]] was defeated, the Shi-ar reacted by launching the Anti-Matter Bomb against the Kree Empire, decimating their number and ravaging their world. The Avengers apparently did nothing to stop the Shi-ar.{{r|Avengers in Galactic Storm}}

After the bomb, the Avengers travelled back to Hala to confront the Kree leader, the [[Supreme Intelligence (Earth-TRN561)|Supreme Intelligence]]. The Intelligence claimed it could not understand why had the Avengers allied with the Shi-ar, but nevertheless it tried to kill them using its android body [[Supremor (Android) (Earth-TRN561)|Supremor]]. It failed: The Supremor was defeated and apparently the Intelligence itself was lost in its own computer.{{r|Avengers in Galactic Storm}}

The Avengers returned safely to Earth, only to discover that Galen-Kor had tracked them, thirsty for revenge. Galen-Kor confronted two Avengers in front of the [[Avengers Mansion]]. Galen-Kor was ultimately defeated once more.{{r|Avengers in Galactic Storm}}

Iron Man apparently continued his adventures with the Avengers.

===Teaming with the Hulk===
Tony was the owner of [[Stark Industries (Earth-TRN607)|Stark Industries]] and was based in his own personal [[S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier|Helicarrier]]. He was training with [[Just A Rather Very Intelligent System (Earth-TRN607)|J.A.R.V.I.S]] who was in a [[Hulkbuster Armor]] when J.A.R.V.I.S had noticed a blackout being caused by a gamma surge that was centered at a power plant that was being controlled by [[Hydra (Earth-TRN607)|Hydra]]. Iron Man ran into [[Bruce Banner (Earth-TRN607)|Hulk]] when investigating the origin of the blackout. Once they realized it was Hydra's doing, they decided to team up against the evil organization. Once they found the base, Tony realized their experiments were being powered by [[Arc Reactor]] similar to that of Tony's. They were then attacked by [[Zzzax (Earth-TRN607)|Zzzax]], a being made of pure energy. It had gotten into the Helicarrier and taken it over. Once Hulk and Iron Man crash landed in a creepy cemetery, Hulk had developed Welder's blindness after his confrontation with Zzzax and Tony had lost the use of his legs while in the suit. They were confronted by a group of [[Wendigo (Race)|Wendigos]] and Tony had to guide Hulk in the battle and once they escaped, Stark was able to give Hulk pieces of the Hulkbuster armor for him to wear in their rematch against Zzzax. Once they brought down the Helicarrier, they were able to ground Zzzax and forced him to loose his charge. After the battle, due to Hulk's hunger, they both went out for food.{{r|Iron Man and Hulk: Heroes United}}

| History                 = 
===Legacy===
During the final battle of the [[Civil War (Event)|Superhuman Civil War]], Iron Man and [[Steven Rogers (Earth-TRN634)|Captain America]] mortally wounded each other; Steve survived, but Tony didn't. Consumed by guilt and grief for the millions of lives lost, Steve vowed to honor Stark's memory by preventing another irrational conflict like the Civil War from ever happening again. Abandoning the mantle of Captain America, Steve Rogers combined Stark's [[Arc Reactor|Arc]] technology with his own arsenal to become the Civil Warrior.{{r|Marvel Contest of Champions|; [[Steven Rogers (Earth-TRN634)|Civil Warrior]]'s Champion Info}}{{r|Marvel Contest of Champions|; "Cosmic Civil War: Endgame" Event Quest}}

Civil Warrior was captured by the [[Taneleer Tivan (Earth-TRN1095)|Collector]] to participate in his [[Marvel Contest of Champions|Contest of Champions]] and taken to the [[Earth-517|Battlerealm]]. There he witnessed a conflict between an alternate [[Anthony Stark (Earth-517)|Iron Man]] and [[Steven Rogers (WWII) (Earth-517)|Captain America]] and their respective [[Iron Faction (Earth-517)|Iron]] and [[Blue Faction (Earth-517)|Blue Factions]]. Despite initially succumbing to remorse and inaction, Rogers snapped out of it and worked with the [[Summoner (Earth-517)|Summoner]] to end the Cosmic Civil War, saving millions of lives in the process.{{r|Marvel Contest of Champions|; "Cosmic Civil War: Endgame" Event Quest}} Civil Warrior later reconciled with the former Iron Faction leader, gaining closure for his guilt over what happened to his Stark.{{r|Marvel Contest of Champions|; "Secret Empire Forever" Event Quest}}

| History                 = Iron Man shared a similar history his [[Anthony Stark (Earth-199999)|Marvel Cinematic Universe counterpart]] until after the [[Chitauri]] invasion of [[New York City]]. During Tony Stark's birthday party a [[Zombies|Zombie]] attacks but was taken out by [[Natalia Romanoff (Earth-TRN808)|Black Widow]]. However, it was discovered that the infection is spread by touch and both [[Thor Odinson (Earth-TRN808)|Thor]] and Black Widow have become infected. They attempted to contain Thor and Black Widow whilst [[Bruce Banner (Earth-TRN808)|Bruce Banner]] and Tony looked for a cure. Thor escaped and went after the other [[Avengers (Earth-TRN808)|Avengers]].{{r|Zombies Assemble Vol 1 1}} 

Tony and [[Clinton Barton (Earth-TRN808)|Hawkeye]] held off Thor, while Bruce continued researching, until Thor was taken out by a Chitauri weapon wielded by [[Toshiko Amano (Earth-TRN808)|Toshiko Amano]]. She revealed she was the source of the [[Chitauri Virus|plague]], which was a mutated Chitauri virus and she had the only known anti-virus. They administered the cure to Thor but found it didn't last very long, before Thor reverted.{{r|Zombies Assemble Vol 1 2}} 

Meanwhile, the plague was spreading through New York and [[James Rhodes (Earth-TRN808)|War Machine]] was helping to contain the infected. One approached his barricade and exploded. The Avengers rushed to investigate and Iron Man found only an empty War Machine armor. He, Cap, and Hawkeye were surrounded by the infected and several exploded, knocking them unconscious. Back in the lab, Bruce and Toshiko developed the second iteration of the anti-virus. In order to test it, Toshiko infected herself and began to turn. However, this version also failed. Whilst turning she screamed out the name, [[Jasper Scott (Earth-TRN808)|Jasper]]. Looking in Toshiko's files, Bruce discovered a video that showed that the virus had been mutated by someone else.{{r|Zombies Assemble Vol 1 3}} 

Bruce used this new information to develop a new anti-virus was able to administer it to Thor, Black Widow and Toshiko before he was himself infected and turned into a zombie Hulk. Iron Man, Cap and Hawkeye awoke to find themselves uninfected having been saved by a Dr. Jasper Scott, who had administered a "cure" to each of them.{{r|Zombies Assemble 2 Vol 1 1}} 

The three of them tried to stop HUlk, but we unable to until a newly cured Thor and Black Widow administered the cure to Hulk, reverting him back to normal. Toshiko arrived and it was discovered the Dr Jasper Scott had infected Iron Man, Cap and Hawkeye with a new strain of the virus that was not responding to the current anti-virus and she revealed he was her brother and the actual source of the virus. Whilst they had been working on an early stage of it, they discovered it could regenerate missing fingers and Jasper was patient zero. Jasper, meanwhile was unleashing his new zombies onto New York.{{r|Zombies Assemble 2 Vol 1 2}} 

The Avengers went out to Jasper and were overwhelmed by the zombies long enough for Jasper to kidnap Bruce and attempted to use him to convince Tony to return to weapon's manufacturing. Bruce refused and was eventually rescued just before it was revealed that Jasper was mutating into a Human-Chitauri hybrid.{{r|Zombies Assemble 2 Vol 1 3}}

They were able to defeat him and Bruce administered a cure he had obtained from Jasper on the remaining Zombies and when Thor left he took all samples of the virus and any data on it to Asgard.{{r|Zombies Assemble 2 Vol 1 4}}

| History                 = As a child, Tony Stark was advised by his father [[Howard Stark (Earth-TRN838)|Howard]] to send a letter to [[Jolnir (Earth-TRN838)|Santa Claus]] to corroborate if he was real. The letter was returned, leading Tony to believe that Santa Claus did not exist. In his adulthood, Tony became Iron Man and joined the [[Avengers (Earth-TRN838)|Avengers]]. 

On Monukiri Island the Avengers faced Ymir who had the chest of ancient winters. The Avengers recovered the chest, but Ymir was rescued by [[Loki Laufeyson (Earth-TRN838)|Loki]]. At [[Stark Tower|Avengers Tower]] I praise [[Humberto Lopez (Earth-TRN838)|Reptil]] for having survived facing Loki. A female dinosaur attacked the city, Iron Man asked Reptile to have a dinosaur head and the dinosaur believed that Reptile was his baby and calmed down. [[Thor Odinson (Earth-TRN838)|Thor]] returned from hiding the chest and said that Loki set a price for Santa Claus's capture. Tony wanted to travel to Alfahim to prove that Santa was not real, but Thor denied him. The Avengers, except Thor and Hulk, traveled to Alfahim in Tony's dimensional transport portal.{{r|Marvel Super Hero Adventures: Frost Fight!}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-TRN883) from Marvel Future Revolution 003.png|thumb|left]]
When [[Earth-TRN883|their Earth]] was about to collide with another during an event known as "the Convergence", Iron Man and the other heroes sought to prevent it. Iron Man defeated the [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-TRN883)|A.I.M.]] soldiers with [[Ororo Munroe (Earth-TRN883)|Storm]]'s help, but [[George Tarleton (Earth-TRN883)|M.O.D.O.K.]] escaped with the anti-matter bomb and Iron Man gave chase. Stark knocked M.O.D.O.K. into a rooftop and fought him. The villain was defeated, but an alternate version of himself, [[George Tarleton (K.D.O.O.M.) (Earth-TRN883)|K.D.O.O.M.]], came  to his help, blasting Iron Man away. [[Peter Parker (Earth-TRN883)|Spider-Man]] caught Iron Man with a webline and went in their pursuit since Iron Man's armor has been damaged. The heroes eventually failed to stop the Convergence, but [[Vision (Earth-TRN883)|Vision]] saved everyone by using the Convergence energies and his own density-altering powers to merge the two worlds, as well as several others, together peacefully. This created a new Primary Earth, in which multiple different realities became fused together. 

[[File:Anthony Stark (Earth-TRN883) from Marvel Future Revolution 001.jpg|thumb|left]]
Tony Stark took charge of their chunck of this new world, which was dubbed [[New York City|New Stark City]], which played a key role in [[Primary Earth]]'s survival. Under Tony Stark's plans, and developed in conjunction with [[Henry Pym (Earth-TRN883)|Hank Pym]]'s [[Ultron (Earth-TRN883)|Ultron]], the city was designed around [[Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. (Earth-TRN883)|Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S.]], which was centered upon researching a solution of the Convergence. [[Ultron Drones]]s, whose potential threat was unknown in their reality, were used as New Stark City's security forces. Months later, Hank Pym approached Tony Stark and asked for a status on Primary Earth. Stark explained that despite the shifting landscape of the new planet, they had identified a number of new Earths that have merged with their own such. [[Nicholas Fury (Earth-TRN883)|Nick Fury]] intercepts them to remind them that they have also absorbed entire regions that could end up as potential threats. Fury warned Tony and Hank that they'll need to keep fighting and asked how many forces they've recruited. 

Stark recruited an [[Anthony Stark (Earth-TRN882)|alternate version of himself]] and later worked with him and other Omega Flight operatives to combat the new threats, such as the sudden uprising of his Ultrons and the arrival of [[Thanos (Earth-TRN884)|Thanos]].{{r|Marvel Future Revolution}}

| History                 = Tony Stark shared a similar history to his [[Anthony Stark (Earth-199999)|MCU counterpart]]. He was kidnapped by the [[Ten Rings (Earth-TRN999)|Ten Rings]] and during his capture, he and [[Ho Yinsen (Earth-TRN999)|Ho Yinsen]] built the [[Iron Man Armor MK I (Earth-199999)|first Iron Man Armor]]. Tony used the armor to escape but Yinsen was killed. Tony was rescued and returned the US and declared his company was no longer going to produce weapons, which [[Obadiah Stane (Earth-TRN999)|Obadiah Stane]] disagreed with.

Tony upgraded his suit after which the [[Maggia (Earth-TRN999)|Maggia]] attempted to break into the Stark Corporation's Armory after Stark stopped selling them weapons, which he was able to fend off. He revealed to [[James Rhodes (Earth-TRN999)|Rhodey]] and [[Virginia Potts (Earth-TRN999)|Pepper Potts]] his secret identity. Rhodes informed him of a weapons transport in Afghanistan where Iron Man confronted former Stark Industries worker [[Mark Scarlotti (Earth-TRN999)|Mark Scarlotti]]. He traveled to the Maggia's compound to destroy the rest of the weapons and confronted [[Whitney Frost (Earth-TRN999)|Madame Masque]] and then destroyed the Maggia's flying fortress.

Unbeknownst to Stark, Stane recovered Stark's first Iron Man armor and allied himself with [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-TRN999)|Advanced Idea Mechanics (A.I.M.),]] to create a power source. Iron Man confronted A.I.M. when they attacked a Russian nuclear facility and confronted [[Boris Bullski (Earth-TRN999)|Titanium Man]]. Stark then confronted A.I.M. when they attacked a military ship in the Arctic where he destroyed a controller device.

A.I.M. forces under the command of Titanium Man attacked Stark Industries in an attempted by Stane to steal the Iron Man suit. Iron Man was ambushed by Stane who stole his arc reactor and kidnapped Pepper. He saved Pepper from the A.I.M. facility and prevented the explosion of their reactor. He traveled to their island and shut down their operations after defeating the [[Bruno Horgan (Earth-TRN999)|Melter]].

Stane used the stolen technology to build his own [[Iron Monger Armor (Earth-199999)|Iron Monger Armor]] and the two battle atop Stark Industries, where Stark has Pepper overload the building's arc reactor killing Stane. Back in his workshop, Tony ponders his position in life and decides to continue to be Iron Man. {{r|Iron Man (video game)}}

Some time after this, it is presumed that events similar if not identical to his MCU counterpart occur where Rhodey becomes War Machine.

Iron Man learns that the [[Roxxon Corporation (Earth-TRN999)|Roxxon Corporation]] are attempting to duplicate his armors without success and discovered them attempting to steal an archived version of J.A.R.V.I.S. from the dataspine. However, Roxxon drop an EMP bomb which disables his armor and after the power reserves in Iron Man's armor activate he decided to destroy the Dataspine to protect the archive. However, the group manage to make off with JARVIS' A.I..

Iron Man is contacted by [[Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division (Earth-TRN999)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]] director [[Nicholas Fury (Earth-TRN999)|Colonel Nick Fury]] to gain his help against [[Valentin Shatalov (Earth-TRN999)|General Valentin Shatalov]]. After defeating some of Roxxon's forces, Iron Man learned the Shatalov was working with A.I.M. to complete a [[Crimson Dynamo Armor]]. Iron Man tracked down [[Natalia Romanoff (Earth-TRN999)|Black Widow]] who was working as a spy inside Shatalov's force and rescued her while he and War Machine battled Shatalov in his Crimson Dynamo armor. After Shatalov is defeated, the group learn that former Stark employee [[Kearson DeWitt (Earth-TRN999)|Kearson DeWitt]] and A.I.M. were behind the theft of J.A.R.V.I.S.'s AI to create a new super-weapon [[Ultimo (Earth-TRN999)|Ultimo]].

Iron Man and War Machine confronted DeWitt after he has used his PROTEAN technology to merge with a giant metal robot to become Ultimo. After a lengthy battle, they destroy Ultimo and rescue JARVIS.{{r|Iron Man 2 (video game)}}

| History                 = This A.I. was created as a back-up plan by [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] after suffering an almost-fatal mental attack by the [[Jerald (Earth-7511)|Black Lama]]. It is a full back up of Stark's mind up to the point of its creation, to be used in case something went wrong. Using a short-term mind-wipe, Stark made himself forget about the A.I.'s creation.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 7}}

Eight years later, Stark was victim of another type of mental attack, a magic spell during the [[Avengers & X-Men: AXIS|World War Hate]] that inverted his moral compass, turning him into a more determined and nefarious version of himself. [[Virginia Potts (Earth-616)|Pepper Potts]] activated the contingency plan that was the Tony Stark A.I. (enclosed in the [[Iron Man Armor Model 2]]), and decided to help Tony get back to his regular self.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 1}} Before confronting Tony Stark, the A.I. spent some time catching up with relevant events in the past eight years.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 3}}

When the time to face Stark came, Pepper lured him to [[Stark Resilient (Earth-616)|Resilient]]'s New York HQ, where he was confronted by the Tony A.I.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 6}} The A.I. revealed its origins to Tony Stark, and that it would try to get into Tony's mind and fix the damage, or completely replace him if the first option failed. With Stark's [[Iron Man Armor Model 50|current armor]] making its way to Tony, the A.I. Tony encased Stark in its Model 2 and flew away into space. Stark's Endo-Sym armor followed them, but the A.I. Tony shot its jet boots, forcing it to stop. When the Endo-Sym armor tried to continue the chase it couldn't as there wasn't oxygen in space to enable the jet boots from firing.

A.I. Tony took Stark to the Resilient Space Station, where he got ready to enter his mind. However, a little piece of the Endo-Sym which had remained in Stark infiltrated the A.I. Tony's armor when it was distracted and disabled it.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 7}} The A.I. Tony quickly projected itself into [[Iron Man Armor Model 7|another suit of armor]] stored back on Earth, and interrupted Tony when he tried to make Pepper believe the damage of his mind had been fixed and he was his older self again.

[[File:Anthony Stark (First A.I.) (Earth-616) from Superior Iron Man Vol 1 8 002.jpg|thumb|left|Controlling numerous suits]]
Tony returned to San Francisco, and the A.I. Tony got ready to confront him again. Tony lured the A.I. Tony to [[Alcatraz Island|Stark Island]], where he had used a bio-weapon to control the minds of the attendees of one of his pool parties, using them as human shields. The A.I. Tony controlled numerous Iron Man suits and used them to clear the area from civilians before confronting Stark.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 8}}

Iron Man used more of the compound that made up his [[Iron Man Armor Model 50|Endo-Sym Armor]] to increase in size and strength, being able to hold his own against the swarm of armor. Soon after he discovering the Tony A.I. was being housed in the Resilient New York HQ, Pepper appeared in a new [[Rescue]] suit and used sonic weapons to disrupt Tony's [[Symbiotes|symbiote]]-based suit, knocking Tony down. Once they returned to New York, Stark took an opportunity to insert a USB drive into one of Resilient's computers, a virus which would locate and destroy his digital counterpart. With no way out, the A.I. Tony was forced to retreat into a USB stick, where Tony planned to keep him. When the Endo-Sym Armor arrived to rescue Stark, it accidentally fried the USB stick, seemingly killing the only back up left of the Tony Stark A.I.{{r|Superior Iron Man Vol 1 9}}

| Quotation               = A few million years from now, they will give me the title of '''Kang''', and it will stick. It is one of the [[Earth-6160|universe]]'s '''first''' spoken words, from the first spoken language. Roughly translated, it means "'''all-conqueror'''." But please, my [[Ultimates (Earth-6160)|friends]]... Just call me '''Tony'''. 
| Speaker                 = [[Anthony Stark (Earth-6160)|Kang]]
| QuoteSource             = Ultimate Endgame Vol 1 3

| History                 = Kang was an inhabitant of the far future of [[Earth-6160]]. When the present-day imperator of this world, the [[Reed Richards (Earth-1610)|Maker]], sought to learn if his dominion lasted into the future, he used the time machine that he had employed to rewrite history to his image, the [[Immortus Engine]], and jumped to the furthest point forward he could. He stumbled into Kang, who quickly attacked the imperator for his wrongdoings to history. The Maker escaped back to the present with his memory impaired due to a severe injury sustained from Kang, and with the Immortus Engine broken.{{r|Ultimate Invasion Vol 1 4}}

Still pursuing revenge against the Maker, Kang assembled [[Kang's Army (Earth-6160)|an army of genetically-engineered clone super-soldiers]] and sent them into the Maker's present using an Immortus Engine in his own possession. However, the super-soldiers failed. The Maker tracked down their DNA to their present-day ancestors and killed them, causing the soldiers to cease to exist.{{r|Ultimate Invasion Vol 1 2}} In response, Kang assembled a bigger army made from different genetic material.{{r|Ultimate Invasion Vol 1 3}}

[[File:Reed Richards (Earth-1610) and Kang (Earth-TRN1072) from Ultimate Invasion Vol 1 4 001.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Fighting the Maker.]]

In the present, the Maker enlisted the help of super-genius inventor [[Howard Stark (Earth-6160)|Howard Stark]] to replace the broken Immortus Engine. Stark and his ally [[Reed Richards (Earth-6160)|Reed Richards]] opted to betray the Maker. While Stark was delivering the second Immortus Engine to the Maker, Richards snuck into the mainframe of the Maker's headquarters, the [[Dome (Location)|City]], and temporarily deactivated its temporal shields. This gave Kang and his army a window of opportunity to strike within the Maker's domain, but left them trapped inside the City. Kang and the Maker were locked in combat until Stark intervened, empowered by the second Immortus Engine. He used it to blast the Maker and Kang, as well as both of their armies. With Kang seemingly dead, Howard approached his body and took off his armor's faceplate, reacting with lament afterward.{{r|Ultimate Invasion Vol 1 4}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Kang) Earth-6160 and Anthony Stark Earth-6160 Ultimate Endgame Vol 1 5.jpeg|thumb|right|150px|Kang being wiped from existence.]]

When Iron Lad led an attack inside The Maker's dome, Kang appeared to help the resistance against the Children of Tomorrow. He then revealed his identity much to the shock of everyone especially Doom. He tells them that while he would like to help them kill the Maker, their gruesome deaths are part of the history before his Immortus Engine is damaged by Doom and disappears.{{r|Ultimate Endgame Vol 1 3}} Doom overcame the Maker in a battle of will, destroying him and averting the timeline that lead to Kang's existence. Iron Lad visited Kang as he faded into nothingness.{{r|Ultimate Endgame Vol 1 5}}
[[File:Kang (Earth-TRN1072) from Ultimate Invasion Vol 1 3 001.jpg|thumb]]

| Notes                   = * Throughout the {{cl|Ultimates Vol 3}} title, various hints pointed at the fact that he is the future version of [[Howard Stark (Earth-6160)|Howard Stark]]'s son [[Anthony Stark (Earth-6160)|Tony]]. In addition to possessing an armor visually derivative of Howard's Iron Man suit and speaking highly of Howard, present-day Tony became Iron Lad wearing an armor identical to Kang's save for a different color scheme. Tony becoming Iron Lad before eventually adopting the alias of Kang would also mirror the evolution of the mainline [[Nathaniel Richards (Kang) (Earth-6311)|Kang the Conqueror]], who also adopted the alias of [[Nathaniel Richards (Iron Lad) (Earth-6311)|Iron Lad]] in his youth.
** In {{cl|Ultimates Vol 3 8}}, [[Star-Lord (Earth-6160)|Star-Lord]], who comes from the future, states that of [[Reed Richards (Earth-6160)|Doom]] and Iron Lad, one will be responsible for untold suffering and the death of trillions while another could save everything, though he also states he does not remember which is which.
** In {{cl|Ultimate Endgame Vol 1 2}}, Howard Stark (now going by Immortus) initially does not recognize Tony after centuries of four-dimensional conflict against the Maker, but later in a brief moment of lucidity he realizes an unmasked Tony's face as that of the "Conqueror" and "Destroyer".
** In {{cl|Ultimate Endgame Vol 1 3}}, it was revealed that the identity of Kang was indeed a future Tony Stark.

After lobotomizing [[Krakoa (Moira-VII.1)|Krakoa]] with an orbital laser, the Sinisters blamed [[Orchis (Moira-VII.1)|Orchis]] for the attack. With the Resurrection Protocols thrown into disarray, Iron Man and the [[Avengers (Moira-VII.1)|Avengers]] joined the [[X-Men (Moira-VII.1)|X-Men]] and other superheroes for an attack on Orchis. Iron Man helped program a virus which disabled [[Nimrod (Moira-VII.1)|Nimrod]], allowing them to destroy him.{{r|Sins of Sinister Vol 1 1}}

With Orchis destroyed, Tony was convinced to accept X-Gene treatment as a way of showing solidarity, unaware that this meant that he too would become a Sinister-clone. Under Sinister's control, Tony and the other human primaries on the Avengers pushed the team into increasingly extreme, antisocial, and malevolent actions.{{r|Sins of Sinister Vol 1 1}}

This climaxed in a war during which [[Steven Rogers (Moira-VII.1)|Captain America]] seized control of the [[United States Government]] after murdering the sitting president. Tony and the Avengers were defeated and killed by the [[X-Men (Moira-VII.1)|X-Men]] as a way of propping up Sinister's grip on the planet.{{r|Sins of Sinister Vol 1 1}}

Later Iron Man with the Avengers and their allies the [[Fantastic Four (Onslaught Reborn) (Earth-616)|Fantastic Four]] clashed with the [[Bruce Banner (Onslaught Reborn) (Earth-616)|Hulk]] who was possessed by Onslaught. During the fight Iron Man received an emergency call from [[Steven Rogers (Onslaught Reborn) (Earth-616)|Captain America]] and went to retrieve [[Thor Odinson (Onslaught Reborn) (Earth-616)|Thor]] after he had collided with the Hulk and had been thrown into the upper layers of the atmosphere transforming into the human Don Blake due to the separation from [[Mjolnir]], so he swooped into the Hulk managing to make him lose consciousness but he himself remained possessed by Onslaught.{{r|Onslaught Reborn Vol 1 3}}

The possessed Iron Man clashed with Captain America in a fight without quarters leaving the two heroes both unconscious and Onslaught triumphant.{{r|Onslaught Reborn Vol 1 4}}

In the final showdown Iron Man along with the Avengers and the Fantastic Four pushed Onslaught back by imprisoning him in the [[Negative Zone]].{{r|Onslaught Reborn Vol 1 5}}

Some time later, Iron Man appeared on Earth transported from his dimension allied with the [[Quiet Man (Earth-616)|Quiet Man]] against [[Reed Richards (Earth-616)|Reed Richards]].{{r|Fantastic Four Vol 5 12}}

Iron Man and the Avengers of the F-Dimension, allied with the Quiet Man and the [[Bentley Wittman (Earth-616)|Wizard]], hold Franklin and the other childs from the [[Future Foundation (Earth-616)|Future Foundation]] hostage to get what the Quiet man wants from Reed Richards.{{r|Fantastic Four Vol 5 13}}

Quiet Man reveals to Reed that Iron Man and the Avengers come from the pocket dimension created by Franklin and that even if simple mirrors of the real characters are very useful.{{r|Fantastic Four Vol 5 14}}

He then tells Reed that there will be another invasion he devised on a worldwide scale and not just of New York and that his stoic guard of honor, or the heroes created by Franklin's imagination, including Iron Man, will be his further aid in that operation.{{r|Fantastic Four Vol 5 643}}

During the invasion devised by the Quiet Man, Reed manages to break free and Quiet Man teleports himself and his Avengers away to strike again. While during the clashes in Manhattan, the [[Benjamin Grimm (Earth-616)|Thing]] hopes help will arrive from the [[Avengers (Earth-616)|Avengers]], while the fake Avengers appear instead.{{r|Fantastic Four Vol 5 644}}

The fake Avengers joined the fray by supporting the invasion opposed by the Thing and all its allies. In the final battle, Iron Man struggles against [[William Baker (Earth-616)|Sandman]] of the [[Frightful Four (Earth-616)|Frightful Four]], meanwhile Reed Richards defeats the Quiet Man and without the control of the latter the fake Avengers collapsed to the ground leaving only an empty shell of them.{{r|Fantastic Four Vol 5 645}}

| History                 = ===Preface===
Not much is known about this version of Tony Stark. He had a similar history as his [[Earth-616]] [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|counterpart]], except that he seemingly was alive when his reality succumbed to an [[Glossary:Incursion|incursion]].{{r|Ultimate End Vol 1 1}} Stark, along with half of the population of Manhattan in his native reality were among the many fragments of the multiverse preserved by [[Victor von Doom (Earth-616)|God Emperor Doom]] when he created [[Battleworld (Latverion)|Battleworld]]. Stark's domain became part of what was later referred to as the [[Kingdom of Manhattan]].{{r|Secret Wars Vol 1 1}}

===Ultimate End===
One day, the [[Antonio Stark (Ultimate) (Earth-61610)|Tony Stark]] of the section of [[Manhattan]] similar to [[Earth-1610]] found a rift in the time-space continuum that somehow merged the two Manhattans into [[Earth-61610|unique domain]]. Iron Man was among the numerous heroes of the two Manhattans gathered together to try to solve the problem, with the heroes agreeing to get over their differences and work together to separate their two Manhattans.{{r|Ultimate End Vol 1 1}}

The [[Thors (Earth-15513)|Thors]] confronted the heroes and informed them that Doom wanted them to stop trying to fix the problem. When Spider-Man's fellow heroes challenged this order, the Thors struck down [[Clinton Barton (Prime) (Earth-61610)|Hawkeye]].{{r|Ultimate End Vol 1 2}}

Later, Tony and [[Antonio Stark (Ultimate) (Earth-61610)|his Ultimate counterpart]] found another rift, but they disagreed on whether or not to tell Doom. Believing the other would take his course of action, Tony assembled an army of heroes from his section of the domain againist the Ultimate heroes.{{r|Ultimate End Vol 1 4}}

Their battle was interrupted by [[Miles Morales (Earth-1610)|Spider-Man of Earth-1610]], who revealed that Doom had simply recreated them and wanted them to destroy each other. While they initially accused him of heresy, another visitor [[James Howlett (Earth-21923)|Old Man Logan]] from the [[Amerika|Wastelands]] backed him up. The heroes then assembled to overthrow Doom. In the final battle, Iron Man and his allies were seemingly erased from existence.{{r|Ultimate End Vol 1 5}}

===Postscript===
Following the dissolution of Battleworld and the restoration of the multiverse, {{r|Secret Wars Vol 1 9}} the merged kingdom of Manhattan endures as reality [[Earth-61610]].{{r|Contest of Champions Vol 1 1}} If Stark or any of his other allies were revived as a result remains to be seen. Stark's activities on Battleworld have been index to having occurred on [[Earth-15513|Reality-15513]].{{r|All-New, All-Different Marvel Universe Vol 1 1}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Squad 47) (Earth-TRN883) from Marvel Future Revolution 003.png|thumb|left]]
Iron Man from an unspecified reality was recruited into the [[Omega Flight (Earth-TRN883)|Omega Flight]] on [[Primary Earth]]. He became part of Squad 47 and along with [[Carol Danvers (Squad 47) (Earth-TRN883)|Captain Marvel]] of the same Squad was send to investigate the [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-TRN882)|A.I.M.]] of an alternate [[Earth]] who were tampering with extra-dimensional travel. After meeting with another Omega Flight operative they proceeded to interrogate one of the A.I.M. agents present at the scene, who insisted that A.I.M was saving the world. The interdimensional portal opened by A.I.M. became overloading and the A.I.M technicians were unable to close it. Iron Man jumped it to close it with his expertise, but it was too late and a version of [[Thanos]] from another reality emerged through the portal. 

Thanos berated A.I.M. for their foolishness in tampering with dimensional travel and announced his intent to conquer this world new to him. Iron Man and Captain Marvel battled Thanos until he stopped something unusual about this reality, which was due to the effects of the Convergence. Intrigued, Thanos let the others live while he teleported away to discover the secret of this new world. Iron Man and Captain Marvel then went to confront [[M.O.D.O.K.]] who was the one responsible for this. M.O.D.O.K. was furious at the Omega Flight for interrupting his experiment which he claimed was meant to save the Universe from a threat even bigger than the Convergence or Thanos. After defeating M.O.D.O.K., Iron Man and Captain Marvel returned to Omega Squad Headquarters to report to [[Henry Pym (Earth-TRN883)|Hank Pym]] and [[Anthony Stark (Earth-TRN883)|Tony Stark]] of the New Stark City. Squad 47's Iron Man also revealed that he managed to record the unique frequency of Thanos with his armor, allowing the Omega Squad to predict his next site of attack.{{r|Marvel Future Revolution}}
