| History                 = 
===Mentoring Riri Williams===
This A.I. of [[Anthony Stark (Earth-616)|Tony Stark]] was created by the super-genius inventor himself as a backup in case his body no longer worked, so his essence could be preserved. A device containing the A.I. Stark was shipped to [[Riri Williams (Earth-616)|Riri Williams]], a child prodigy who had caught Stark's attention, so the A.I. could serve as a mentor to her.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 1}} The A.I. most notably assisted Riri in the creation of her second [[Ironheart Armor Model 2|armor]], and came up with her super hero alias of "[[Ironheart]]."{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 3}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Third A.I.) (Earth-616) from Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 4 002.jpg|thumb|left|Operating an Iron Man Armor]]

The A.I. didn't limit himself to being Riri's companion, and he often hung around Tony Stark's lab at the [[Stark Industries Main Campus]].{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 5}} When [[Victor von Doom (Earth-616)|Victor von Doom]] irrupted into Stark's lab, the A.I. confronted him and tried to stop him from donning the [[Iron Man Armor Model 51|Model-Prime Armor]] for himself as part of his attempt to pick up Stark's mantle.{{r|Infamous Iron Man Vol 1 1}}

Since the A.I. was the reconstruction of a real person's consciousness and not a digital program made from scratch, the lack of a physical body affected the A.I. negatively, to the point of expressing the belief that humanity itself was an obstacle in the protection of the world.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 5}} At one point, Tony Stark's original assistant A.I. [[Friday Stark (Earth-616)|Friday]] feared that the Tony A.I. wasn't holding to the guidelines of his programming.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 9}}

===Secret Empire===
When [[Hydra (Earth-616)|Hydra]] launched its plan of conquering the [[United States of America|United States]] under the leadership of a fascist [[Steven Rogers (Earth-61311)|Captain America]] from [[Earth-61311|an alternate reality]], Tony's A.I. rallied America's remaining heroes to fend off the Hydra forces that attacked [[Washington, D.C.]],{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 0}} but failed to stop the take-over.{{r|Free Comic Book Day 2017 (Secret Empire) Vol 1 1}} As Hydra successfully took over the country, the resistance managed to regroup in [[Mount|The Mount]], and form the [[Underground (Secret Empire) (Earth-616)|Underground]]. The Underground's ensuing failures to defeat Hydra led the A.I. to become apathetic and defeated, to the point of recalibrating its own systems to simulate the effects of alcohol in order to cope.

Tony's outlook drastically changed when the Underground's newest recruit, [[Rayshaun Lucas (Earth-616)|Rayshaun Lucas]],{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 1}} provided info obtained from [[Richard Jones (Earth-616)|Rick Jones]] on how Steve Rogers was transformed into a Hydra agent.{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 2}} While controlling the [[Iron Man Armor Model 4]], Tony led a group of heroes to various locations all over the world to recover the fragments of the sentient [[Cosmic Cube]] named [[Kobik (Earth-616)|Kobik]] so she could be rebuilt and restore Rogers to normal. Due to Jones' intel only providing potential leads and not solid clues, Tony pretended to have created a machine that could pinpoint the exact location of the cube's remnants in order to foster hope in the resistance.{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 3|5}}{{r|Secret Empire: Underground Vol 1 1}}

[[File:Anthony Stark (Third A.I.) (Earth-616) from Secret Empire Vol 1 4 003.jpg|thumb|A.I. Tony projecting his image through the armor]]

In the end, the journey of Tony's team only resulted in the recovery of two shards. Once the team returned to The Mount, Hydra attacked it after being tipped off by their unwilling mole, [[Scott Lang (Earth-616)|Ant-Man]], in order to subdue the resistance and recover the fragments.{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 5}} Hydra eventually penetrated The Mount's defenses with the use of a resurrected [[Bruce Banner (Earth-616)|Hulk]]. Before he could evacuate with the rest of the resistance, Iron Man was attacked by Captain America, who used a device derived from [[Ultron (Earth-616)|Ultron]]'s technology to prevent him from transferring himself elsewhere. When the effects of his temporary resurrection ceased, Hulk decayed, collapsing the roof above Iron Man and Captain America. With his suit damaged from the cave-in, Tony activated the "Clean Slate Protocol," a self-destruct mechanism. In his last seconds, Tony apologized to Cap for having failed to revert his condition. Tony set off an explosion, resulting in a massive mushroom explosion that destroyed The Mount, and his armor with it. Both Steve and the A.I. survived the explosion,{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 6}} with Tony later inhabiting another unit of the Model 4.{{r|Captain America Vol 8 25}}

The A.I. Tony continued working with the Underground in their following efforts to take down Hydra, coming up with a plan involving a Cosmic Cube fragment that Sam Wilson used to help bring back the heroes neutralized by Hydra, either because they were trapped within a [[:Glossary:Darkforce|Darkforce]] dome in [[Manhattan]] or stranded off-planet on the other side of the impenetrable [[Planetary Defense Shield]].{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 8}} Iron Man took part in the final assault against Hydra's forces in [[Washington, D.C.]]{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 9}} and witnessed the return of the real Captain America, who proceeded to defeat his evil self.{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 10}}

===Death===
Following Hydra's defeat, the Tony Stark A.I. returned to operate exclusively as Riri Williams' assistant A.I.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 594}} The Tony Stark A.I. aided in finding the real Tony Stark after his comatose body vanished. The A.I. had additionally learned to embrace humanity's flaws and decided to ignore its initial instincts to save humankind from itself.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 600}} At some point afterward, Riri stopped making use of the A.I. Tony Stark.

A device that contained the A.I.'s program made its way to [[Miles Brickman (Earth-616)|Miles Brickman]], an anti-robotics senator. During a congressional hearing involving the real Tony Stark, Senator Brickman called into question his humanity due to his use of advanced technology to upgrade his body and mind. In order to support his argument, Senator Brickman activated the A.I. Tony Stark, with the intention to compare its legitimacy as a sentient being. After the hearing adjourned, Tony retrieved his digital self. The duplicate A.I. agreed to Tony's suggestion to become his [[Iron Man Armor Model 64|armor]]'s operating system, transferring itself into Tony's suit, and becoming dubbed as "Li'l Tony." This partnership was cut short once a hybrid of [[Vision (Earth-616)|Vision]] and [[Simon Williams (Earth-616)|Wonder Man]] attacked Iron Man, having been sent after the [[Janet Van Dyne (Earth-616)|Wasp]] by [[Ultron (Earth-616)|Ultron]]. Stark saw himself forced to detonate an EMP from within his suit to defeat his foe, but it cost the life of Li'l Tony, since the EMP fried his armor's sytems. Before proceeding, the A.I. agreed to Tony's plan since it was the only way out, and said goodbye.{{r|Tony Stark: Iron Man Vol 1 15}}

| Powers                  = '''Consciousness Recreation:''' This A.I. is a reconstruction of Tony Stark's mind, so it possesses all knowledge and mental faculties of the real Stark.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 595}}, though he was once stated to not be as smart as the real Stark.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 593}}

'''Computer Brain:''' Since this incarnation of Tony Stark is that of an artificial intelligence, it is capable of multitasking much more effectively than a normal human. He's capable of being present in different places at once while doing different activities, like controlling over a dozen [[Iron Man Armor|Iron Man suits]] at once, or operating the [[Ironheart Armor Model 2|Ironheart Armor]] and holding a conversation with [[Friday Stark (Earth-616)|Friday]] on the other side of the globe.{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 9}} He can also download himself into different devices, be it a laptop or an [[Iron Man Armor]].{{r|Invincible Iron Man Vol 4 4}}

| Abilities               = 

| Weaknesses              = '''Alcoholism:''' Being an entity based on the real Tony Stark, A.I. Tony appears to have inherited the real Tony's alcoholism. Following [[Hydra (Earth-616)|Hydra]]'s take-over of the [[United States of America|United States]], the A.I. undertook a code-based recalibration of his behavioral modifiers to emulate inebriation,{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 1}} becoming unable to utilize the more advanced suits that Stark had made, limiting himself to the [[Iron Man Armor Model 4|Model 4 Armor]].{{r|Secret Empire Vol 1 4}}

| History                 = 
===Early Life===
'''Tony Stark''' was born a genius and one of the twin sons of industrialist inventor [[Howard Stark (Earth-1610)|Howard Stark]], with the other son being [[Gregory Stark (Earth-1610)|Gregory]].{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 1}} Despite Howard's determination to have Tony continue [[Stark Industries (Earth-1610)|Stark Industries]]' legacy, Tony set out to create his own company from scratch so to leave his father's shadow, a promising small business called [[JT Technologies (Earth-1610)|JT Technologies]] he was working on with his girlfriend [[Josey Gardner (Earth-1610)|Josey Gardner]]. Unfortunately, Howard continued pressuring Tony, and he managed to sway his son away from his dreams. Tony reluctantly joined Howard's side, and as a consequence, Josey left him.

Six months later, Josey died tragically in a plane crash.{{r|Ultimate Comics Iron Man Vol 1 1}} Unbeknownst to anybody, Josey's death had been orchestrated by [[Mandarin International (Earth-1610)|Mandarin International]], a company Howard dealt with during Stark Industries' fledgling days, but had cut ties with ever since. Josey's death had the effect the Mandarin desired on Tony,{{r|Ultimate Comics Iron Man Vol 1 4}} as Howard convinced the boy to channel his emotions into his work and throw himself into his inventions. Tony's first project following Josey's death involved the development of cutting edge nanotechnology.{{r|Ultimate Comics Iron Man Vol 1 1}}

===Becoming Iron Man===
Following Howard's death, presumably at the hands of the Mandarin in revenge for walking on them, Tony took full reins of Stark Industries.{{r|Ultimate Comics Iron Man Vol 1 4}} As he grew up a cynic, alcoholic womanizer, Stark also became a world-wide celebrity and a brand name.{{r|Ultimates Vol 1 1}} His company was the third biggest in America, and he was the world's third-richest man. However, Tony's life took a drastic change when he was was diagnosed with an inoperable brain tumor.{{r|Ultimates Vol 1 6}} Desperate for a cure, Tony met with the best oncologists from all over the world. While visiting a children's hospital, he met a young boy named Sam who was undergoing chemotherapy. Sam's death even after being treated for three years encouraged Tony to use the time he had left to put his resources to use for a better world.{{r|Ultimate New Ultimates Vol 1 1}} Tony additionally turned to technology to help himself, and started devising a temporary cure in the form of a mixture of bio-tech and armor.

During a business trip in [[Guatemala]], Stark and his cousin [[Morgan Stark (Earth-1610)|Morgan]] were captured along with the passengers on their flight by a guerrilla militia called the [[Red Devil (Earth-1610)|Red Devil]]. The soldiers murdered Morgan when Tony refused to cooperate. Tony eventually agreed to help the terrorists, and built a rough exo-skeleton based on the preliminary designs of the armor he was working on in the States. However, without the necessary precautions, Stark made is so the device purposefully backfired on his captors, which facilitating his freedom{{r|Ultimate Marvel Team Up Vol 1 5}} and allowed him to lead a rescue mission that saved the lives of his fellow captives. Stark's actions kick-started events that ended the Red Devil's reign of international terrorism. In the aftermath of this incident, Tony stayed away from the public spotlight for almost two years. When he returned, Tony refashioned himself as a super hero,{{r|Ultimate Marvel Team Up Vol 1 4}} using his latest invention, a nanotechnology-operated [[Iron Man Armor (Earth-1610)|suit]] to become the armor-clad super hero [[Iron Man]].{{r|Ultimates Vol 1 2}} Iron Man became a global phenomenon after he saved the Vice-President from an assassination attempt.{{r|Ultimate Marvel Team Up Vol 1 4}}

For a while, Tony operated together with his friend [[James Rhodes (Earth-1610)|Jim Rhodes]], who wore an armor similar to Tony's and went by the alias of [[War Machine]]. They had a falling out after Tony's recklessness almost cost both of their lives when fighting [[Advanced Idea Mechanics (Earth-1610)|A.I.M.]] forces. The last time they had spoken, Rhodey berated Tony for his behavior, and Stark had him removed from his building by security.{{r|Ultimate Comics Iron Man Vol 1 2}}

===Ultimates===
Continuing with his desire to help save the world, Stark accepted an offer to join the [[Ultimates (Earth-1610)|Ultimates]], a [[Strategic Hazard Intervention Espionage Logistics Directorate (Earth-1610)|S.H.I.E.L.D.]]-sponsored super hero team, as Iron Man.{{r|Ultimates Vol 1 2}} Forming an unlikely friendship with anti-corporate teammate [[Thor Odinson (Earth-1610)|Thor]], Stark helped subdue the monstrous [[Bruce Banner (Earth-1610)|Hulk]] and save Earth from the extraterrestrial [[Chitauri]].{{r|Ultimates Vol 1 6|13}}

Tony began dating teammate [[Natalia Romanova (Earth-1610)|Natasha Romanova]] and eventually proposed to her, creating a new armor for her as an engagement gift; however, when a traitor within the ranks helped an army of foreign Super-Soldiers defeat the Ultimates, Natasha was apparently revealed as the traitor when she turned on Tony during the assault, killing Tony's good friend, and butler, [[Edwin Jarvis (Earth-1610)|Jarvis]]. Tony turned the tables on her, using the nanites he had given Natasha to control the armor against his former lover, paralyzing her and downloading information direct from her brain to his.{{r|Ultimates 2 Vol 1 1|13}}

[[File:Antonio Stark (Earth-1610) from Ultimate Spider-Man Special Vol 1 1 001.jpg|thumb|left|Tony Stark]]
Stark left his penthouse in an old model suit of armor similar to the ones used by the [[Rocketmen (Earth-1610)|Rocketmen]]. Though his support staff believed that he was heading to [[Washington, D.C.]] to battle the [[Liberators (Earth-1610)|Liberators]], Stark instead set a course for an orbiting satellite. He reappeared in D.C. a short time later in a massive airborne weapons platform called Iron Man Six. With the new armor, Stark made short work of the airborne forces of the Liberators and destroyed most of the [[Alex Su (Earth-1610)|Crimson Dynamo]]'s mobile dolls. After the battle, Stark agreed to finance the now privately practicing Ultimates, and very quickly got over Natasha's betrayal with the help of a pretty blonde.{{r|Ultimates 2 Vol 1 11|13}}

===Ultron Take-Over===
Tony brought the Ultimates into his home, using it as their base, and supplying all their needs. One of the [[Ultron (Earth-1610)|Ultron]] bots, a robot designed by [[Henry Pym (Earth-1610)|Hank Pym]] as butlers and servants, had become evil, falling in love with the [[Wanda Lensherr (Earth-1610)|Scarlet Witch]]. Ultron had killed the Scarlet Witch after realizing he/it would never have her to himself. Drugging Tony, Ultron took over the Iron Man persona, creating a brand new suit, all the while holding Stark in a tank, while creating new robotic versions of the Ultimates as they were in the prime of their lives. Tony was able to escape, thanks to [[Janet Van Dyne (Earth-1610)|Wasp]] and Ant-Man. Tony acquired a new suit and helped the Ultimates fight [[Erik Lensherr (Earth-1610)|Magneto]] and the Ultron bots. Unfortunately, Magneto snapped when his son, [[Pietro Lensherr (Earth-1610)|Quicksilver]], was apparently killed during the fight.{{r|Ultimates 3 Vol 1 1|5}}

===[[Ultimatum (Event)|Ultimatum]]===
Magneto, in response to the death of his children, shifted the Earth's axis, causing world-wide devastation. [[New York City|New York]] was demolished by a huge tidal wave, which also destroyed Tony's home, and killed millions, including some heroes, in the process (e.g. Wasp, [[Matthew Murdock (Earth-1610)|Daredevil]], etc.). Tony, who was saved by his suit, rescued [[Steven Rogers (Earth-1610)|Captain America]], and the two went looking for survivors. Cap fell unconscious, and Tony was forced to bring Cap to the [[Triskelion (New York City)|Triskelion]], where Cap was met with immediate help. Magneto's goons, the [[James Madrox (Earth-1610)|Multiple Men]], were causing havoc outside the Triskelion, each strapped with a bomb. Iron Man helped as much as he could to stop Madrox, but it was a suicidal for Hank Pym who killed them all, allowing all of them to crawl over his body, and then walk into the seas, waiting for the stupid Madroxs to blow themselves up, killing all of them, and Pym. Tony and the Ultimates traveled to Magneto's base, where [[James Howlett (Earth-1610)|Wolverine]] immediately attacked. Before Wolverine could kill Magneto, Magneto took control of [[Scott Summers (Earth-1610)|Cyclops]]' lenses, and Iron Man's suit, forcing the two to blast Wolverine. Magneto then easily killed the melted hero. As Magneto was later killed, Tony was about to meet an all new adventure.

===Post-Ultimatum and the Armor Wars===
[[File:Ultimate Armor Wars Vol 1 1 Textless.jpg|thumb|Iron Man battling foes during the Armor Wars]]
Tony traveled to the destroyed building that once was Stark Industries, where he went to a secret underground facility. There, he met [[Justine Hammer (Earth-1610)|Justine Hammer]], a woman looking for nano fleets to put in her blood to help her survive her father's experiments on her. He also later met the [[Ghost (Earth-1610)|Ghost]], who had stolen a remnant very sacred to Tony. Tony teamed up with Justine to take down the Ghost, but first, solve the problem about who had secretly stolen Tony's Iron Man technology. Traveling all across Europe, from [[Prague]], to [[England]], Tony fell in love with Justine. Finding that the England riot police had used his tech to create Riot suits, Tony was outraged, and attacked the police. The police managed to force Stark to run away. Tony met the Ghost again, who blasted Tony into the river, where water flooded into his damaged helmet. The Police took Tony out of the river, bringing him to Justine. Justine and Tony made love, and Tony asked her to stay with him, which she agreed to. They were interrupted by an explosion outside their jet. Tony got into his ruined suit, and went to meet two giant Iron Men who blasted Tony until he finally was defeated, his suit utterly destroyed. The robots brought Tony to a base in a stranded desert, where Tony met his delusional Grandfather, [[Howard Stark Sr. (Earth-1610)|Howard Stark Sr]]. Howard was in charge of the Ghost, the robots, and Justine, and was looking for an upgrade in his organic, giant, old suit. Howard had the remnant that the had Ghost stolen and wanted Tony to open it. Tony used a quote by Richard Feynman, and the box opened. Inside the box was the dead head of [[Anthony Stark (Earth-242)|Tony Stark (Earth-242)]]. Tony explained he got the head while looking at other universes with [[Reed Richards (Earth-1610)|Reed Richards]]. The entire Earth was on fire, so he took the head of his counterpart. Tony explained that, while he had upgraded himself for safety, the head shutdown Nanofleets, and killed machinery. Immediately, Ghost exploded, Howard was killed, the robots exploded, and Justine died. Tony then sat alone, stating "Lucky me", in a depressed tone. Tony was later in [[Berlin]], drinking with the head, crying in an extremely depressed state.

[[File:Antonio Stark (Earth-1610) and Iron Man Armor (New Ultimates) (Earth-1610) from Ultimate New Ultimates Vol 1 1 001.jpg|thumb|New team, new armor|left]]
===New Ultimates===
Returning to the Triskelion, and under S.H.I.E.L.D. command, Tony became the leader of the [[New Ultimates (Earth-1610)|New Ultimates]], wearing a new slimmer suit after his original was destroyed. While in the field, [[Carol Danvers (Earth-1610)|Carol Danvers]], S.H.I.E.L.D. leader, presented herself as the boss of Tony and the team, things were much different in the bedroom, as Tony and Carol began a sexual relationship. One night, Tony was with [[Clint Barton (Earth-1610)|Hawkeye]], discussing the changes after Ultimatum. Tony made it very clear that he had lost practically everything because of Ultimatum. Suddenly, the [[Defenders (Earth-1610)|Defenders]], a teenage wannabe super hero team arrived, but as supervillains. As the rest of team came to aid Iron Man and Hawkeye in the fight, the Defenders left with what they came for: [[Mjolnir]]. This allowed [[Loki Odinson (Earth-1610)|Loki]] to teleport back to Earth to resume his chaos. Carol Danvers revealed to Tony that she had one of the Defenders, [[Daimon Hellstrom (Earth-1610)|Hellstorm]], working undercover.

===Training Spider-Man===
When the Ultimates didn't knew what to do with [[Peter Parker (Earth-1610)|Spider-Man]], Carol Danvers proposed to train him, Iron Man was one of his tutors and helped him to fight [[Quentin Beck (Earth-616)|Mysterio]] in [[SoHo]].

[[File:Iron Man Armor (Earth-1610) from Ultimate Spider-Man Vol 2 153 001.jpg|thumb|300px|The Hall of Armors|right]]
===Vampire Wars===
During the attack of the-now-turned-vampires [[Stick (Earth-1610)|Stick]], [[Raymond Connor (Earth-1610)|Daredevil]] and [[Bruce Banner (Clone) (Earth-1610)|Nerd Hulk]] along an army of vampires, Stark was seriously damaged and taken to a hospital by Captain America and Thor.

===Avengers vs. New Ultimates===
Stark recovered really fast from his wounds and was able to fight War Machine in a new armor. While attending to [[Gregory Stark (Earth-1610)|his brother]]'s funeral, Tony is invited by [[Jonathan Blackhaven (Earth-1610)|Jonathan Blackhaven]] to be part of the secret [[Kratos Club (Earth-1610)|Kratos Club]], a group of industrial multimillionaires, whose goal is to use their influence to ensure that the right things get done, no matter what.

===Death of Spider-Man===
Tony proposed [[Maybelle Parker (Earth-1610)|May Parker]] and [[Gwendolyne Stacy (Earth-1610)|Gwen Stacy]] to give her one of his houses in [[Paris]] and take them there.

===Return to The Ultimates===
With new global problems rising, the Ultimates returned, and Iron Man as a part of it. Tony used a new device for remote access to the armor, and tried to prevent a military conflict between [[Uruguay]] and [[Argentina]]. A ghost ship equipped with a atomic bomb made in Stark Industries was detonated in [[Montevideo]] (Uruguay's capital city) and the Iron Man armor made a short cut, affecting Tony himself. [[Jarvis (William) (Earth-1610)|Jarvis]] assisted Stark with electronic shocks and Tony was brought back. Using a transportable Iron Man armor, Tony went to aid Thor when [[Asgard]] was destroyed at the hands of the [[Children of Tomorrow (Earth-1610)|Children of Tomorrow]].

[[File:Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 3 Textless.jpg|thumb|left]]
Due to Thor being powerless, Tony provided him with a new and upgraded version of his old Super-Soldier suit, with which Thor was powered again and battled the Children of Tomorrow along with the other Ultimates.

Thinking about the Kratos Club as responsible of the Uruguayan massacre, Tony went to Paris and faced them, but couldn't do anything as they stated it was only for their benefit.

Soon before the Children nuked Washington, D.C., the President activated the "Winter Protocols", making agent [[Marvin Flumm (S.H.I.E.L.D.) (Earth-1610)|Marvin Flumm]] the new director of S.H.I.E.L.D., who ordered to hunt down the Ultimates and bring them to him. Tony managed to escape from the [[Stark Tower]] along Thor, but at the same time his brain tumor reappeared.

After S.H.I.E.L.D. convinced [[Shen-Yin (Earth-1610)|Zorn]] and the Hulk to attack the Children (but the latter convinced to help them), the [[Reed Richards (Earth-1610)|Maker]] deployed an anti-matter attack on Washington, D.C., killing the President, his Cabinet and the Congress, with only Secretary of Energy Howard surviving and becoming the next President and activating the Winter Protocols, forcing the Ultimates to hand over to S.H.I.E.L.D. custody, only Tony Stark and Thor managed to escape. Tony contacted the new President to make a plan against the Children, Stark was provided as a prisoner for the Children to seal a pact of peace.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 11}}

When Richards was about to vivisect Stark, Tony's self-conscious technology interfacer brain tumor named [[Anthony (Brain Tumor) (Earth-1610)|Anthony]] convinced the City to rebel against the Maker because of his master's counter-evolutionary acts of war and allowed Anthony to create a [[Iron Man Armor (Anthony) (Earth-1610)|giant Iron Man Armor]] and use it against Richards and become the new leader of the Children. Richards defended himself using a Giant-Man serum on the Hulk, but he was finally defeated by [[Susan Storm (Earth-1610)|Sue Storm]] and presumably handed over to S.H.I.E.L.D.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 12}}

===Divided We Fall===
When the Ultimates decided to face the [[Sentinels#Ultimate Universe .28Earth-1610.29|Nimrod Sentinel]] invasion in the country, Tony created a new armor to face this evil. He helped Captain America and Thor to destroy a rogue Sentinel in [[New Mexico (State)|New Mexico]], and stop the people that were controlling it. He also disarmed the New Republic of [[Texas (State)|Texas]] by threatening one of the members of its government into giving him the nuke's codes, and then giving said codes to Anthony, who disarmed the nuke in the nick of time. Iron Man is also helping out [[Katherine Pryde (Earth-1610)|Kitty Pryde]] and the mutants. Kitty Has showed Iron Man some mutant plants that can change the world and she wants to show the world. 

Iron Man was present during the battle for [[Wyoming (State)|Wyoming]] against [[Hydra (Earth-1610)|Hydra]] and [[Modi Thorson (Earth-1610)|Modi]] in which the Ultimates were triumphant.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 18}}

[[File:Antonio Stark (Earth-1610) from Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 18.1 0001.jpg|thumb|right|Tony's new identity]]
===Reconstruction and Disassembled===
After the [[United States of America|United States]] was saved from a civil war, Tony felt that a reconstruction of the country was needed, he created a new identity of Iron Patriot in order to boost the morality of American people.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 18.1}}

After facing new threats such as Hydra and the appearance of the [[West Coast Ultimates (Earth-1610)|West Coast Ultimates]], Tony returned to his "Iron Man" identity. He was present during a meeting in which Invisible Woman informed S.H.I.E.L.D. about the [[Infinity Stones|Infinity Gems]] she had been gathering along Thor, and the moment in which the mysterious [[Susan Storm (Earth-13074)|Kang]] freed both Hulk and Reed Richards from the Triskelion, stole the Gems and formed along them and Quicksilver the [[Dark Ultimates (Earth-1610)|Dark Ultimates]]. The Ultimates barely escaped, but Captain America decided to be left behind in order to stop the villains, although he was defeated.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 25}}

[[File:Antonio Stark (Earth-1610) from Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 28 001.jpg|thumb|200px|left|Stark incorporeal]]
Stark started working in one of his secret warehouses on a way to stop Richards, Anthony unsuccessfully tried to remove a encrypted code from Stark's armors, and Tony created a gauntlet to control the [[Power Stone|Power Gem]]. Stark was attacked by Quicksilver, who came to collect the latest discovery of the Dark Ultimates, that one of the remaining gems was inside Tony Stark's brain.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 26}} The Maker performed a surgery on Stark's brain while his [[Humanoid Experimental Robot B-type Integrated Electronics (Earth-1610)|H.E.R.B.I.E.]] Trons were trying to reach the Earth's core in order to acquire the final gem. Richards finally got the last gem, and left Tony Stark to die.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 27}}

Richards copied Stark's brain waves in order to access to the [[Hall of Armor|Iron Man Armory]]. But it was revealed Stark's consciousness survived electronically, he managed to get into Reed's systems secretly, starting a plan to defeat the Dark Ultimates by freeing the Ultimates from the [[Negative Zone]]. He also assembled a new Iron Man armor from the remains of his armory.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 28}} When he confronted Richards, Tony explained that the radiation of the gem in his brain altered his neural network, and made it "plug and play". Iron Man confronted Reed along with the rest of the Ultimates, but the Maker's cavalry arrived in the form of Kang wielding the final gem, who also revealed herself as being the Sue Storm from a near future.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 29}}

[[File:Antonio Stark (Earth-1610) from Cataclysm The Ultimates' Last Stand Vol 1 1 001.jpg|thumb|right]]
During a furious battle against Reed Richards and his Dark Ultimates, Tony managed to acquire the Infinity Gems and depower The Maker. Tony first used the gems to revive his corpse and transfer his consciousness back to his body. When he was about to face Richards, an immense flux of energy echoed through time and space and the Gems were destroyed. Kang stated that what she tried to prevent just happened, and she left stating she would try to go back further in time.

Unknown to them, the flux of energy had brought a powerful being known as [[Galan (Earth-616)|Galactus]] from [[Earth-616|another universe]] to this one, and it started approaching Earth.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 30}} The Ultimates faced Galactus with the loss of [[Steven Rogers (Earth-1610)|Captain America]] and [[Thor Odinson (Earth-1610)|Thor]], but managed to defeat the cosmic entity and exile it to the Negative Zone, saving Earth.{{r|Cataclysm: The Ultimates' Last Stand Vol 1 1|5}} In the end of the crisis, and without Thor and Cap, Tony decided to disband the Ultimates.{{r|Survive! Vol 1 1}}

===Final Incursion===
Based on the concept of the defunct [[Fantastic Four (Earth-1610)|Fantastic Four]], Iron Man founded a team of geniuses along with the [[Susan Storm (Earth-1610)|Invisible Woman]], called the [[Future Foundation (Earth-1610)|Future Foundation]].{{r|Ultimate FF Vol 1 1}} The team managed to save the universe from an ever-increasing amount of rifts in time-space,{{r|Ultimate FF Vol 1 6}} but learned that all of reality would ultimately come to an end due to a different phenomena known as [[Glossary:Incursion|incursions]].

The incursions caused realities to collide with each other, with the point of impact being each universe's planet Earth, and the final one pitted Earth-1610 against [[Earth-616]]. Nick Fury and S.H.I.E.L.D. were led to believe by the Maker that their universe had a chance at surviving by destroying the colliding alternate planet Earth. Iron Man assisted the S.H.I.E.L.D. army which attempted to destroy the alternate Earth, and deployed the [[Iron Man Armor MK VI (Earth-1610)|Iron Man Six]], but said weapon was neutralized by the [[Guardians of the Galaxy (Earth-616)|Guardians of the Galaxy]]. In the end, the two realities collided, and Iron Man died together with his universe.{{r|Secret Wars Vol 1 1}}

===Return===
Iron Man and his fellow Ultimates were resurrected by the [[Reed Richards (Earth-1610)|Maker]] when he rewrote the [[Multiverse]] in order to merge all realities into one to help [[Eternity (Multiverse)|Eternity]] fight the [[First Firmament (First Cosmos)|First Firmament]].{{r|Ultimates 2 Vol 2 9}} When the [[Ultimates (Earth-616)|Ultimates]] from the [[Earth-616|Prime Earth]] arrived on [[Counter-Earth (High Evolutionary)|Counter-Earth]] and confronted the Maker for his actions, which were actually giving the First Firmament the upper hand against Eternity, Iron Man and his teammates were ordered by him to attack the other Ultimates, and kill them if possible. Iron Man didn't want to fight and tried to act as a peacemaker, but Captain America made that difficult. Eventually, the members of both teams realized they shouldn't be fighting each other, and worked together to help Eternity gain the strength to finally defeat the First Firmament. After that, Iron Man and the other Ultimates decided to travel the Multiverse to hunt down the Maker.{{r|Ultimates 2 Vol 2 100}}

| Notes                   = 
* The Ultimate Universe version of Iron Man originally made his debut in 2001's {{cl|Ultimate Marvel Team Up Vol 1 4}}. In this series, Tony was a child prodigy who created the Iron Man Armor in adulthood as a bio-mechanical solution to stop his brain tumor. He was additionally captured by terrorists in [[Guatemala]], leading to his change of heart to become a super hero. This origin was overwritten in 2005's [[Ultimate Iron Man Vol 1|''Ultimate Iron Man'']], in which Tony's entire flesh was mutated into neural tissue while in womb due to an accident, and he was already sporting the Iron Man armor as a teenager. The ''[[Official Handbook of the Ultimate Marvel Universe: The Ultimates & X-Men 2005 Vol 1 1|Official Handbook of the Ultimate Marvel Universe: Ultimate X-Men - Ultimates 2005]]'' reconciled the two different origins in a way, revealing that Tony simply claimed to have built the Iron Man suit when he was older. The ''Ultimate Iron Man'' origin was eventually ignored, with 2011's {{cl|Ultimate Avengers vs. New Ultimates Vol 1 2}} retconning it as a work of fiction within the Ultimate Universe. According to [[Sana Amanat]], this second origin was dropped because "while the [[Orson Scott Card]] series was great, it didn't match up with where we were going."{{cite|ref=true|url=https://www.cbr.com/nycc-ultimate-comics-universe-reborn/|title=NYCC: Ultimate Comics Universe Reborn|work=CBR.com|first=Kiel|last=Phegley|date=14 October 2011|accessdate=30 April 2018}} A portion of Tony's early life was fleshed out in {{cl|Ultimate Comics Iron Man Vol 1}}, retconning the elements of Tony's younger years that had been introduced in ''Ultimate Marvel Team-Up''. Instead of founding Stark Industries on his own, ''Ultimate Comics Iron Man'' showed Tony inheriting the company from his father.

Armor]] which still required a team to assemble or an assembly device.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 13}}{{r|Ultimate Comics Iron Man Vol 1 1}}
* Tony had made multiple suicide attempts.{{r|Ultimates 2 Vol 1 4}}
* Tony was born twenty minutes after his twin brother Gregory.{{r|Ultimate Avengers Vol 1 16}}
* Tony Stark's biggest fear was the death of his friends and teammates.{{r|Spider-Men Vol 1 4}}
* Tony Stark considered himself the smartest man of Earth, [[Samuel Wilson (Earth-1610)|Sam Wilson]] the second, [[Amadeus Cho (Earth-1610)|Amadeus Cho]] the third, [[Bruce Banner (Earth-1610)|Bruce Banner]] the fourth, and [[Reed Richards (Earth-1610)|Reed Richards]] the eighth or ninth, although this statement was meant entirely to taunt Reed.{{r|Ultimate Comics Ultimates Vol 1 29}}
